verses.en: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
verses.fr: Le roi David était vieux, avancé en âge; on le couvrait de vêtements, et il ne pouvait se réchauffer.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ዳዊትም ሸመገለ ዕድሜውም በዛ፤ ልብስም ደረቡለት፥ ነገር ግን አይሞቀውም ነበር።

verses.en: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
verses.fr: Ses serviteurs lui dirent: Que l''on cherche pour mon seigneur le roi une jeune fille vierge; qu''elle se tienne devant le roi, qu''elle le soigne, et qu''elle couche dans ton sein; et mon seigneur le roi se réchauffera.
verses.am: ባሪያዎቹም። ለጌታችን ለንጉሡ ድንግል ትፈለጋለች፤ በንጉሡም ፊት ቆማ ታገልግለው፥ በጌታችንም በንጉሡ ብብት ተኝታ ታሙቀው አሉት።

verses.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.fr: On chercha dans tout le territoire d''Israël une fille jeune et belle, et on trouva Abischag, la Sunamite, que l''on conduisit auprès du roi.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም አገር ሁሉ የተዋበች ቈንጆ ፈለጉ፤ ሱነማይቱን አቢሳንም አገኙ፥ ወደ ንጉሡም ይዘዋት መጡ።

verses.en: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
verses.fr: Cette jeune fille était fort belle. Elle soigna le roi, et le servit; mais le roi ne la connut point.
verses.am: ቈንጆይቱም እጅግ ውብ ነበረች፤ ንጉሡንም ትረዳውና ታገለግለው ነበር፥ ንጉሡ ግን አያውቃትም ነበር።

verses.en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.fr: Adonija, fils de Haggith, se laissa emporter par l''orgueil jusqu''à dire: C''est moi qui serai roi! Et il se procura un char et des cavaliers, et cinquante hommes qui couraient devant lui.
verses.am: የአጊትም ልጅ አዶንያስ። ንጉሥ እሆናለሁ ብሎ ተነሣ፤ ሰረገሎችንና ፈረሰኞችን በፊቱም የሚሮጡ አምሳ ሰዎች አዘጋጀ።

verses.en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.
verses.fr: Son père ne lui avait de sa vie fait un reproche, en lui disant: Pourquoi agis-tu ainsi? Adonija était, en outre, très beau de figure, et il était né après Absalom.
verses.am: አባቱም ከቶ በሕይወቱ ሳለ። እንዲህ ለምን ታደርጋለህ? ብሎ አልተቈጣውም ነበር፤ እርሱ ደግሞ እጅግ ያማረ ሰው ነበረ፤ ከአቤሴሎምም በኋላ ተወልዶ ነበር።

verses.en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
verses.fr: Il eut un entretien avec Joab, fils de Tseruja, et avec le sacrificateur Abiathar; et ils embrassèrent son parti.
verses.am: ሴራውም ከጽሩያ ልጅ ከኢዮአብና ከካህኑ ከአብያታር ጋር ነበረ፥ እነርሱም አዶንያስን ተከትለው ይረዱት ነበር።

verses.en: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.fr: Mais le sacrificateur Tsadok, Benaja, fils de Jehojada, Nathan le prophète, Schimeï, Réï, et les vaillants hommes de David, ne furent point avec Adonija.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ካህኑ ሳዶቅና የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ነቢዩም ናታን ሳሚም ሬሲም የዳዊትም ኃያላን ከአዶንያስ ጋር አልነበሩም።

verses.en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:
verses.fr: Adonija tua des brebis, des boeufs et des veaux gras, près de la pierre de Zohéleth, qui est à côté d''En-Roguel; et il invita tous ses frères, fils du roi, et tous les hommes de Juda au service du roi.
verses.am: አዶንያስም በጎችንና በሬዎችን ፍሪዳዎችንም በዓይንሮጌል አጠገብ ባለችው በዞሔሌት ድንጋይ ዘንድ ሠዋ፤ የንጉሡንም ልጆች ወንድሞቹን ሁሉ፥ የንጉሡንም ባሪያዎች፥ የይሁዳን ሰዎች ሁሉ ጠራ።

verses.en: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
verses.fr: Mais il n''invita point Nathan le prophète, ni Benaja, ni les vaillants hommes, ni Salomon, son frère.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ነቢዩን ናታንን፥ በናያስንም፥ ኃያላኑንም፥ ወንድሙንም ሰሎሞንን አልጠራም።

verses.en: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
verses.fr: Alors Nathan dit à Bath-Schéba, mère de Salomon: N''as-tu pas appris qu''Adonija, fils de Haggith, est devenu roi, sans que notre seigneur David le sache?
verses.am: ናታንም የሰሎሞንን እናት ቤርሳቤህን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራት። ጌታችን ዳዊት ሳያውቅ የአጊት ልጅ አዶንያስ እንደ ነገሠ አልሰማሽምን?

verses.en: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
verses.fr: Viens donc maintenant, je te donnerai un conseil, afin que tu sauves ta vie et la vie de ton fils Salomon.
verses.am: አሁንም ነዪ፥ የልጅሽን የሰሎሞንን ነፍስና የአንቺን ነፍስ እንድታድኝ እመክርሻለሁ።

verses.en: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
verses.fr: Va, entre chez le roi David, et dis-lui: O roi mon seigneur, n''as-tu pas juré à ta servante, en disant: Salomon, ton fils, régnera après moi, et il s''assiéra sur mon trône? Pourquoi donc Adonija règne-t-il?
verses.am: ሄደሽ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ዳዊት ግቢና። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ለእኔ ለባሪያህ። ልጅሽ ሰሎሞን ከእኔ በኋላ ይነግሣል፥ በዙፋኔም ይቀመጣል ብለህ አልማልህልኝምን? ስለ ምንስ አዶንያስ ይነግሣል? በዪው።

verses.en: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
verses.fr: Et voici, pendant que tu parleras là avec le roi, j''entrerai moi-même après toi, et je compléterai tes paroles.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አንቺ በዚያ ለንጉሥ ስትነግሪ እኔ ከአንቺ በኋላ እገባለሁ፥ ቃልሽንም አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
verses.fr: Bath-Schéba se rendit dans la chambre du roi. Il était très vieux; et Abischag, la Sunamite, le servait.
verses.am: ቤርሳቤህም ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ እልፍኝ ገባች፤ ንጉሡም እጅግ ሸምግሎ ነበር፥ ሱነማይቱም አቢሳ ታገለግለው ነበር።

verses.en: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
verses.fr: Bath-Schéba s''inclina et se prosterna devant le roi. Et le roi dit: Qu''as-tu?
verses.am: ቤርሳቤህም አጐንብሳ ለንጉሡ እጅ ነሣች፤ ንጉሡም። ምን ትፈልጊያለሽ? አለ።

verses.en: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the Lord thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
verses.fr: Elle lui répondit: Mon seigneur, tu as juré à ta servante par l''Eternel, ton Dieu, en disant: Salomon, ton fils, régnera après moi, et il s''assiéra sur mon trône.
verses.am: እርስዋም አለችው። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ አንተ ለባሪያህ። ልጅሽ ሰሎሞን ከእኔ በኋላ ይነግሣል፥ በዙፋኔም ይቀመጣል ብለህ በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ምለህልኛል፤

verses.en: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:
verses.fr: Et maintenant voici, Adonija règne! Et tu ne le sais pas, ô roi mon seigneur!
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ አዶንያስ መንገሡ ነው፤ አንተም ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ይህን አታውቅም፤

verses.en: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
verses.fr: Il a tué des boeufs, des veaux gras et des brebis en quantité; et il a invité tous les fils du roi, le sacrificateur Abiathar, et Joab, chef de l''armée, mais il n''a point invité Salomon, ton serviteur.
verses.am: እርሱም ብዙ በሬዎችንና ፍሪዳዎችን በጎችንም ሠውቶአል፥ የንጉሡንም ልጆች ሁሉ፥ ካህኑንም አብያታርን፥ የሠራዊቱንም አለቃ ኢዮአብን ጠርቶአል፤ ባሪያህን ሰሎሞንን ግን አልጠራውም።

verses.en: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.fr: O roi mon seigneur, tout Israël a les yeux sur toi, pour que tu lui fasses connaître qui s''assiéra sur le trône du roi mon seigneur après lui.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ በኋላ በጌታዬ በንጉሥ ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመጠውን ትነግራቸው ዘንድ የእስራኤል ሁሉ ዓይን ይመለከትሃል።

verses.en: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
verses.fr: Et lorsque le roi mon seigneur sera couché avec ses pères, il arrivera que moi et mon fils Salomon nous serons traités comme des coupables.
verses.am: ይህ ባይሆን፥ ጌታዬ ከአባቶችህ ጋር ባንቀላፋህ ጊዜ እኔና ልጄ ሰሎሞን እንደ ኃጢአተኞች እንቈጠራለን።

verses.en: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
verses.fr: Tandis qu''elle parlait encore avec le roi, voici, Nathan le prophète arriva.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ለንጉሡ ስትናገር ነቢዩ ናታን ገባ።

verses.en: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.fr: On l''annonça au roi, en disant: Voici Nathan le prophète! Il entra en présence du roi, et se prosterna devant le roi, le visage contre terre.
verses.am: ለንጉሡም። እነሆ፥ ነቢዩ ናታን መጥቶአል ብለው ነገሩት፤ እርሱም ወደ ንጉሡ ፊት በገባ ጊዜ በግምባሩ በምድር ላይ ተደፍቶ ለንጉሡ እጅ ነሣ።

verses.en: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
verses.fr: Et Nathan dit: O roi mon seigneur, c''est donc toi qui as dit: Adonija régnera après moi, et il s''assiéra sur mon trône!
verses.am: ናታንም አለ። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ አንተ። ከእኔ በኋላ አዶንያስ ይነግሣል፥ በዙፋኔም ላይ ይቀመጣል ብለሃልን?

verses.en: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
verses.fr: Car il est descendu aujourd''hui, il a tué des boeufs, des veaux gras et des brebis en quantité; et il a invité tous les fils du roi, les chefs de l''armée, et le sacrificateur Abiathar. Et voici, ils mangent et boivent devant lui, et ils disent: Vive le roi Adonija!
verses.am: እርሱ ዛሬ ወርዶ ብዙ በሬዎችንና ፍሪዳዎችን በጎችንም ሠውቶአል፥ የንጉሡንም ልጆች ሁሉ፥ የሠራዊትንም አለቃ ኢዮአብን፥ ካህኑንም አብያታርን ጠርቶአል፤ እነሆም፥ በፊቱ እየበሉና እየጠጡ። አዶንያስ ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ ይላሉ።

verses.en: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
verses.fr: Mais il n''a invité ni moi qui suis ton serviteur, ni le sacrificateur Tsadok, ni Benaja, fils de Jehojada, ni Salomon, ton serviteur.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እኔን ባሪያህን፥ ካህኑንም ሳዶቅን፥ የዮዳሄንም ልጅ በናያስን፥ ባሪያህንም ሰሎሞንን አልጠራም።

verses.en: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
verses.fr: Est-ce bien par ordre de mon seigneur le roi que cette chose a lieu, et sans que tu aies fait connaître à ton serviteur qui doit s''asseoir sur le trône du roi mon seigneur après lui?
verses.am: በውኑ ይህ ነገር ከጌታዬ ከንጉሡ የተደረገ ነውን? ለባሪያህም ከአንተ በኋላ በጌታዬ በንጉሡ ዙፋን ላይ የሚቀመጠውን አልነገርህምን?

verses.en: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.
verses.fr: Le roi David répondit: Appelez-moi Bath-Schéba. Elle entra, et se présenta devant le roi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዳዊት። ቤርሳቤህን ጥሩልኝ ብሎ መለሰ። ወደ ንጉሡም ገባች፥ በንጉሡም ፊት ቆመች።

verses.en: And the king sware, and said, As the Lord liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
verses.fr: Et le roi jura, et dit: L''Eternel qui m''a délivré de toutes les détresses est vivant!
verses.am: ንጉሡም። ነፍሴን ከመከራ ሁሉ ያዳነኝ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን!

verses.en: Even as I sware unto thee by the Lord God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
verses.fr: Ainsi que je te l''ai juré par l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, en disant: Salomon, ton fils, régnera après moi, et il s''assiéra sur mon trône à ma place, -ainsi ferai-je aujourd''hui.
verses.am: በእውነት። ልጅሽ ሰሎሞን ከእኔ በኋላ ይነግሣል፥ በእኔም ፋንታ በዙፋኔ ላይ ይቀመጣል ብዬ በእስራኤል አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር እንደ ማልሁልሽ፥ እንዲሁ ዛሬ በእውነት አደርጋለሁ ብሎ ማለ።

verses.en: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
verses.fr: Bath-Schéba s''inclina le visage contre terre, et se prosterna devant le roi. Et elle dit: Vive à jamais mon seigneur le roi David!
verses.am: ቤርሳቤህም በግምባርዋ በምድር ላይ ተደፍታ ለንጉሡ እጅ ነሣችና። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ዳዊት ለዘላለም በሕይወት ይኑር አለች።

verses.en: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
verses.fr: Le roi David dit: Appelez-moi le sacrificateur Tsadok, Nathan le prophète, et Benaja, fils de Jehojada. Ils entrèrent en présence du roi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዳዊት። ካህኑን ሳዶቅንና ነቢዩን ናታንን የዮዳሄንም ልጅ በናያስን ጥሩልኝ አለ። ወደ ንጉሡም ፊት ገቡ።

verses.en: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
verses.fr: Et le roi leur dit: Prenez avec vous les serviteurs de votre maître, faites monter Salomon, mon fils, sur ma mule, et faites-le descendre à Guihon.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አላቸው። የጌታችሁን ባሪያዎች ይዛችሁ ሂዱ፥ ልጄንም ሰሎሞንን በበቅሎዬ ላይ አስቀምጡት፥ ወደ ግዮንም አውርዱት፤

verses.en: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
verses.fr: Là, le sacrificateur Tsadok et Nathan le prophète l''oindront pour roi sur Israël. Vous sonnerez de la trompette, et vous direz: Vive le roi Salomon!
verses.am: በዚያም ካህኑ ሳዶቅና ነቢዩ ናታን በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ አድርገው ይቅቡት፤ ቀንደ መለከትም ነፍታችሁ። ሰሎሞን ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ በሉ።

verses.en: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
verses.fr: Vous monterez après lui; il viendra s''asseoir sur mon trône, et il régnera à ma place. C''est lui qui, par mon ordre, sera chef d''Israël et de Juda.
verses.am: በኋላውም ተከትላችሁ ውጡ፤ እርሱም መጥቶ በዙፋኔ ላይ ይቀመጥ፥ በእኔም ፋንታ ይንገሥ፤ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳም ላይ አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the Lord God of my lord the king say so too.
verses.fr: Benaja, fils de Jehojada, répondit au roi: Amen! Ainsi dise l''Eternel, le Dieu de mon seigneur le roi!
verses.am: የዮዳሄም ልጅ በናያስ መልሶ ለንጉሡ አለ፥ ያበጅ ያድርግ፤ የጌታዬም የንጉሥ አምላክ ይህን ይናገር።

verses.en: As the Lord hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.fr: Que l''Eternel soit avec Salomon comme il a été avec mon seigneur le roi, et qu''il élève son trône au-dessus du trône de mon seigneur le roi David!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከጌታዬ ከንጉሥ ጋር እንደ ነበረ እንዲሁ ከሰሎሞን ጋር ይሁን፥ ዙፋኑንም ከጌታዬ ከንጉሡ ዳዊት ዙፋን የበለጠ ያድርግ።

verses.en: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.fr: Alors le sacrificateur Tsadok descendit avec Nathan le prophète, Benaja, fils de Jehojada, les Kéréthiens et les Péléthiens; ils firent monter Salomon sur la mule du roi David, et ils le menèrent à Guihon.
verses.am: ካህኑም ሳዶቅና ነቢዩ ናታን የዮዳሄም ልጅ በናያስ ከሊታውያንና ፈሊታውያንም ወረዱ፥ ሰሎሞንንም በንጉሡ በዳዊት በቅሎ ላይ አስቀምጠው ወደ ግዮን አመጡት።

verses.en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur Tsadok prit la corne d''huile dans la tente, et il oignit Salomon. On sonna de la trompette, et tout le peuple dit: Vive le roi Salomon!
verses.am: ካህኑም ሳዶቅ ከድንኳኑ የቅብዓቱን ቀንድ ወስዶ ሰሎሞንን ቀባ፤ ቀንደ መለከትም ነፉ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። ሰሎሞን ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ አሉ።

verses.en: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple monta après lui, et le peuple jouait de la flûte et se livrait à une grande joie; la terre s''ébranlait par leurs cris.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እርሱን ተከትለው ወጡ፥ ሕዝቡም ዘፈን ይዘፍኑ ነበር፥ በታላቅም ደስታ ደስ አላቸው፤ ከጩኸታቸውም የተነሣ ምድር ተናወጠች።

verses.en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.fr: Ce bruit fut entendu d''Adonija et de tous les conviés qui étaient avec lui, au moment où ils finissaient de manger. Joab, entendant le son de la trompette, dit: Pourquoi ce bruit de la ville en tumulte?
verses.am: አዶንያስና እርሱም የጠራቸው ሁሉ መብሉና መጠጡ ተፈጽሞ ሳለ ሰሙ፤ ኢዮአብም የቀንደ መለከት ጽምፅ በሰማ ጊዜ። ይህ በከተማ ውስጥ ያለ የሽብር ድምፅ ምንድር ነው? አለ።

verses.en: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
verses.fr: Il parlait encore lorsque Jonathan, fils du sacrificateur Abiathar, arriva. Et Adonija dit: Approche, car tu es un vaillant homme, et tu apportes de bonnes nouvelles.
verses.am: እርሱም ይህን ሲናገር የካህኑ የአብያታር ልጅ ዮናታን መጣ፤ አዶንያስም። አንተ መልካም ሰው ነህና፥ መልካም ታወራልናለህና ግባ አለ።

verses.en: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
verses.fr: Oui! répondit Jonathan à Adonija, notre seigneur le roi David a fait Salomon roi.
verses.am: ዮናታንም ለአዶንያስ እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ። በእውነት ጌታችን ንጉሥ ዳዊት ሰሎሞንን አነገሠው።

verses.en: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:
verses.fr: Il a envoyé avec lui le sacrificateur Tsadok, Nathan le prophète, Benaja, fils de Jehojada, les Kéréthiens et les Péléthiens, et ils l''ont fait monter sur la mule du roi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ከእርሱ ጋር ካሁኑን ሳዶቅንና ነቢዩን ናታንን የዮዳሄንም ልጅ በናያስን ከሊታውያንንና ፈሊታውያንንም ሰደደ፥ በንጉሡም በቅሎ ላይ አስቀመጡት።

verses.en: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur Tsadok et Nathan le prophète l''ont oint pour roi à Guihon. De là ils sont remontés en se livrant à la joie, et la ville a été émue: c''est là le bruit que vous avez entendu.
verses.am: ካህኑም ሳዶቅና ነቢዩ ናታን በግዮን ንጉሥ አድርገው ቀቡት፤ ከዚያም ደስ ብሎአቸው ወጡ፥ ከተማይቱም አስተጋባች፤ የሰማችሁትም ድምፅ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.fr: Salomon s''est même assis sur le trône royal.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሰሎሞን በመንግሥቱ ዙፋን ላይ ተቀምጦአል።

verses.en: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.fr: Et les serviteurs du roi sont venus pour bénir notre seigneur le roi David, en disant: Que ton Dieu rende le nom de Salomon plus célèbre que ton nom, et qu''il élève son trône au-dessus de ton trône! Et le roi s''est prosterné sur son lit.
verses.am: የንጉሡም ባሪያዎች ገብተው። እግዚአብሔር የሰሎሞንን ስም ከስምህ ዙፋኑንም ከዙፋንህ የበለጠ ያድርግ ብለው ጌታችንን ንጉሡን ዳዊትን ባረኩ፤ ንጉሡም በአልጋው ላይ ሆኖ ሰገደ።

verses.en: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
verses.fr: Voici encore ce qu''a dit le roi: Béni soit l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, qui m''a donné aujourd''hui un successeur sur mon trône, et qui m''a permis de le voir!
verses.am: ንጉሡም ደግሞ። ዓይኔ እያየ ዛሬ በዙፋኔ ላይ የሚቀመጠውን የሰጠኝ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን አለ።

verses.en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
verses.fr: Tous les conviés d''Adonija furent saisis d''épouvante; ils se levèrent et s''en allèrent chacun de son côté.
verses.am: አዶንያስም የጠራቸው ሁሉ ፈሩ፥ ተነሥተውም እያንዳንዳቸው በየመንገዳቸው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.fr: Adonija eut peur de Salomon; il se leva aussi, s''en alla, et saisit les cornes de l''autel.
verses.am: አዶንያስም ሰሎሞንን ፈራ፥ ተነሥቶም ሄደ፥ የመሠዊያውንም ቀንድ ያዘ።

verses.en: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me today that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.fr: On vint dire à Salomon: Voici, Adonija a peur du roi Salomon, et il a saisi les cornes de l''autel, en disant: Que le roi Salomon me jure aujourd''hui qu''il ne fera point mourir son serviteur par l''épée!
verses.am: ለሰሎሞንም። እነሆ፥ አዶንያስ ንጉሡን ሰሎሞንን ፈርቶ። ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን ባሪያውን በሰይፍ እንዳይገድለኝ ዛሬ ይማልልኝ ብሎ የመሠዊያውን ቀንድ ይዞአል አሉት።

verses.en: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
verses.fr: Salomon dit: S''il se montre un honnête homme, il ne tombera pas à terre un de ses cheveux; mais s''il se trouve en lui de la méchanceté, il mourra.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም። እርሱ አካሄዱን ያሳመረ እንደ ሆነ ከእርሱ አንዲት ጠጕር እንኳ በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም፤ ነገር ግን ክፋት የተገኘበት እንደ ሆነ ይሞታል አለ።

verses.en: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
verses.fr: Et le roi Salomon envoya des gens, qui le firent descendre de l''autel. Il vint se prosterner devant le roi Salomon, et Salomon lui dit: Va dans ta maison.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞንም ላከ፥ ከመሠዊያውም አወረዱት፤ መጥቶም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እጅ ነሣ፥ ሰሎሞንም። ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
verses.fr: David approchait du moment de sa mort, et il donna ses ordres à Salomon, son fils, en disant:
verses.am: ዳዊትም የሚሞትበት ቀን ቀረበ፤ ልጁንም ሰሎሞንን እንዲህ ሲል አዘዘው።

verses.en: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verses.fr: Je m''en vais par le chemin de toute la terre. Fortifie-toi, et sois un homme!
verses.am: እኔ የምድሩን ሁሉ መንገድ እሄዳለሁ፤

verses.en: And keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
verses.fr: Observe les commandements de l''Eternel, ton Dieu, en marchant dans ses voies, et en gardant ses lois, ses ordonnances, ses jugements et ses préceptes, selon ce qui est écrit dans la loi de Moïse, afin que tu réussisses dans tout ce que tu feras et partout où tu te tourneras,
verses.am: በርታ ሰውም ሁን፤ የምታደርገውንና የምትሄድበትን ሁሉ ታከናውን ዘንድ፥ በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ ሥርዓቱንና ትእዛዛቱን ፍርዱንና ምስክሩንም ትጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ በመንገዱም ትሄድ ዘንድ፥ የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: That the Lord may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
verses.fr: et afin que l''Eternel accomplisse cette parole qu''il a prononcée sur moi: Si tes fils prennent garde à leur voie, en marchant avec fidélité devant moi, de tout leur coeur, et de toute leur âme, tu ne manqueras jamais d''un successeur sur le trône d''Israël.
verses.am: ይኸውም ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እኔ። ልጆችህ መንገዳቸውን ቢጠብቁ፥ በፊቴም በፍጹም ልባቸውና በፍጹም ነፍሳቸው በእውነት ቢሄዱ ከእስራኤል ዙፋን ሰው አይቈረጥብህም ብሎ የተናገረውን ቃል ያጸና ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
verses.fr: Tu sais ce que m''a fait Joab, fils de Tseruja, ce qu''il a fait à deux chefs de l''armée d''Israël, à Abner, fils de Ner, et à Amasa, fils de Jéther. Il les a tués; il a versé pendant la paix le sang de la guerre, et il a mis le sang de la guerre sur la ceinture qu''il avait aux reins et sur la chaussure qu''il avait aux pieds.
verses.am: አንተም ደግሞ የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብ፥ ሁለቱን የእስራኤልን ጭፍራ አለቆች የኔር ልጅ አበኔርን የዬቴሩንም ልጅ አሜሳይን ገድሎ፥ በእኔ ላይ ያደረገውን ታውቃለህ፤ የሰልፉንም ደም በሰላም አፈሰሰ፥ በወገቡም ባለው ድግና በእግሩ ባለው ጫማ ንጹሕ ደም አኖረ።

verses.en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
verses.fr: Tu agiras selon ta sagesse, et tu ne laisseras pas ses cheveux blancs descendre en paix dans le séjour des morts.
verses.am: አንተም እንደ ጥበብህ አድርግ፥ ሽበቱንም በሰላም ወደ መቃብር አታውርደው።

verses.en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
verses.fr: Tu traiteras avec bienveillance les fils de Barzillaï, le Galaadite, et ils seront de ceux qui se nourrissent de ta table; car ils ont agi de la même manière à mon égard, en venant au-devant de moi lorsque je fuyais Absalom, ton frère.
verses.am: ከወንድምህ ከአቤሴሎም ፊት በሸሸሁ ጊዜ ቀርበውኛልና ለገለዓዳዊው ለቤርዜሊ ልጆች መልካም ቸርነት አድርግላቸው፥ በማዕድህም ከሚበሉት መካከል ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the Lord, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
verses.fr: Voici, tu as près de toi Schimeï, fils de Guéra, Benjamite, de Bachurim. Il a prononcé contre moi des malédictions violentes le jour où j''allais à Mahanaïm. Mais il descendit à ma rencontre vers le Jourdain, et je lui jurai par l''Eternel, en disant: Je ne te ferai point mourir par l''épée.
verses.am: እኔም ወደ መሃናይም በሄድሁ ጊዜ ብርቱ እርግማን የረገመኝ የብራቂም አገር ሰው የብንያማዊው የጌራ ልጅ ሳሚ፥ እነሆ፥ በአንተ ዘንድ ነው፤ እርሱ ግን ዮርዳኖስን በተሻገርሁ ጊዜ ሊቀበለኝ ወረደ፥ እኔም። በሰይፍ አልገድልህም ብዬ በእግዚአብሔር ምዬለታለሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
verses.fr: Maintenant, tu ne le laisseras pas impuni; car tu es un homme sage, et tu sais comment tu dois le traiter. Tu feras descendre ensanglantés ses cheveux blancs dans le séjour des morts.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ጥበበኛ ሰው ነህና ያለ ቅጣት አትተወው፤ የምታደርግበትንም አንተ ታውቃለህ፥ ሽበቱንም ከደም ጋር ወደ መቃብር አውርድ።

verses.en: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.fr: David se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré dans la ville de David.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Le temps que David régna sur Israël fut de quarante ans: à Hébron il régna sept ans, et à Jérusalem il régna trente-trois ans.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በእስራኤል ላይ የነገሠው ዘመን አርባ ዓመት ነበረ። በኬብሮን ሰባት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሠላሳ ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
verses.fr: Salomon s''assit sur le trône de David, son père, et son règne fut très affermi.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በአባቱ በዳዊት ዙፋን ተቀመጠ፤ መንግሥቱም እጅግ ጸና።

verses.en: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
verses.fr: Adonija, fils de Haggith, alla vers Bath-Schéba, mère de Salomon. Elle lui dit: Viens-tu dans des intentions paisibles? Il répondit: Oui.
verses.am: የአጊት ልጅ አዶንያስም ወደ ሰሎሞን እናት ወደ ቤርሳቤህ መጣ፤ እርስዋም። ወደ እኔ መምጣትህ በሰላም ነውን? አለች፤

verses.en: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
verses.fr: Et il ajouta: J''ai un mot à te dire. Elle dit: Parle!
verses.am: እርሱም። በሰላም ነው አለ። ደግሞም። ከአንቺ ጋር ጉዳይ አለኝ አለ፤ እርስዋም። ተናገር አለች።

verses.en: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the Lord.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Tu sais que la royauté m''appartenait, et que tout Israël portait ses regards sur moi pour me faire régner. Mais la royauté a tourné, et elle est échue à mon frère, parce que l''Eternel la lui a donnée.
verses.am: እርሱም። መንግሥቱ ለእኔ እንደ ነበረ፥ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ንጉሥ እሆን ዘንድ ፊታቸውን ወደ እኔ አድርገው እንደ ነበረ አንቺ ታውቂያለሽ፤ ነገር ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሆኖለታልና መንግሥቱ ከእኔ አልፎ ለወንድሜ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
verses.fr: Maintenant, je te demande une chose: ne me la refuse pas! Elle lui répondit: Parle!
verses.am: አሁንም አንዲት ልመና እለምንሻለሁ፤ አታሳፍሪኝ አለ። እርስዋም። ተናገር አለችው።

verses.en: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Dis, je te prie, au roi Salomon-car il ne te le refusera pas-qu''il me donne pour femme Abischag, la Sunamite.
verses.am: እርሱም። አያሳፍርሽምና ሱነማይቱን አቢሳን ይድርልኝ ዘንድ ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እንድትነግሪው እለምንሻለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
verses.fr: Bath-Schéba dit: Bien! je parlerai pour toi au roi.
verses.am: ቤርሳቤህም። መልካም ነው፥ ስለ አንተ ለንጉሡ እነግረዋለሁ አለች።

verses.en: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.fr: Bath-Schéba se rendit auprès du roi Salomon, pour lui parler en faveur d''Adonija. Le roi se leva pour aller à sa rencontre, il se prosterna devant elle, et il s''assit sur son trône. On plaça un siège pour la mère du roi, et elle s''assit à sa droite.
verses.am: ቤርሳቤህም የአዶንያስን ነገር ትነግረው ዘንድ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሰሎሞን ገባች፤ ንጉሡም ሊቀበላት ተነሣ ሳማትም፥ በዙፋኑም ተቀመጠ፤ ለንጉሡም እናት ወንበር አስመጣላት፥ በቀኙም ተቀመጠች።

verses.en: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.
verses.fr: Puis elle dit: J''ai une petite demande à te faire: ne me la refuse pas! Et le roi lui dit: Demande, ma mère, car je ne te refuserai pas.
verses.am: እርስዋም። አንዲት ታናሽ ልመና እለምንሃለሁ፤ አታሳፍረኝ አለች። ንጉሡም። እናቴ ሆይ፥ አላሳፍርሽምና ለምኝ አላት።

verses.en: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
verses.fr: Elle dit: Qu''Abischag, la Sunamite, soit donnée pour femme à Adonija, ton frère.
verses.am: እርስዋም። ሱነማይቱ አቢሳ ለወንድምህ ለአዶንያስ ትዳርለት አለች።

verses.en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon répondit à sa mère: Pourquoi demandes-tu Abischag, la Sunamite, pour Adonija? Demande donc la royauté pour lui, -car il est mon frère aîné, -pour lui, pour le sacrificateur Abiathar, et pour Joab, fils de Tseruja!
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ለእናቱ መልሶ። ሱነማይቱን አቢሳን ለአዶንያስ ለምን ትለምኝለታለሽ? ታላቅ ወንድሜ ነውና መንግሥትን ደግሞ ለምኚለት፤ ካህኑም አብያታርና የጽሩያ ልጅ ኢዮአብ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር ናቸው አላት።

verses.en: Then king Solomon sware by the Lord, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.fr: Alors le roi Salomon jura par l''Eternel, en disant: Que Dieu me traite dans toute sa rigueur, si ce n''est pas au prix de sa vie qu''Adonija a prononcé cette parole!
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን። አዶንያስ ይህን ቃል በሕይወቱ ላይ አለመናገሩ እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ያድርግብኝ፥ ይህንም ይጨምርብኝ።

verses.en: Now therefore, as the Lord liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
verses.fr: Maintenant, l''Eternel est vivant, lui qui m''a affermi et m''a fait asseoir sur le trône de David, mon père, et qui m''a fait une maison selon sa promesse! aujourd''hui Adonija mourra.
verses.am: አሁንም ያጸናኝ፥ በአባቴም በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ያስቀመጠኝ፥ እንደ ተናገረውም ቤትን የሠራልኝ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ዛሬ አዶንያስ ፈጽሞ ይገደላል ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር ማለ።

verses.en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
verses.fr: Et le roi Salomon envoya Benaja, fils de Jehojada, qui le frappa; et Adonija mourut.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን የዮዳሄን ልጅ በናያስን ላከ፤ እርሱም ወደቀበት፥ ሞተም።

verses.en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord God before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
verses.fr: Le roi dit ensuite au sacrificateur Abiathar: Va-t''en à Anathoth dans tes terres, car tu mérites la mort; mais je ne te ferai pas mourir aujourd''hui, parce que tu as porté l''arche du Seigneur l''Eternel devant David, mon père, et parce que tu as eu part à toutes les souffrances de mon père.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ካህኑን አብያታርን። አንተ ዛሬ የሞት ሰው ነበርህ፤ ነገር ግን የአምላክን የእግዚአብሔርን ታቦት በአባቴ በዳዊት ፊት ስለ ተሸከምህ፥ አባቴም የተቀበለውን መከራ ሁሉ አንተ ስለ ተቀበልህ አልገድልህምና በዓናቶት ወዳለው ወደ እርሻህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the Lord; that he might fulfil the word of the Lord, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.fr: Ainsi Salomon dépouilla Abiathar de ses fonctions de sacrificateur de l''Eternel, afin d''accomplir la parole que l''Eternel avait prononcée sur la maison d''Eli à Silo.
verses.am: በሴሎም በዔሊ ቤት ላይ የተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ ሰሎሞን አብያታርን ከእግዚአብሔር ክህነት አወጣው።

verses.en: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the Lord, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.fr: Le bruit en parvint à Joab, qui avait suivi le parti d''Adonija, quoiqu''il n''eût pas suivi le parti d''Absalom. Et Joab se réfugia vers la tente de l''Eternel, et saisit les cornes de l''autel.
verses.am: ለኢዮአብም ወሬ ደረሰለት፤ ኢዮአብም አቤሴሎምን አልተከተለም ነበር እንጂ አዶንያስን ተከትሎ ነበር። ኢዮአብም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ድንኳን ሸሽቶ የመሠዊያውን ቀንድ ያዘ።

verses.en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the Lord; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
verses.fr: On annonça au roi Salomon que Joab s''était réfugié vers la tente de l''Eternel, et qu''il était auprès de l''autel. Et Salomon envoya Benaja, fils de Jehojada, en lui disant: Va, frappe-le.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ኢዮአብ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ድንኳን ሸሽቶ መሠዊያውን እንደ ያዘ ሰማ፤ ሰሎሞንም የዮዳሄን ልጅ በናያስን፥ ሂድ ውደቅበት ብሎ አዘዘው።

verses.en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the Lord, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
verses.fr: Benaja arriva à la tente de l''Eternel, et dit à Joab: Sors! c''est le roi qui l''ordonne. Mais il répondit: Non! je veux mourir ici. Benaja rapporta la chose au roi, en disant: C''est ainsi qu''a parlé Joab, et c''est ainsi qu''il m''a répondu.
verses.am: በናያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ድንኳን መጥቶ። ንጉሡ። ውጣ ይልሃል አለው፤ እርሱም። በዚህ እሞታለሁ እንጂ አልወጣም አለ። በናያስም። ኢዮአብ የተናገረው ቃል የመለሰልኝም እንዲህ ነው ብሎ ወደ ንጉሡ ወሬ አመጣ።

verses.en: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
verses.fr: Le roi dit à Benaja: Fais comme il a dit, frappe-le, et enterre-le; tu ôteras ainsi de dessus moi et de dessus la maison de mon père le sang que Joab a répandu sans cause.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አለው። እንደ ነገረህ አድርግ፤ ኢዮአብም በከንቱ ያፈሰሰውን ደም ከእኔና ከአባቴ ቤት ታርቅ ዘንድ ገድለህ ቅበረው።

verses.en: And the Lord shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fera retomber son sang sur sa tête, parce qu''il a frappé deux hommes plus justes et meilleurs que lui et les a tués par l''épée, sans que mon père David le sût: Abner, fils de Ner, chef de l''armée d''Israël, et Amasa, fils de Jéther, chef de l''armée de Juda.
verses.am: አባቴ ዳዊት ሳያውቅ ከእርሱ የሚሻሉትን ሁለቱን ጻድቃን ሰዎች፥ የእስራኤልን ሠራዊት አለቃ የኔርን ልጅ አበኔርን፥ የይሁዳንም ሠራዊት አለቃ የዬቴርን ልጅ አሜሳይን፥ በሰይፍ ገድሎአልና እግዚአብሔር ደሙን በራሱ ላይ ይመልሰው።

verses.en: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the Lord.
verses.fr: Leur sang retombera sur la tête de Joab et sur la tête de ses descendants à perpétuité; mais il y aura paix à toujours, de par l''Eternel, pour David, pour sa postérité, pour sa maison et pour son trône.
verses.am: ደማቸውም በኢዮአብ ራስና በዘሩ ራስ ላይ ለዘላለም ይመለስ፤ ለዳዊት ግን ለዘሩና ለቤቱ ለዙፋኑም የእግዚአብሔር ሰላም ለዘላለም ይሁን።

verses.en: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Benaja, fils de Jehojada, monta, frappa Joab, et le fit mourir. Il fut enterré dans sa maison, au désert.
verses.am: የዮዳሄም ልጅ በናያስ ወጥቶ ወደቀበት ገደለውም፤ በምድረ በዳም ባለው በቤቱ ተቀበረ።

verses.en: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
verses.fr: Le roi mit à la tête de l''armée Benaja, fils de Jehojada, en remplacement de Joab, et il mit le sacrificateur Tsadok à la place d''Abiathar.
verses.am: ንጉሡም በእርሱ ፋንታ የዮዳሄን ልጅ በናያስን የሠራዊቱ አለቃ አደረገ፤ በአብያታርም ፋንታ ካህኑን ሳዶቅን አደረገ።

verses.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
verses.fr: Le roi fit appeler Schimeï, et lui dit: Bâtis-toi une maison à Jérusalem; tu y demeureras, et tu n''en sortiras point pour aller de côté ou d''autre.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ልኮ ሳሚን አስጠራውና። በኢየሩሳሌም ቤት ሠርተህ ተቀመጥ፥ ወዲህና ወዲያም አትውጣ።

verses.en: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
verses.fr: Sache bien que tu mourras le jour où tu sortiras et passeras le torrent de Cédron; ton sang sera sur ta tête.
verses.am: በወጣህበትም ቀን፥ የቄድሮንንም ፈፋ በተሻገርህበት ቀን ፈጽመህ እንድትሞት እወቅ፤ ደምህ በራስህ ላይ ይሆናል አለው።

verses.en: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.fr: Schimeï répondit au roi: C''est bien! ton serviteur fera ce que dit mon seigneur le roi. Et Schimeï demeura longtemps à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ሳሚም ንጉሡን። ነገሩ መልካም ነው፤ ጌታዬ ንጉሥ እንደ ተናገረ ባሪያህ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል አለው፤ ሳሚም በኢየሩሳሌም ብዙ ቀን ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.
verses.fr: Au bout de trois ans, il arriva que deux serviteurs de Schimeï s''enfuirent chez Akisch, fils de Maaca, roi de Gath. On le rapporta à Schimeï, en disant: Voici, tes serviteurs sont à Gath.
verses.am: ከሦስት ዓመትም በኋላ ከሳሚ ባሪያዎች ሁለቱ ወደ ጌት ንጉሥ ወደ መዓካ ልጅ ወደ አንኩስ ኰበለሉ፤ ሳሚንም። እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎችህ በጌት ናቸው ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.fr: Schimeï se leva, sella son âne, et s''en alla à Gath chez Akisch pour chercher ses serviteurs. Schimeï donc s''en alla, et il ramena de Gath ses serviteurs.
verses.am: ሳሚም ተነሣ፥ አህያውንም ጭኖ ባሪያዎቹን ይሻ ዘንድ ወደ ጌት ወደ አንኩስ ዘንድ ሄደ፤ ሳሚም ሄዶ ባሪያዎቹን ከጌት አመጣ።

verses.en: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
verses.fr: On informa Salomon que Schimeï était allé de Jérusalem à Gath, et qu''il était de retour.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ሳሚ ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ጌት ሄዶ እንደ ተመለሰ ሰማ።

verses.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the Lord, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
verses.fr: Le roi fit appeler Schimeï, et lui dit: Ne t''avais-je pas fait jurer par l''Eternel, et ne t''avais-je pas fait cette déclaration formelle: Sache bien que tu mourras le jour où tu sortiras pour aller de côté ou d''autre? Et ne m''as-tu pas répondu: C''est bien! j''ai entendu?
verses.am: ንጉሡም ልኮ ሳሚን አስጠራና። ወዲህና ወዲያ ለመሄድ በወጣህ ቀን ፈጽመህ እንድትሞት እወቅ ብዬ በእግዚአብሔር አላስማልሁህምን? ወይስ አላስመሰከርሁብህምን? አንተም። ቃሉ መልካም ነው፥ ሰምቻለሁ አልኸኝ።

verses.en: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the Lord, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
verses.fr: Pourquoi donc n''as-tu pas observé le serment de l''Eternel et l''ordre que je t''avais donné?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን መሐላ እኔስ ያዘዝሁህን ትእዛዝ ስለ ምን አልጠበቅህም? አለው።

verses.en: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the Lord shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
verses.fr: Et le roi dit à Schimeï: Tu sais au dedans de ton coeur tout le mal que tu as fait à David, mon père; l''Eternel fait retomber ta méchanceté sur ta tête.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ደግሞ ሳሚን። አንተ በአባቴ በዳዊት ላይ የሠራኸውን ልብህም ያሰበውን ክፋት ሁሉ ታውቃለህ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ክፋትህን በራስህ ላይ ይመልሳል።

verses.en: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord for ever.
verses.fr: Mais le roi Salomon sera béni, et le trône de David sera pour toujours affermi devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን ግን የተባረከ ይሆናል፥ የዳዊትም ዙፋን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለዘላለም ይጸናል አለው።

verses.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.fr: Et le roi donna ses ordres à Benaja, fils de Jehojada, qui sortit et frappa Schimeï; et Schimeï mourut. La royauté fut ainsi affermie entre les mains de Salomon.
verses.am: ንጉሡም የዮዳሄን ልጅ በናያስን አዘዘው፥ ወጥቶም ወደቀበት፥ ሞተም። መንግሥትም በሰሎሞን እጅ ጸና። a

verses.en: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the Lord, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
verses.fr: Salomon s''allia par mariage avec Pharaon, roi d''Egypte. Il prit pour femme la fille de Pharaon, et il l''amena dans la ville de David, jusqu''à ce qu''il eût achevé de bâtir sa maison, la maison de l''Eternel, et le mur d''enceinte de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ለግብጽ ንጉሥ ለፈርዖን አማች ሆነ፤ የፈርዖንን ልጅ አገባ፥ ቤቱንና የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት በኢየሩሳሌምም ዙሪያ ያለውን ቅጥር ሠርቶ እስኪፈጽም ድረስ ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ አመጣት።

verses.en: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the Lord, until those days.
verses.fr: Le peuple ne sacrifiait que sur les hauts lieux, car jusqu''à cette époque il n''avait point été bâti de maison au nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እስከዚያም ቀን ድረስ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም መቅደስ አልተሠራም ነበርና ሕዝቡ በኮረብታ ላይ ባሉት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋ ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
verses.fr: Salomon aimait l''Eternel, et suivait les coutumes de David, son père. Seulement c''était sur les hauts lieux qu''il offrait des sacrifices et des parfums.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም እግዚአብሔርን ይወድድ ነበር፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ሥርዓት ይሄድ ነበር፤ ብቻ በኮረብታ መስገጃ ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.en: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
verses.fr: Le roi se rendit à Gabaon pour y sacrifier, car c''était le principal des hauts lieux. Salomon offrit mille holocaustes sur l''autel.
verses.am: ገባዖን ዋና የኮረብታ መስገጃ ነበረችና ንጉሡ ይሠዋ ዘንድ ወደዚያ ሄደ፤ ሰሎሞንም በዚያ መሠዊያ ላይ አንድ ሺህ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አቀረበ።

verses.en: In Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.fr: A Gabaon, l''Eternel apparut en songe à Salomon pendant la nuit, et Dieu lui dit: Demande ce que tu veux que je te donne.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በገባዖን ለሰሎሞን በሌሊት በሕልም ተገለጠለት፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ምን እንድሰጥህ ለምን አለ።

verses.en: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
verses.fr: Salomon répondit: Tu as traité avec une grande bienveillance ton serviteur David, mon père, parce qu''il marchait en ta présence dans la fidélité, dans la justice, et dans la droiture de coeur envers toi; tu lui as conservé cette grande bienveillance, et tu lui as donné un fils qui est assis sur son trône, comme on le voit aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም አለ። እርሱ በፊትህ በእውነትና በጽድቅ በልብም ቅንነት ከአንተ ጋር እንደ ሄደ፥ ከባሪያህ ከአባቴ ከዳዊት ጋር ታላቅ ቸርነት አድርገሃል፤ ዛሬ እንደ ሆነም በዙፋኑ ላይ የሚቀመጥ ልጅ ሰጥተህ ታላቁን ቸርነትህን አቆይተህለታል።

verses.en: And now, O Lord my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
verses.fr: Maintenant, Eternel mon Dieu, tu as fait régner ton serviteur à la place de David, mon père; et moi je ne suis qu''un jeune homme, je n''ai point d''expérience.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እኔን ባሪያህን በአባቴ በዳዊት ፋንታ አንግሠኸኛል፤ እኔም መውጫንና መግቢያን የማላውቅ ታናሽ ብላቴና ነኝ።

verses.en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
verses.fr: Ton serviteur est au milieu du peuple que tu as choisi, peuple immense, qui ne peut être ni compté ni nombré, à cause de sa multitude.
verses.am: ባሪያህም ያለው አንተ በመረጥኸው ሕዝብህ ስለ ብዛቱም ይቈጠርና ይመጠን ዘንድ በማይቻል በታላቅ ሕዝብ መካከል ነው።

verses.en: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
verses.fr: Accorde donc à ton serviteur un coeur intelligent pour juger ton peuple, pour discerner le bien du mal! Car qui pourrait juger ton peuple, ce peuple si nombreux?
verses.am: ስለዚህም በሕዝብህ ላይ መፍረድ ይችል ዘንድ፥ መልካሙንና ክፉውንም ይለይ ዘንድ ለባሪያህ አስተዋይ ልቡና ስጠው፤ አለዚያማ በዚህ በታላቅ ሕዝብህ ላይ ይፈድ ዘንድ ማን ይችላል?

verses.en: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.fr: Cette demande de Salomon plut au Seigneur.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ይህን ነገር ስለ ለመነ፥ ነገሩ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ አሰኘው።

verses.en: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
verses.fr: Et Dieu lui dit: Puisque c''est là ce que tu demandes, puisque tu ne demandes pour toi ni une longue vie, ni les richesses, ni la mort de tes ennemis, et que tu demandes de l''intelligence pour exercer la justice,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። ፍርድን ትለይ ዘንድ ለራስህ ማስተዋልን ለመንህ እንጂ ለራስህ ብዙ ዘመናትን ባለጠግነትንም የጠላቶችህንም ነፍስ ሳትለምን ይህን ነገር ለምነሃልና እነሆ፥

verses.en: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
verses.fr: voici, j''agirai selon ta parole. Je te donnerai un coeur sage et intelligent, de telle sorte qu''il n''y aura eu personne avant toi et qu''on ne verra jamais personne de semblable à toi.
verses.am: እኔ እንደ ቃል አድርጌልሃለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ማንም የሚመስልህ ከአንተ በፊት እንደሌለ ከአንተም በኋላ እንዳይነሣ አድርጌ ጥበበኛና አስተዋይ ልቡና ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.en: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
verses.fr: Je te donnerai, en outre, ce que tu n''as pas demandé, des richesses et de la gloire, de telle sorte qu''il n''y aura pendant toute ta vie aucun roi qui soit ton pareil.
verses.am: ደግሞም ከነገሥታት የሚመስልህ ማንም እንዳይኖር ያልለመንኸውን ባለጠግነትና ክብር ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
verses.fr: Et si tu marches dans mes voies, en observant mes lois et mes commandements, comme l''a fait David, ton père, je prolongerai tes jours.
verses.am: አባትህም ዳዊት እንደ ሄደ፥ ሥርዓቴንና ትእዛዜን ትጠብቅ ዘንድ በመንገዴ የሄድህ እንደ ሆነ፥ ዕድሜህን አረዝመዋለሁ።

verses.en: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
verses.fr: Salomon s''éveilla. Et voilà le songe. Salomon revint à Jérusalem, et se présenta devant l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel. Il offrit des holocaustes et des sacrifices d''actions de grâces, et il fit un festin à tous ses serviteurs.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ነቃ፥ እነሆም፥ ሕልም ነበረ፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ፊት ቆመ፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አሳረገ፥ የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት አቀረበ፥ ለባሪያዎቹም ሁሉ ግብዣ አደረገ።

verses.en: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
verses.fr: Alors deux femmes prostituées vinrent chez le roi, et se présentèrent devant lui.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ሁለት ጋለሞቶች ሴቶች ወደ ንጉሡ መጥተው በፊቱ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
verses.fr: L''une des femmes dit: Pardon! mon seigneur, moi et cette femme nous demeurions dans la même maison, et je suis accouchée près d''elle dans la maison.
verses.am: አንደኛይቱም ሴት አለች። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ እኔና ይህች ሴት በአንድ ቤት እንኖራለን፤ እኔም ከእርስዋ ጋር በቤት ሳለሁ ወለድሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
verses.fr: Trois jours après, cette femme est aussi accouchée. Nous habitions ensemble, aucun étranger n''était avec nous dans la maison, il n''y avait que nous deux.
verses.am: እኔ ከወለድሁ ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ ይህች ሴት ደግሞ ወለደች፤ እኛ በቤት ውስጥ አብረን ነበርን፥ ከሁለታችንም በቀር ማንም በቤት ውስጥ አልነበረም።

verses.en: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
verses.fr: Le fils de cette femme est mort pendant la nuit, parce qu''elle s''était couchée sur lui.
verses.am: እርስዋም በላዩ ስለ ተኛችበት የዚህች ሴት ልጅ በሌሊት ሞተ።

verses.en: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.fr: Elle s''est levée au milieu de la nuit, elle a pris mon fils à mes côtés tandis que ta servante dormait, et elle l''a couché dans son sein; et son fils qui était mort, elle l''a couché dans mon sein.
verses.am: እርስዋም በእኩለ ሌሊት ተነሥታ፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ተኝቼ ሳለሁ፥ ልጄን ከአጠገቤ ወሰደች፥ በብብትዋም አደረገችው፥ የሞተውንም ልጅዋን በእኔ ብብት አደረገች።

verses.en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
verses.fr: Le matin, je me suis levée pour allaiter mon fils; et voici, il était mort. Je l''ai regardé attentivement le matin; et voici, ce n''était pas mon fils que j''avais enfanté.
verses.am: ልጄንም አጠባ ዘንድ በማለዳ ብነሣ፥ እነሆ፥ ሞቶ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ብርሃን በሆነ ጊዜ ተመለከትሁት፥ እነሆም፥ የወለድሁት ልጄ አልነበረም።

verses.en: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
verses.fr: L''autre femme dit: Au contraire! c''est mon fils qui est vivant, et c''est ton fils qui est mort. Mais la première répliqua: Nullement! C''est ton fils qui est mort, et c''est mon fils qui est vivant. C''est ainsi qu''elles parlèrent devant le roi.
verses.am: ሁለተኛይቱም ሴት። ደኅነኛው የኔ ልጅ ነው፥ የሞተውም የአንቺ ልጅ ነው እንጂ አንቺ እንደምትዪው አይደለም አለች። ይህችም። የሞተው የአንቺ ልጅ ነው፥ ደኅነኛውም የእኔ ልጅ ነው አለች፤ እንዲሁም በንጉሡ ፊት ይነጋገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.
verses.fr: Le roi dit: L''une dit: C''est mon fils qui est vivant, et c''est ton fils qui est mort; et l''autre dit: Nullement! c''est ton fils qui est mort, et c''est mon fils qui est vivant.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ንጉሡ። ይህች። ደኅነኛው የእኔ ልጅ ነው፥ የሞተውም የአንቺ ልጅ ነው ትላለች፤ ያችኛይቱም። አይደለም፥ የሞተው የአንቺ ልጅ ነው ደኅነኛውም የእኔ ልጅ ነው ትላለች አለ።

verses.en: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
verses.fr: Puis il ajouta: Apportez-moi une épée. On apporta une épée devant le roi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም። ሰይፍ አምጡልኝ አለ፤ ሰይፍም ይዘው ወደ ንጉሡ ፊት መጡ።

verses.en: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verses.fr: Et le roi dit: Coupez en deux l''enfant qui vit, et donnez-en la moitié à l''une et la moitié à l''autre.
verses.am: ንጉሡም። ደኅነኛውን ሕፃን ለሁለት ከፍላችሁ ለአንዲቱ አንዱን ክፍል፥ ለሁለተኛይቱም ሁለተኛውን ክፍል ስጡ አለ።

verses.en: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.
verses.fr: Alors la femme dont le fils était vivant sentit ses entrailles s''émouvoir pour son fils, et elle dit au roi: Ah! mon seigneur, donnez-lui l''enfant qui vit, et ne le faites point mourir. Mais l''autre dit: Il ne sera ni à moi ni à toi; coupez-le!
verses.am: ደኅነኛውም የነበራት ሴት አንጀትዋ ስለ ልጅዋ ናፍቆአልና። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ደኀነኛውን ለእርስዋ ስጣት እንጂ አትግደል ብላ ለንጉሡ ተናገረች። ያችኛይቱ ግን። ይከፈል እንጂ ለእኔም ለአንቺም አይሁን አለች።

verses.en: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
verses.fr: Et le roi, prenant la parole, dit: Donnez à la première l''enfant qui vit, et ne le faites point mourir. C''est elle qui est sa mère.
verses.am: ንጉሡም መልሶ። ይህችኛይቱ እናቱ ናትና ደኅነኛውን ሕፃን ለእርስዋ ስጡአት እንጂ አትግደሉት አለ።

verses.en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.
verses.fr: Tout Israël apprit le jugement que le roi avait prononcé. Et l''on craignit le roi, car on vit que la sagesse de Dieu était en lui pour le diriger dans ses jugements.
verses.am: ንጉሡም የፈረደውን ፍርድ እስራኤል ሁሉ ሰሙ፤ ፍርድን ለማድረግ የእግዚአብሔር ጥበብ እንደ ነበረበት አይተዋልና ንጉሡን ፈሩ።

verses.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon était roi sur tout Israël.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ ነግሦ ነበር።

verses.en: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
verses.fr: Voici les chefs qu''il avait à son service. Azaria, fils du sacrificateur Tsadok,
verses.am: የነበሩትም አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የሳዶቅ ልጅ ካህኑ ዓዛርያስ፥

verses.en: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
verses.fr: Elihoreph et Achija, fils de Schischa, étaient secrétaires; Josaphat, fils d''Achilud, était archiviste;
verses.am: ጸሐፊዎቹም የሴባ ልጆች ኤልያፍና አኪያ፥ ታሪክ ጸሐፊም የአሒሉድ ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ፥

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.fr: Benaja, fils de Jehojada, commandait l''armée; Tsadok et Abiathar étaient sacrificateurs;
verses.am: የዮዳሄም ልጅ በናያስ የሠራዊት አለቃ ነበረ፤ ሳዶቅና አብያታርም ካህናት ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:
verses.fr: Azaria, fils de Nathan, était chef des intendants; Zabud, fils de Nathan, était ministre d''état, favori du roi;
verses.am: የናታንም ልጅ ዓዛርያስ የሹሞች አለቃ ነበረ፤ የናታንም ልጅ ዛቡድ የንጉሡ አማካሪና ወዳጅ ነበረ፤

verses.en: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
verses.fr: Achischar était chef de la maison du roi; et Adoniram, fils d''Abda, était préposé sur les impôts.
verses.am: አሒሳርም የቤት አዛዥ፥ የዓብዳም ልጅ አዶኒራም አስገባሪ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
verses.fr: Salomon avait douze intendants sur tout Israël. Ils pourvoyaient à l''entretien du roi et de sa maison, chacun pendant un mois de l''année.
verses.am: ለንጉሡና ለቤተ ሰቡም ቀለብ የሚሰጡ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ አሥራ ሁለት ሹሞች ለሰሎሞን ነበሩት። ከዓመቱ ውስጥ አንዱን ወር እያንዳንዳቸው ይቀልቡ ነበር።

verses.en: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
verses.fr: Voici leurs noms. Le fils de Hur, dans la montagne d''Ephraïm.
verses.am: ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ በተራራማው አገር በኤፍሬም የሑር ልጅ፤

verses.en: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:
verses.fr: Le fils de Déker, à Makats, à Saalbim, à Beth-Schémesch, à Elon et à Beth-Hanan.
verses.am: በማቃጽና በሸዓልቢም በቤትሳሚስና በኤሎንቤትሐናን የዴቀር ልጅ፤

verses.en: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
verses.fr: Le fils de Hésed, à Arubboth; il avait Soco et tout le pays de Hépher.
verses.am: በአሩቦት የሔሴድ ልጅ፥ ለእርሱም ሰኰትና የኦፌር አገር ሁሉ ነበረ፤

verses.en: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.fr: Le fils d''Abinadab avait toute la contrée de Dor. Thaphath, fille de Salomon, était sa femme.
verses.am: በዶር አገር ዳርቻ ሁሉ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ፥ እርሱም የሰሎሞንን ልጅ ጣፈትን አግብቶ ነበር፤

verses.en: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
verses.fr: Baana, fils d''Achilud, avait Thaanac et Meguiddo, et tout Beth-Schean qui est près de Tsarthan au-dessous de Jizreel, depuis Beth-Schean jusqu''à Abel-Mehola, jusqu''au delà de Jokmeam.
verses.am: ከቤትሳን ጀምሮ እስከ አቤልምሖላና እስከ ዮቅምዓም ማዶ ድረስ በታዕናክና በመጊዶ በጸርታንም አጠገብ በኢይዝራኤል በታች ባለው በቤትሳን ሁሉ የአሒሉድ ልጅ በዓና ነበረ፤

verses.en: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
verses.fr: Le fils de Guéber, à Ramoth en Galaad; il avait les bourgs de Jaïr, fils de Manassé, en Galaad; il avait encore la contrée d''Argob en Basan, soixante grandes villes à murailles et à barres d''airain.
verses.am: በሬማት ዘገለዓድ የጌበር ልጅ ነበረ፥ ለእርሱም በገለዓድ ያሉት የምናሴ ልጅ የኢያዕር መንደሮች ነበሩ፤ ለእርሱም ደግሞ በባሳን በአርጎብ ዳርቻ ያሉት ቅጥርና የናስ መወረወሪያዎች የነበረባቸው ስድሳ ታላላቅ ከተሞች ነበሩበት፤

verses.en: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
verses.fr: Achinadab, fils d''Iddo, à Mahanaïm.
verses.am: በመሃናይም የዒዶ ልጅ አሒናዳብ፤

verses.en: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.fr: Achimaats, en Nephthali. Il avait pris pour femme Basmath, fille de Salomon.
verses.am: በንፍታሌም አኪማአስ ነበረ፥ እርሱም የሰሎሞንን ልጅ ባስማትን አግብቶ ነበር፤

verses.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
verses.fr: Baana, fils de Huschaï, en Aser et à Bealoth.
verses.am: በአሴርና በበዓሎት የኩሲ ልጅ በዓና፤

verses.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
verses.fr: Josaphat, fils de Paruach, en Issacar.
verses.am: በይሳኮር የፋሩዋ ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ፤

verses.en: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
verses.fr: Schimeï, fils d''Ela, en Benjamin.
verses.am: በብንያም የኤላ ልጅ ሳሚ፤

verses.en: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
verses.fr: Guéber, fils d''Uri, dans le pays de Galaad; il avait la contrée de Sihon, roi des Amoréens, et d''Og, roi de Basan. Il y avait un seul intendant pour ce pays.
verses.am: በአሞራውያን ንጉሥ በሴዎንና በባሳን ንጉሥ በዐግ አገር፥ በገለዓድ አገር፥ የኡሪ ልጅ ጌበር ነበረ፤ በዚያችም ምድር ላይ እርሱ ብቻውን ሹም ነበረ።

verses.en: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
verses.fr: Juda et Israël étaient très nombreux, pareils au sable qui est sur le bord de la mer. Ils mangeaient, buvaient et se réjouissaient.
verses.am: ይሁዳና እስራኤልም እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ ብዛት ብዙ ነበሩ፤ በልተውም ጠጥተውም ደስ ብሎአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.fr: Salomon dominait encore sur tous les royaumes depuis le fleuve jusqu''au pays des Philistins et jusqu''à la frontière d''Egypte; ils apportaient des présents, et ils furent assujettis à Salomon tout le temps de sa vie.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ከወንዙ ጀምሮ እስከ ግብጽ ዳርቻ እስከ ፍልስጥኤም ድረስ በመንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ነግሦ ነበር፤ ግብርም ያመጡለት ነበር፥ በዕድሜውም ሙሉ ለሰሎሞን ይገዙ ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
verses.fr: Chaque jour Salomon consommait en vivres: trente cors de fleur de farine et soixante cors de farine,
verses.am: ለሰሎሞንም ለቀን ለቀኑ ቀለብ የሚሆን ሠላሳ ኮር መልካም ዱቄትና ስድሳ ኮር መናኛ ድቄት፥

verses.en: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
verses.fr: dix boeufs gras, vingt boeufs de pâturage, et cent brebis, outre les cerfs, les gazelles, les daims, et les volailles engraissées.
verses.am: ከዋላና ከሚዳቋ ከበረሀ ፍየልና ከሰቡ ወፎች በቀር አሥር ፍሪዳዎች ሀያም የተሰማሩ በሬዎች አንድ መቶም በጎች ነበረ።

verses.en: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
verses.fr: Il dominait sur tout le pays de l''autre côté du fleuve, depuis Thiphsach jusqu''à Gaza, sur tous les rois de l''autre côté du fleuve. Et il avait la paix de tous les côtés alentour.
verses.am: ከወንዙ ወዲህ ባሉት ነገሥታት ሁሉ ከወንዙም ወዲህ ባለው አገር ሁሉ ላይ ከቲፍሳ ጀምሮ እስከ ጋዛ ድረስ ነግሦ ነበር፤ በዙሪያውም ባለው በሁሉ ወገን ሰላም ሆኖለት ነበር።

verses.en: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.fr: Juda et Israël, depuis Dan jusqu''à Beer-Schéba, habitèrent en sécurité, chacun sous sa vigne et sous son figuier, tout le temps de Salomon.
verses.am: በሰሎሞንም ዘመን ሁሉ ይሁዳና እስራኤል ከዳን ጀምሮ እስከ ቤርሳቤህ ድረስ እያንዳንዱ ከወይኑና ከበለሱ በታች ተዘልሎ ይቀመጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.fr: Salomon avait quarante mille crèches pour les chevaux destinés à ses chars, et douze mille cavaliers.
verses.am: ለሰሎሞንም በአርባ ሺህ ጋጥ የሚገቡ የሰረገላ ፈረሶች አሥራ ሁለትም ሺህ ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
verses.fr: Les intendants pourvoyaient à l''entretien du roi Salomon et de tous ceux qui s''approchaient de sa table, chacun pendant son mois; ils ne laissaient manquer de rien.
verses.am: እነዚያም ሹሞች እያንዳንዱ በየወሩ ንጉሡን ሰሎሞንንና ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሰሎሞን ማዕድ የሚቀርቡትን ሁሉ ይቀልቡ ነበር፤ ምንም አያጎድሉም ነበር።

verses.en: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
verses.fr: Ils faisaient aussi venir de l''orge et de la paille pour les chevaux et les coursiers dans le lieu où se trouvait le roi, chacun selon les ordres qu''il avait reçus.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም እንደ ደንቡ ለፈረሶቹና ለሰጋር በቅሎች ገብስና ጭድ ወደ ስፍራቸው ያመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
verses.fr: Dieu donna à Salomon de la sagesse, une très grande intelligence, et des connaissances multipliées comme le sable qui est au bord de la mer.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለሰሎሞን እጅግ ብዙ ጥበብና ማስተዋል በባሕርም ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ የልብ ስፋት ሰጠው።

verses.en: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.fr: La sagesse de Salomon surpassait la sagesse de tous les fils de l''Orient et toute la sagesse des Egyptiens.
verses.am: የሰሎሞንም ጥበብ በምሥራቅ ካሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ጥበብና ከግብጽ ጥበብ ሁሉ በለጠ።

verses.en: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
verses.fr: Il était plus sage qu''aucun homme, plus qu''Ethan, l''Ezrachite, plus qu''Héman, Calcol et Darda, les fils de Machol; et sa renommée était répandue parmi toutes les nations d''alentour.
verses.am: ከሰውም ሁሉ ይልቅ ከኢይዝራኤላዊው ከኤታንና ከማሖል ልጆች ከሄማንና ከከልቀድ ከደራልም ይልቅ ጥበበኛ ነበረ። በዙሪያውም ባሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ዝናው ወጣ።

verses.en: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.fr: Il a prononcé trois mille sentences, et composé mille cinq cantiques.
verses.am: እርሱም ሦስት ሺህ ምሳሌዎች ተናገረ፤ መኃልዩም ሺህ አምስት ነበረ።

verses.en: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verses.fr: Il a parlé sur les arbres, depuis le cèdre du Liban jusqu''à l''hysope qui sort de la muraille; il a aussi parlé sur les animaux, sur les oiseaux, sur les reptiles et sur les poissons.
verses.am: ስለ ዛፍም ከሊባኖስ ዝግባ ጀምሮ በቅጥር ግንብ ላይ እስከሚበቅለው እስከ ሂሶጵ ድረስ ይናገር ነበር፤ ደግሞም ስለ አውሬዎችና ስለ ወፎች ሰለተንቀሳቃሾችና ስለ ዓሣዎች ይናገር ነበር።

verses.en: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
verses.fr: Il venait des gens de tous les peuples pour entendre la sagesse de Salomon, de la part de tous les rois de la terre qui avaient entendu parler de sa sagesse.
verses.am: ከአሕዛብም ሁሉ፥ ጥበቡንም ሰምተው ከነበሩ ከምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ ለመስማት ሰዎች ይመጡ ነበር። a

verses.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
verses.fr: Hiram, roi de Tyr, envoya ses serviteurs vers Salomon, car il apprit qu''on l''avait oint pour roi à la place de son père, et il avait toujours aimé David.
verses.am: የጢሮስ ንጉሥ ኪራም ለዳዊት በዘመኑ ሁሉ ወዳጅ ስለ ነበረ፥ ሰሎሞን በአባቱ ፋንታ ንጉሥ ለመሆን እንደ ተቀባ ሰምቶ ባሪያዎቹን ወደ ሰሎሞን ሰደደ።

verses.en: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.fr: Salomon fit dire à Hiram:
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ወደ ኪራም እንዲህ ብሎ ላከ።

verses.en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the Lord his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the Lord put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.fr: Tu sais que David, mon père, n''a pas pu bâtir une maison à l''Eternel, son Dieu, à cause des guerres dont ses ennemis l''ont enveloppé jusqu''à ce que l''Eternel les eût mis sous la plante de ses pieds.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከእግሩ በታች እስኪጥልለት ድረስ በዙሪያው ስለ ነበረ ሰልፍ አባቴ ዳዊት የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሥራት እንዳልቻለ አንተ ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: But now the Lord my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
verses.fr: Maintenant l''Eternel, mon Dieu, m''a donné du repos de toutes parts; plus d''adversaires, plus de calamités!
verses.am: አሁንም አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር በዙሪያዬ ካሉት ዕረፍት ሰጥቶኛል፤ ጠላትም ክፉም ነገር የለብኝም።

verses.en: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God, as the Lord spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.
verses.fr: Voici, j''ai l''intention de bâtir une maison au nom de l''Eternel, mon Dieu, comme l''Eternel l''a déclaré à David, mon père, en disant: Ton fils que je mettrai à ta place sur ton trône, ce sera lui qui bâtira une maison à mon nom.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር ለአባቴ ለዳዊት። በአንተ ፋንታ በዙፋንህ ላይ የማስቀምጠው ልጅህ እርሱ ለስሜ ቤት ይሠራል ብሎ እንደ ነገረው፥ ለአምላኬ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት እሠራ ዘንድ አስባለሁ።

verses.en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
verses.fr: Ordonne maintenant que l''on coupe pour moi des cèdres du Liban. Mes serviteurs seront avec les tiens, et je te paierai le salaire de tes serviteurs tel que tu l''auras fixé; car tu sais qu''il n''y a personne parmi nous qui s''entende à couper les bois comme les Sidoniens.
verses.am: አሁንም ከወገኔ እንደ ሲዶናውያን እንጨት መቈረጥ የሚያውቅ እንደሌለ ታውቃለህና የዝግባ ዛፍ ከሊባኖስ ይቈርጡልኝ ዘንድ ባሪያዎችህን እዘዝ፤ ባሪያዎቼም ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር ይሁኑ፤ የባሪያዎችህንም ዋጋ እንደ ተናገርኸው ሁሉ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the Lord this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il entendit les paroles de Salomon, Hiram eut une grande joie, et il dit: Béni soit aujourd''hui l''Eternel, qui a donné à David un fils sage pour chef de ce grand peuple!
verses.am: ኪራምም የሰሎሞንን ቃል ሰምቶ እጅግ ደስ አለውና። በዚህ በታላቅ ሕዝብ ላይ ጥበበኛ ልጅ ለዳዊት የሰጠ እግዚአብሔር ዛሬ ይመስገን አለ።

verses.en: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
verses.fr: Et Hiram fit répondre à Salomon: J''ai entendu ce que tu m''as envoyé dire. Je ferai tout ce qui te plaira au sujet des bois de cèdre et des bois de cyprès.
verses.am: ኪራምም። የላክህብኝን ሁሉ ሰማሁ፤ ስለ ዝግባውና ስለ ጥዱ እንጨት ፈቃድህን ሁሉ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
verses.fr: Mes serviteurs les descendront du Liban à la mer, et je les expédierai par mer en radeaux jusqu''au lieu que tu m''indiqueras; là, je les ferai délier, et tu les prendras. Ce que je désire en retour, c''est que tu fournisses des vivres à ma maison.
verses.am: ባሪያዎቼ ከሊባኖስ ወደ ባሕር ይጐትቱታል፤ እኔም በታንኳ አድርጌ በባሕር ላይ እያንሳፈፍሁ አንተ እስከ ወሰንኸው ስፍራ ድረስ አደርስልሃለሁ፥ በዚያም እፈታዋለሁ፥ አንተም ከዚያ ታስወስደዋለህ፤ አንተም ፈቃዴን ታደርጋለህ፤ ለቤቴም ቀለብ የሚሆነውን ትሰጠኛለህ ብሎ ወደ ሰሎሞን ላከ።

verses.en: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
verses.fr: Hiram donna à Salomon des bois de cèdre et des bois de cyprès autant qu''il en voulut.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ኪራም የዝግባውንና የጥዱን እንጨት እንደሚሻው ያህል ሁሉ ለሰሎሞን ይሰጠው ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
verses.fr: Et Salomon donna à Hiram vingt mille cors de froment pour l''entretien de sa maison et vingt cors d''huile d''olives concassées; c''est ce que Salomon donna chaque année à Hiram.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ለኪራም ስለ ቤቱ ቀለብ ሀያ ሺ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ስንዴ ሀያ ኮርም ጥሩ ዘይት ይሰጠው ነበር፤ ሰሎሞንም ለኪራም በየዓመቱ ይህን ይሰጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
verses.fr: L''Eternel donna de la sagesse à Salomon, comme il le lui avait promis. Et il y eut paix entre Hiram et Salomon, et ils firent alliance ensemble.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ነገረው ለሰሎሞን ጥበብን ሰጠው፤ በኪራምና በሰሎሞንም መካከል ሰላም ነበረ፤ ሁለቱም ቃል ኪዳን ተጋቡ።

verses.en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon leva sur tout Israël des hommes de corvée; ils étaient au nombre de trente mille.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ገባሮቹን መርጦ አወጣ፤ የገባሮቹም ቍጥር ሠላሳ ሺህ ሰዎች ነበረ።

verses.en: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
verses.fr: Il les envoya au Liban, dix mille par mois alternativement; ils étaient un mois au Liban, et deux mois chez eux. Adoniram était préposé sur les hommes de corvée.
verses.am: በየወሩም እያከታተለ ወደ ሊባኖስ አሥር አሥር ሺህ ይሰድድ ነበር፤ አንድ ወርም በሊባኖስ ሁለት ወርም በቤታቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር። አዶኒራምም አስገባሪ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
verses.fr: Salomon avait encore soixante-dix mille hommes qui portaient les fardeaux et quatre-vingt mille qui taillaient les pierres dans la montagne,
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ሰባ ሺህ ተሸካሚዎች፥ ሰማንያ ሺህም በተራራው ላይ የሚጠርቡ ጠራቢዎች ነበሩት።

verses.en: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.fr: sans compter les chefs, au nombre de trois mille trois cents, préposés par Salomon sur les travaux et chargés de surveiller les ouvriers.
verses.am: ይኸውም በሠራተኛው ሕዝብ ላይ ከተሾሙት ከሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ሰዎች ሌላ ነው።

verses.en: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
verses.fr: Le roi ordonna d''extraire de grandes et magnifiques pierres de taille pour les fondements de la maison.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ታላላቅ ምርጥ ምርጥ ድንጋዮችን ይቈፍሩና ይጠርቡ ዘንድ ለቤቱም መሠረት ይረበርቡት ዘንድ አዘዘ።

verses.en: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
verses.fr: Les ouvriers de Salomon, ceux de Hiram, et les Guibliens, les taillèrent, et ils préparèrent les bois et les pierres pour bâtir la maison.
verses.am: የሰሎሞንና የኪራምም አናጢዎች ጌባላውያንም ወቀሩአቸው፥ ቤቱንም ለመሥራት እንጨቱንና ድንጋዮቹን አዘጋጁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ce fut la quatre cent quatre-vingtième année après la sortie des enfants d''Israël du pays d''Egypte que Salomon bâtit la maison à l''Eternel, la quatrième année de son règne sur Israël, au mois de Ziv, qui est le second mois.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር ከወጡ አራት መቶ ሰማንያ ዓመት በሆነ ጊዜ፥ ሰሎሞን በእስራኤል ላይ በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት፥ ዚፍ በሚባለው በሁለተኛው ወር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሥራት ጀመረ።

verses.en: And the house which king Solomon built for the Lord, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
verses.fr: La maison que le roi Salomon bâtit à l''Eternel avait soixante coudées de longueur, vingt de largeur, et trente de hauteur.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር የሠራው ቤት ርዝመቱ ስድሳ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም ሠላሳ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
verses.fr: Le portique devant le temple de la maison avait vingt coudées de longueur répondant à la largeur de la maison, et dix coudées de profondeur sur la face de la maison.
verses.am: በመቅደሱም ፊት ወለል ነበረ፤ ርዝመቱም እንደ መቅደሱ ወርድ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ከቤቱ ወደፊት አሥር ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
verses.fr: Le roi fit à la maison des fenêtres solidement grillées.
verses.am: ለቤቱም በዓይነ ርግብ የተዘጉ መስኮቶች አደረገ።

verses.en: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
verses.fr: Il bâtit contre le mur de la maison des étages circulaires, qui entouraient les murs de la maison, le temple et le sanctuaire; et il fit des chambres latérales tout autour.
verses.am: በቤቱም ግንብ ዙሪያ፥ በመቅደሱና በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ ግንብ ዙሪያ፥ ደርብ ሠራ፥ በዙሪያውም ጓዳዎች አደረገ።

verses.en: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
verses.fr: L''étage inférieur était large de cinq coudées, celui du milieu de six coudées, et le troisième de sept coudées; car il ménagea des retraites à la maison tout autour en dehors, afin que la charpente n''entrât pas dans les murs de la maison.
verses.am: የታችኛውም ደርብ ወርዱ አምስት ክንድ፥ የመካከለኛው ደርብ ወርዱ ስድስት ክንድ፥ የሦስተኛውም ደርብ ወርዱ ሰባት ክንድ ነበረ። ሰረገሎቹ በቤቱ ግንብ ውስጥ እንዳይገቡ ከቤቱ ግንብ ውጭ ዓረፍቶች አደረገ።

verses.en: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''on bâtit la maison, on se servit de pierres toutes taillées, et ni marteau, ni hache, ni aucun instrument de fer, ne furent entendus dans la maison pendant qu''on la construisait.
verses.am: ቤቱም በተሠራ ጊዜ ፈጽመው በተወቀሩ ድንጋዮች ተሠራ፤ በተሠራም ጊዜ መራጃና መጥረቢያ የብረትም ዕቃ ሁሉ በቤቱ ውስጥ አልተሰማም።

verses.en: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
verses.fr: L''entrée des chambres de l''étage inférieur était au côté droit de la maison; on montait à l''étage du milieu par un escalier tournant, et de l''étage du milieu au troisième.
verses.am: የታችኛውም ደርብ ጓዳዎች በር በቤቱ ቀኝ አጠገብ ነበረ። ከዚያም ወደ መካከለኛው ደርብ፥ ከመካከለኛውም ወደ ሦስተኛው ደርብ በመውጫ ያስወጣ ነበር።

verses.en: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
verses.fr: Après avoir achevé de bâtir la maison, Salomon la couvrit de planches et de poutres de cèdre.
verses.am: ቤቱንም ሠርቶ ፈጸመው፤ በዝግባው ሰረገሎችና ሳንቃዎች ከደነው።

verses.en: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
verses.fr: Il donna cinq coudées de hauteur à chacun des étages qui entouraient toute la maison, et il les lia à la maison par des bois de cèdre.
verses.am: በቤቱም ሁሉ ዙሪያ ቁመታቸው አምስት አምስት ክንድ የሆነ ደርቦች ሠራ፤ ከቤቱም ጋር በዝግባ እንጨት አጋጠማቸው።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel adressa la parole à Salomon, et lui dit:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ሰሎሞን መጣ እንዲህ ሲል።

verses.en: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
verses.fr: Tu bâtis cette maison! Si tu marches selon mes lois, si tu pratiques mes ordonnances, si tu observes et suis tous mes commandements, j''accomplirai à ton égard la promesse que j''ai faite à David, ton père,
verses.am: ስለዚህ ስለምትሠራው ቤት በሥርዓቴ ብትሄድ፥ ፍርዴንም ብታደርግ፥ ትመላለስበትም ዘንድ ትእዛዜን ሁሉ ብትጠብቅ፥ ለአባትህ ለዳዊት የነገርሁትን ቃል ከአንተ ጋር አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
verses.fr: j''habiterai au milieu des enfants d''Israël, et je n''abandonnerai point mon peuple d''Israël.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል እኖራለሁ፥ ሕዝቤንም እስራኤልን አልጥልም።

verses.en: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
verses.fr: Après avoir achevé de bâtir la maison,
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ቤቱን ሠራው፥ ፈጸመውም።

verses.en: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
verses.fr: Salomon en revêtit intérieurement les murs de planches de cèdre, depuis le sol jusqu''au plafond; il revêtit ainsi de bois l''intérieur, et il couvrit le sol de la maison de planches de cyprès.
verses.am: የቤቱንም ግንብ ውስጡን በዝግባ ሳንቃ ለበጠ፤ ከቤቱም መሠረት ጀምሮ እስከ ጣራው ድረስ ውስጡን በእንጨት ለበጠው፤ ደግሞም የቤቱን ወለል በጥድ እንጨት ከደነው።

verses.en: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
verses.fr: Il revêtit de planches de cèdre les vingt coudées du fond de la maison, depuis le sol jusqu''au haut des murs, et il réserva cet espace pour en faire le sanctuaire, le lieu très saint.
