verses.am: በቤቱ ውስጥ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ይሆን ዘንድ ኋለኛውን ሀያውን ክንድ በዝግባ እንጨት ጋረደው።

verses.en: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
verses.fr: Les quarante coudées sur le devant formaient la maison, c''est-à-dire le temple.
verses.am: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ ፊት ያለውም መቅደስ ርዝመቱ አርባ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
verses.fr: Le bois de cèdre à l''intérieur de la maison offrait des sculptures de coloquintes et de fleurs épanouies; tout était de cèdre, on ne voyait aucune pierre.
verses.am: የቤቱንም ውስጥ በተጐበጐበና በፈነዳ አበባ በተቀረጸ ዝግባ ለበጠው፤ ሁሉም ዝግባ ነበረ፤ ድንጋዩም አልታየም ነበር።

verses.en: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.fr: Salomon établit le sanctuaire intérieurement au milieu de la maison, pour y placer l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ያኖር ዘንድ በቤቱ ውስጥ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑን አበጀ።

verses.en: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
verses.fr: Le sanctuaire avait vingt coudées de longueur, vingt coudées de largeur, et vingt coudées de hauteur. Salomon le couvrit d''or pur. Il fit devant le sanctuaire un autel de bois de cèdre et le couvrit d''or.
verses.am: የቅድስተ ቅዱሳንም ርዝመት ሀያ ክንድ፥ ስፋቱም ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ በጥሩ ወርቅም ለበጠው።

verses.en: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.fr: Il couvrit d''or pur l''intérieur de la maison, et il fit passer le voile dans des chaînettes d''or devant le sanctuaire, qu''il couvrit d''or.
verses.am: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ፊት ከዝግባ የተሠራ መሠዊያ አደረገ፤ በጥሩ ወርቅም ለበጠው።

verses.en: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
verses.fr: Il couvrit d''or toute la maison, la maison tout entière, et il couvrit d''or tout l''autel qui était devant le sanctuaire.
verses.am: ቤቱንም ሁሉ ፈጽሞ በወርቅ ለበጠው፤ በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ፊት የነበረውን መሠዊያ ሁሉ በወርቅ ለበጠው።

verses.en: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
verses.fr: Il fit dans le sanctuaire deux chérubins de bois d''olivier sauvage, ayant dix coudées de hauteur.
verses.am: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ውስጥ ቁመታቸው አሥር ክንድ የሆነ ከወይራ እንጨት ሁለት ኪሩቤል ሠራ።

verses.en: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
verses.fr: Chacune des deux ailes de l''un des chérubins avait cinq coudées, ce qui faisait dix coudées de l''extrémité d''une de ses ailes à l''extrémité de l''autre.
verses.am: የኪሩብም አንደኛው ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ፥ የኪሩብም ሁለተኛው ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፤ ከአንደኛው ክንፍ ጫፍ ጀምሮ እስክ ሁለተኛው ክንፍ ጫፍ ድረስ አሥር ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
verses.fr: Le second chérubin avait aussi dix coudées. La mesure et la forme étaient les mêmes pour les deux chérubins.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውም ኪሩብ አሥር ክንድ ነበረ፤ ሁለቱም ኪሩቤል አንድ ልክና አንድ መልክ ነበረ።

verses.en: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
verses.fr: La hauteur de chacun des deux chérubins était de dix coudées.
verses.am: የአንዱ ኪሩብ ቁመት አሥር ክንድ ነበረ፥ የሁለተኛውም ኪሩብ እንዲሁ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
verses.fr: Salomon plaça les chérubins au milieu de la maison, dans l''intérieur. Leurs ailes étaient déployées: l''aile du premier touchait à l''un des murs, et l''aile du second touchait à l''autre mur; et leurs autres ailes se rencontraient par l''extrémité au milieu de la maison.
verses.am: ኪሩቤልንም በውስጠኛው ቤት አኖራቸው፤ የኪሩቤልም ክንፎቻቸው ተዘርግተው ነበር፤ የአንዱም ኪሩብ ክንፍ አንደኛውን ግንብ ይነካ ነበር፥ የሁለተኛውም ኪሩብ ክንፍ ሁለተኛውን ግንብ ይነካ ነበር፤ የሁለቱም ክንፎች በቤቱ መካከል እርስ በርሳቸው ይነካኩ ነበር።

verses.en: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
verses.fr: Salomon couvrit d''or les chérubins.
verses.am: ኪሩቤልንም በወርቅ ለበጣቸው።

verses.en: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
verses.fr: Il fit sculpter sur tout le pourtour des murs de la maison, à l''intérieur et à l''extérieur, des chérubins, des palmes et des fleurs épanouies.
verses.am: በቤቱም ግንብ ሁሉ ዙሪያ በውስጥና በውጭ የኪሩቤልና የዘንባባ ዛፍ የፈነዳም አበባ ምስል ቀረጸ።

verses.en: And the floors of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
verses.fr: Il couvrit d''or le sol de la maison, à l''intérieur et à l''extérieur.
verses.am: የቤቱንም ወለል በውስጥና በውጭ በወርቅ ለበጠ።

verses.en: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
verses.fr: Il fit à l''entrée du sanctuaire une porte à deux battants, de bois d''olivier sauvage; l''encadrement avec les poteaux équivalait à un cinquième du mur.
verses.am: ለቅዱስተ ቅዱሳኑም መግቢያ ከወይራ እንጨት ደጆች ሠራ፤ መድረኩንና መቃኖቹን ደፉንም አምስት ማዕዘን አደረገ።

verses.en: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
verses.fr: Les deux battants étaient de bois d''olivier sauvage. Il y fit sculpter des chérubins, des palmes et des fleurs épanouies, et il les couvrit d''or; il étendit aussi l''or sur les chérubins et sur les palmes.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ደጆች ከወይራ እንጨት ሠራ፤ የኪሩቤልንና የዘንባባ ዛፍ የፈነዳም አበባ ምስል ቀረጸባቸው፥ በወርቅም ለበጣቸው፤ ኪሩቤልናና የዘንባባውን ዛፍ በወርቅ ለበጣቸው።

verses.en: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
verses.fr: Il fit de même, pour la porte du temple, des poteaux de bois d''olivier sauvage, ayant le quart de la dimension du mur,
verses.am: እንዲሁም ለመቅደሱ መግቢያ ከወይራ እንጨት አራት ማዕዘን መቃን አደረገ።

verses.en: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
verses.fr: et deux battants de bois de cyprès; chacun des battants était formé de deux planches brisées.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ደጆች ከጥድ እንጨት ሠራ፤ አንዱ ደጅ በማጠፊያ ከተያያዘ ከሁለት ሳንቃ ተደረገ፥ ሁለተኛውም ደጅ በማጠፊያ ከተያያዘ ከሁለት ሳንቃ ተደረገ።

verses.en: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
verses.fr: Il y fit sculpter des chérubins, des palmes et des fleurs épanouies, et il les couvrit d''or, qu''il étendit sur la sculpture.
verses.am: የኪሩቤልንና የዘንባባ ዛፍ የፈነዳም አበባ ምስል ቀረጸባቸው፤ በተቀረጸውም ሥራ ላይ በወርቅ ለበጣቸው።

verses.en: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
verses.fr: Il bâtit le parvis intérieur de trois rangées de pierres de taille et d''une rangée de poutres de cèdre.
verses.am: የውስጠኛውንም አደባባይ ቅጥር ሦስቱን ተራ በተጠረበ ድንጋይ፥ አንዱንም ተራ በዝግባ ሳንቃ ሠራው።

verses.en: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the Lord laid, in the month Zif:
verses.fr: La quatrième année, au mois de Ziv, les fondements de la maison de l''Eternel furent posés;
verses.am: በአራተኛው ዓመት ዚፍ በሚባል ወር የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተመሠረተ።

verses.en: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
verses.fr: et la onzième année, au mois de Bul, qui est le huitième mois, la maison fut achevée dans toutes ses parties et telle qu''elle devait être. Salomon la construisit dans l''espace de sept ans.
verses.am: በአሥራ አንደኛውም ዓመት ቡል በሚባል በስምንተኛው ወር ቤቱ እንደ ክፍሎቹና እንደ ሥርዓቱ ሁሉ ተጨረሰ። በሰባትም ዓመት ውስጥ ሠራው። a

verses.en: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.fr: Salomon bâtit encore sa maison, ce qui dura treize ans jusqu''à ce qu''il l''eût entièrement achevée.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የራሱን ቤት በአሥራ ሦስት ዓመት ሠራ፥ የቤቱንም ሥራ ሁሉ ጨረሰ።

verses.en: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.fr: Il construisit d''abord la maison de la forêt du Liban, longue de cent coudées, large de cinquante coudées, et haute de trente coudées. Elle reposait sur quatre rangées de colonnes de cèdre, et il y avait des poutres de cèdre sur les colonnes.
verses.am: የሊባኖስ ዱር ቤት የሚባል ቤትን ሠራ፤ ርዝመቱንም መቶ ክንድ፥ ስፋቱንም አምሳ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱንም ሠላሳ ክንድ አደረገ፤ የዝግባም እንጨት በሦስት ተራ በተሠሩ አዕማድ ላይ ቆሞ ነበር፤ በአዕማዱም ላይ የዝግባ እንጨት አግዳሚ ሰረገሎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
verses.fr: On couvrit de cèdre les chambres qui portaient sur les colonnes et qui étaient au nombre de quarante-cinq, quinze par étage.
verses.am: በአዕማዱም ላይ በነበሩ አግዳሚዎች ቤቱ በዝግባ ሳንቃ ተሸፍኖ ነበር፤ አዕማዱም በአንዱ ተራ አሥራ አምስት፥ በአንዱ ተራ አሥራ አምስት እየሆኑ አርባ አምስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.fr: Il y avait trois étages, à chacun desquels se trouvaient des fenêtres les unes vis-à-vis des autres.
verses.am: መስኮቶቹም በሦስት ተራ ነበሩ፥ መስኮቶቹም ፊት ለፊት ይተያዩ ነበር።

verses.en: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.fr: Toutes les portes et tous les poteaux étaient formés de poutres en carré; et, à chacun des trois étages, les ouvertures étaient les unes vis-à-vis des autres.
verses.am: ደጆቹና መስኮቶቹም ሁሉ አራት ማዕዘን ነበሩ፤ መስኮቶቹም በሦስት ተራ ሆነው ፊት ለፊት ይተያዩ ነበር።

verses.en: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
verses.fr: Il fit le portique des colonnes, long de cinquante coudées et large de trente coudées, et un autre portique en avant avec des colonnes et des degrés sur leur front.
verses.am: አዕማዱም ያሉበቱን ቤት ሠራ፤ ርዝመቱም አምሳ ክንድ፥ ስፋቱም ሠላሳ ክንድ ነበረ፤ በእርሱም ፊት ደግሞ አዕማድና መድረክ ያሉበት ወለል ነበረ።

verses.en: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
verses.fr: Il fit le portique du trône, où il rendait la justice, le portique du jugement; et il le couvrit de cèdre, depuis le sol jusqu''au plafond.
verses.am: ደግሞም የሚፈርድበት ዙፋን ያለበትን የፍርድ ቤት አደረገ። ከወለሉም አንሥቶ እስከ ጣራው ድረስ በዝግባ እንጨት ተሸፍኖ ነበር።

verses.en: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
verses.fr: Sa maison d''habitation fut construite de la même manière, dans une autre cour, derrière le portique. Et il fit une maison du même genre que ce portique pour la fille de Pharaon, qu''il avait prise pour femme.
verses.am: ከፍርድ ሰቀላ ወደ ውስጥ፥ በሌላውም አደባባይ ውስጥ የነበረውን መኖሪያ ቤት እንዲሁ ሠራ። እንደዚሁም ያለ ቤት ሰሎሞን ላገባት ለፈርዖን ልጅ ቤት ሠራ።

verses.en: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
verses.fr: Pour toutes ces constructions on employa de magnifiques pierres, taillées d''après des mesures, sciées avec la scie, intérieurement et extérieurement, et cela depuis les fondements jusqu''aux corniches, et en dehors jusqu''à la grande cour.
verses.am: እነዚህም ሁሉ ከመሠረቱ ጀምሮ እስከ ጕልላቱ ድረስ በጥሩ በተጠረበና በውስጥና በውጭ በልክ በተከረከመ ድንጋይ ተሠርተው ነበር፤ በውጭውም እስከ ታላቁ አደባባይ ድረስ እንዲሁ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.fr: Les fondements étaient en pierres magnifiques et de grande dimension, en pierres de dix coudées et en pierres de huit coudées.
verses.am: መሠረቱም አሥር ወይም ስምንት ክንድ በሆነ በጥሩና በታላቅ ድንጋይ ተሠርቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
verses.fr: Au-dessus il y avait encore de magnifiques pierres, taillées d''après des mesures, et du bois de cèdre.
verses.am: በላዩም ልክ ሆኖ የተከረከመ ጥሩ ድንጋይና የዝግባ ሳንቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the Lord, and for the porch of the house.
verses.fr: La grande cour avait dans tout son circuit trois rangées de pierres de taille et une rangée de poutres de cèdre, comme le parvis intérieur de la maison de l''Eternel, et comme le portique de la maison.
verses.am: በታላቁም አደባባይ ዙሪያ የነበረው ቅጥር እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ውስጠኛው አደባባይ ቅጥርና እንደ ቤቱ ወለል ሦስቱ ተራ በተጠረበ ድንጋይ አንዱም ተራ በዝግባ ሳንቃ ተሠርቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon fit venir de Tyr Hiram,
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ልኮ ኪራምን ከጢሮስ አስመጣ።

verses.en: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
verses.fr: fils d''une veuve de la tribu de Nephthali, et d''un père Tyrien, qui travaillait sur l''airain. Hiram était rempli de sagesse, d''intelligence, et de savoir pour faire toutes sortes d''ouvrages d''airain. Il arriva auprès du roi Salomon, et il exécuta tous ses ouvrages.
verses.am: እርሱም ከንፍታሌም ወገን የነበረች የባል አልባ ሴት ልጅ ነበረ፥ አባቱም የጢሮስ ሰው ናስ ሠራተኛ ነበረ፤ የናስንም ሥራ ሁሉ ይሠራ ዘንድ በጥበብና በማስተዋል በብልሃትም ተሞልቶ ነበር። ወደ ንጉሡም ወደ ሰሎሞን መጥቶ ሥራውን ሁሉ ሠራ።

verses.en: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
verses.fr: Il fit les deux colonnes d''airain. La première avait dix-huit coudées de hauteur, et un fil de douze coudées mesurait la circonférence de la seconde.
verses.am: ሁለቱን የናስ አዕማድ አደረገ፤ የአንዱም ዓምድ ቁመት አሥራ ስምንት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የዙሪያውም መጠን አሥራ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ፤ የዓምዱም ውፍረት አንድ ጋት ነበረ፥ ውስጠ ክፍትም ነበረ። ሁለተኛውም ዓምድ እንዲሁ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
verses.fr: Il fondit deux chapiteaux d''airain, pour mettre sur les sommets des colonnes; le premier avait cinq coudées de hauteur, et le second avait cinq coudées de hauteur.
verses.am: በሁለቱም አዕማድ ራስ ላይ እንዲቀመጡ ከፈሰሰ ናስ ሁለት ጕልላት ሠራ፤ የአንዱም ጕልላት ቁመት አምስት ክንድ፥ የሁለተኛውም ጕልላት ቁመት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
verses.fr: Il fit des treillis en forme de réseaux, des festons façonnés en chaînettes, pour les chapiteaux qui étaient sur le sommet des colonnes, sept pour le premier chapiteau, et sept pour le second chapiteau.
verses.am: በአዕማዱም ራስ ላይ የነበሩትን ጕልላቶች ይሸፍኑ ዘንድ ሁለት እንደ መርበብ ሥራ አደረገ፤ አንዱም መርበብ ለአንዱ ጕልላት ሁለተኛውም መርበብ ለሁለተኛው ጕልላት ነበረ።

verses.en: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
verses.fr: Il fit deux rangs de grenades autour de l''un des treillis, pour couvrir le chapiteau qui était sur le sommet d''une des colonnes; il fit de même pour le second chapiteau.
verses.am: ሮማኖችንም ሠራ፤ በአንድ ጕልላት ዙሪያ በተራ ሁለት መቶ ሮማኖች ነበሩ፥ በአንድም መርበብ ላይ ሁለት ተራ ነበረ፤ እንዲሁም ለሁለተኛው ጕልላት አደረገ።

verses.en: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
verses.fr: Les chapiteaux qui étaient sur le sommet des colonnes, dans le portique, figuraient des lis et avaient quatre coudées.
verses.am: በወለሉም አዕማድ በነበሩት ጕልላቶች ላይ የሱፍ አበባ የሚመስል ሥራ አራት ክንድ አድርጎ ቀረጸ።

verses.en: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
verses.fr: Les chapiteaux placés sur les deux colonnes étaient entourés de deux cents grenades, en haut, près du renflement qui était au delà du treillis; il y avait aussi deux cents grenades rangées autour du second chapiteau.
verses.am: በሁለቱም አዕማድ በነበሩት ጕልላቶች ላይ በመርበቡ ሥራ አጠገብ ሮማኖቹን አደረገ።

verses.en: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
verses.fr: Il dressa les colonnes dans le portique du temple; il dressa la colonne de droite, et la nomma Jakin; puis il dressa la colonne de gauche, et la nomma Boaz.
verses.am: አዕማዱንም በመቅደሱ ወለል አጠገብ አቆማቸው፤ የቀኙንም ዓምድ አቁሞ ያቁም ብሎ ጠራው፤ የግራውንም ዓምድ አቁሞ በለዝ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.fr: Il y avait sur le sommet des colonnes un travail figurant des lis. Ainsi fut achevé l''ouvrage des colonnes.
verses.am: በአዕማዱም ራስ ላይ የሱፍ አበባ የሚመስል ሥራ ነበረ፤ እንዲሁም የአዕማዱ ሥራ ተጨረሰ።

verses.en: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.fr: Il fit la mer de fonte. Elle avait dix coudées d''un bord à l''autre, une forme entièrement ronde, cinq coudées de hauteur, et une circonférence que mesurait un cordon de trente coudées.
verses.am: ከፈሰሰም ናስ ከዳር እስከ ዳር አሥር ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም አምስት ክንድ፥ በዙሪያውም ሠላሳ ክንድ የሆነ ክብ ኵሬ ሠራ።

verses.en: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
verses.fr: Des coloquintes l''entouraient au-dessous de son bord, dix par coudée, faisant tout le tour de la mer; les coloquintes, disposées sur deux rangs, étaient fondues avec elle en une seule pièce.
verses.am: ከከንፈሩም በታች ለአንድ ክንድ አሥር ለአንድ ክንድም አሥር ጉብጉቦች አዞረበት፤ እርሱም በቀለጠ ጊዜ ጉብጉቦቹ በሁለት ተራ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ቀልጠው ነበር።

verses.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.fr: Elle était posée sur douze boeufs, dont trois tournés vers le nord, trois tournés vers l''occident, trois tournés vers le midi, et trois tournés vers l''orient; la mer était sur eux, et toute la partie postérieure de leur corps était en dedans.
verses.am: ኵሬውም በአሥራ ሁለት በሬዎች ምስል ላይ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ ከእነርሱም ሦስቱ ወደ ሰሜን፥ ሦስቱም ወደ ምዕራብ፥ ሦስቱም ወደ ደቡብ፥ ሦስቱም ወደ ምሥራቅ ይመለከቱ ነበር። ኵሬውም በላያቸው ነበረ፥ የሁሉም ጀርባቸው በስተ ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
verses.fr: Son épaisseur était d''un palme; et son bord, semblable au bord d''une coupe, était façonné en fleur de lis. Elle contenait deux mille baths.
verses.am: ውፍረቱም አንድ ጋት ነበረ፤ ከንፈሩም እንደ ጽዋ ከንፈር ተሠርቶ ነበር፤ እንደ ሱፍ አበባዎች ሆኖ ተከርክሞ ነበር። ሁለት ሺህም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ይይዝ ነበር።

verses.en: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.fr: Il fit les dix bases d''airain. Chacune avait quatre coudées de longueur, quatre coudées de largeur, et trois coudées de hauteur.
verses.am: አሥርም የናስ መቀመጫዎች ሠራ፤ የአንዱም መቀመጫ ርዝመት አራት ክንድ፥ ወርዱም አራት ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም ሦስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
verses.fr: Voici en quoi consistaient ces bases. Elles étaient formées de panneaux, liés aux coins par des montants.
verses.am: የመቀመጫውም ሥራ እንዲህ ነበረ፤ በክፈፎችም መካከል ያለው ሰንበር ይመስል ነበር።

verses.en: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
verses.fr: Sur les panneaux qui étaient entre les montants il y avait des lions, des boeufs et des chérubins; et sur les montants, au-dessus comme au-dessous des lions et des boeufs, il y avait des ornements qui pendaient en festons.
verses.am: በክፈፎቹም መካከል በነበሩ ሰንበሮች ላይ አንበሳዎችና በሬዎች ኪሩቤልም ነበሩ፤ እንዲሁም በክፈፎቹ ላይ ነበረ፤ ከአንበሳዎቹና ከበሬዎቹ በታች ሻኵራ የሚመስል ተንጠልጥሎ ነበር።

verses.en: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
verses.fr: Chaque base avait quatre roues d''airain avec des essieux d''airain; et aux quatre angles étaient des consoles de fonte, au-dessous du bassin, et au delà des festons.
verses.am: በየመቀመጫዎቹም ሁሉ አራት የናስ መንኰራኵሮች ነበሩባቸ፤ መንኰራኵሮቹም የሚዞሩበትን የናስ ወስከምት ሠራ፤ ከመታጠቢያውም ሰን በታች በአራቱ ማዕዘን በኩል አራት በምስል የፈሰሱ እግሮች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
verses.fr: Le couronnement de la base offrait à son intérieur une ouverture avec un prolongement d''une coudée vers le haut; cette ouverture était ronde, comme pour les ouvrages de ce genre, et elle avait une coudée et demie de largeur; il s''y trouvait aussi des sculptures. Les panneaux étaient carrés, et non arrondis.
verses.am: በክፈፉም ውስጥ የነበረ አንገት አንድ ክንድ ነበረ፤ አንገቱም ድቡልቡል ነበረ፥ ቁመቱም ክንድ ተኩል ነበረ። በአንገቱም ላይ ቅርጽ ነበረበት፤ ክፈፉ ግን አራት ማዕዘን ነበረ እንጂ ድቡልቡል አልነበረም።

verses.en: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
verses.fr: Les quatre roues étaient sous les panneaux, et les essieux des roues fixés à la base; chacune avait une coudée et demie de hauteur.
verses.am: አራቱም መንኰራኵሮች ከሰንበሮቹ በታች ነበሩ፤ የመንኰራኵሮቹም ወስከምት በመቀመጫው ውስጥ ነበረ፤ የመንኰራኵሩም ቁመት ክንድ ተኩል ነበረ።

verses.en: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
verses.fr: Les roues étaient faites comme celles d''un char. Leurs essieux, leurs jantes, leurs rais et leurs moyeux, tout était de fonte.
verses.am: የመንኰራኵሮቹም ሥራ እንደ ሰረገላ መንኰራኵር ነበረ፥ ወስከምቶቹና የመንኰራኵሮቹ ክፈፍ ቅትርቶቹም ወስከምቱም የሚገባበት ቧምቧ ሁሉ በምስል የፈሰሰ ነበር።

verses.en: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
verses.fr: Il y avait aux quatre angles de chaque base quatre consoles d''une même pièce que la base.
verses.am: በእያንዳንዱም መቀመጫ በአራቱ ማዕዘን በኩል አራት ደገፋዎች ነበሩ፤ ደገፋዎቹም ከመቀመጫው ጋር ተገጥመው ነበር።

verses.en: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
verses.fr: La partie supérieure de la base se terminait par un cercle d''une demi-coudée de hauteur, et elle avait ses appuis et ses panneaux de la même pièce.
verses.am: በመቀመጫውም ላይ ስንዝር የሚሆን ድቡልቡል ነገር ነበረ፤ በመቀመጫውም ላይ የነበሩ መያዣዎችና ሰንበሮች ከእርሱ ጋር ይጋጠሙ ነበር።

verses.en: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
verses.fr: Il grava sur les plaques des appuis, et sur les panneaux, des chérubins, des lions et des palmes, selon les espaces libres, et des guirlandes tout autour.
verses.am: በመያዣውና በሰንበሮቹ ላይ ኪሩቤልንና አንበሳዎችን የዘንባባውንም ዛፍ እንደ መጠናችው ቀረጸ፥ በዙሪያውም ሻኵራ አደረገ።

verses.en: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi qu''il fit les dix bases: la fonte, la mesure et la forme étaient les mêmes pour toutes.
verses.am: እንዲሁ አሥሩን መቀመጫዎች ሠራ፤ ሁሉም በምስልና በመጠን በንድፍም ትክክሎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
verses.fr: Il fit dix bassins d''airain. Chaque bassin contenait quarante baths, chaque bassin avait quatre coudées, chaque bassin était sur l''une des dix bases.
verses.am: አሥሩንም የናስ መታጠቢያ ሰን ሠራ፤ አንዱ መታጠቢያ ሰን አርባ የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ያነሣ ነበር፤ እያንዳንዱም መታጠቢያ ሰን አራት ክንድ ነበረ፤ በአሥሩም መቀመጫዎች ላይ በእያንዳንዱ አንድ አንድ መታጠቢያ ሰን ይቀመጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
verses.fr: Il plaça cinq bases sur le côté droit de la maison, et cinq bases sur le côté gauche de la maison; et il plaça la mer du côté droit de la maison, au sud-est.
verses.am: አምስቱንም መቀመጫዎች በቤቱ ቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በቤቱ ግራ አኖራቸው፤ ኵሬውንም በቤቱ ቀኝ በአዜብ በኩል አኖረው።

verses.en: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the Lord:
verses.fr: Hiram fit les cendriers, les pelles et les coupes. Ainsi Hiram acheva tout l''ouvrage que le roi Salomon lui fit faire pour la maison de l''Eternel;
verses.am: ኪራምም ምንችቶችንና መጫሪያዎችን ድስቶችንም ሠራ፤ ኪራምም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራውን ሥራ ሁሉ ጨረሰ።

verses.en: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;
verses.fr: deux colonnes, avec les deux chapiteaux et leurs bourrelets sur le sommet des colonnes; les deux treillis, pour couvrir les deux bourrelets des chapiteaux sur le sommet des colonnes;
verses.am: ሁለቱም አዕማድ፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ኩብ የሚመስሉትን ጕልላቶች፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለቱን ጕልላቶች የሚሸፍኑትን ሁለቱን መርበቦች፥

verses.en: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;
verses.fr: les quatre cents grenades pour les deux treillis, deux rangées de grenades par treillis, pour couvrir les deux bourrelets des chapiteaux sur le sommet des colonnes;
verses.am: በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለቱን ጕልላቶች ይሸፍኑ ዘንድ ለእያንዳንዱ መርበብ በሁለት በሁለት ተራ አድርጎ ለሁለቱ መርበቦች አራት መቶ ሮማኖች አደረገ።

verses.en: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
verses.fr: les dix bases, et les dix bassins sur les bases;
verses.am: አሥሩንም መቀመጫዎች፥ በመቀመጫዎችም ላይ የሚቀመጡትን አሥሩን መታጠቢያ ሰን፥

verses.en: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
verses.fr: la mer, et les douze boeufs sous la mer;
verses.am: አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ ከኵሬውም በታች የሚሆኑትን አሥራ ሁለቱን በሬዎች፥

verses.en: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the Lord, were of bright brass.
verses.fr: les cendriers, les pelles et les coupes. Tous ces ustensiles que le roi Salomon fit faire à Hiram pour la maison de l''Eternel étaient d''airain poli.
verses.am: ምንቸቶቹንም፥ መጫሪያዎቹንም፥ ድስቶቹንም አደረገ። ኪራምም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራው ይህ ዕቃ ሁሉ የጋለ ናስ ነበረ።

verses.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
verses.fr: Le roi les fit fondre dans la plaine du Jourdain dans un sol argileux, entre Succoth et Tsarthan.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ሜዳ በሱኮትና በጸርታን መካከል ባለው በወፍራሙ መሬት ውስጥ አስፈሰሰው።

verses.en: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
verses.fr: Salomon laissa tous ces ustensiles sans vérifier le poids de l''airain, parce qu''ils étaient en très grande quantité.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ዕቃውን ሁሉ ሳያስመዝን አኖረ፤ የናሱም ሚዛን ከብዛቱ የተነሣ አይቈጠርም ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the Lord: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,
verses.fr: Salomon fit encore tous les autres ustensiles pour la maison de l''Eternel: l''autel d''or; la table d''or, sur laquelle on mettait les pains de proposition;
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አሠራ፤ የወርቁን መሠዊያ፥ የገጹም ኅብስት የነበረበትን የወርቅ ገበታ፥

verses.en: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,
verses.fr: les chandeliers d''or pur, cinq à droite et cinq à gauche, devant le sanctuaire, avec les fleurs, les lampes et les mouchettes d''or;
verses.am: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ ፊት አምስቱ በቀኝ አምስቱም በግራ የሚቀመጡትን ከጥሩ ወርቅ የተሠሩትንም መቅረዞች፥ የወርቁንም አበባዎችና ቀንዲሎች መኰስተሪያዎችም፥

verses.en: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
verses.fr: les bassins, les couteaux, les coupes, les tasses et les brasiers d''or pur; et les gonds d''or pour la porte de l''intérieur de la maison à l''entrée du lieu très saint, et pour la porte de la maison à l''entrée du temple.
verses.am: ከጥሩ ወርቅም የተሠሩትን ጽዋዎችና ጕጠቶች፥ ድስቶቹንና ጭልፋዎቹንም፥ ማንደጃዎቹንም፥ ለውስጠኛውም ቤት ለቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ደጆች ለቤተ መቅደሱም ደጆች የሚሆኑትን የወርቅ ማጠፊያዎች አሠራ።

verses.en: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the Lord. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ainsi fut achevé tout l''ouvrage que le roi Salomon fit pour la maison de l''Eternel. Puis il apporta l''argent, l''or et les ustensiles, que David, son père, avait consacrés, et il les mit dans les trésors de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ያሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ተፈጸመ። አባቱም ዳዊት የቀደሰውን፥ ብርና ወርቅ ዕቃም፥ ሰሎሞን አገባ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ውስጥ በነበሩ ግምጃ ቤቶች አኖረው።

verses.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.fr: Alors le roi Salomon assembla près de lui à Jérusalem les anciens d''Israël et tous les chefs des tribus, les chefs de famille des enfants d''Israël, pour transporter de la cité de David, qui est Sion, l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ከዳዊት ከተማ ከጽዮን ያወጡ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ሽማግሌዎችና የነገድ አለቆችን ሁሉ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች የአባቶቻቸውን ቤቶች መሳፍንት፥ ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን ወዳለበት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰበሰባቸው።

verses.en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
verses.fr: Tous les hommes d''Israël se réunirent auprès du roi Salomon, au mois d''Ethanim, qui est le septième mois, pendant la fête.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ኤታኒም በሚባል በሰባተኛው ወር በበዓሉ ጊዜ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሰሎሞን ተከማቹ።

verses.en: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.fr: Lorsque tous les anciens d''Israël furent arrivés, les sacrificateurs portèrent l''arche.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ መጡ፤ ካህናቱም ታቦቱን አነሡ።

verses.en: And they brought up the ark of the Lord, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.fr: Ils transportèrent l''arche de l''Eternel, la tente d''assignation, et tous les ustensiles sacrés qui étaient dans la tente: ce furent les sacrificateurs et les Lévites qui les transportèrent.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ታቦት፥ የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን፥ በድንኳኑም ውስጥ የነበረውን የተቀደሰውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አመጡ፤ እነዚህንም ሁሉ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ አመጡ።

verses.en: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon et toute l''assemblée d''Israël convoquée auprès de lui se tinrent devant l''arche. Ils sacrifièrent des brebis et des boeufs, qui ne purent être ni comptés, ni nombrés, à cause de leur multitude.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከእርሱም ጋር የተሰበሰቡ የእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር በታቦቱ ፊት ሆነው፥ ከብዛታቸው የተነሣ የማይቈጠሩትንና የማይመጠኑትን በጎችና በሬዎች ይሠዉ ነበር።

verses.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs portèrent l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel à sa place, dans le sanctuaire de la maison, dans le lieu très saint, sous les ailes des chérubins.
verses.am: ካህናቱም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት በቤቱ በቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ውስጥ ከኪሩቤል ክንፍ በታች ወደ ነበረው ወደ ስፍራው አመጡት።

verses.en: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.fr: Car les chérubins avaient les ailes étendues sur la place de l''arche, et ils couvraient l''arche et ses barres par-dessus.
verses.am: ኪሩቤልም በታቦቱ ስፍራ ላይ ክንፎቻቸውን ዘርግተው ነበር፤ ኪሩቤልም ታቦቱንና መሎጊያዎቹን በስተ ላይ በኩል ሸፍነው ነበር።

verses.en: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
verses.fr: On avait donné aux barres une longueur telle que leurs extrémités se voyaient du lieu saint devant le sanctuaire, mais ne se voyaient point du dehors. Elles ont été là jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: መሎጊያዎቹም ረጃጅሞች ነበሩ፤ በቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ፊት ከመቅደሱ ውስጥ ጫፎቻቸው ይታዩ ነበር፤ በውጭ ያለ ግን አያያቸውም ነበር፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በዚያ አሉ።

verses.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the Lord made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Il n''y avait dans l''arche que les deux tables de pierre, que Moïse y déposa en Horeb, lorsque l''Eternel fit alliance avec les enfants d''Israël, à leur sortie du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: በታቦቱም ውስጥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር በወጡ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ባደረገ ጊዜ፥ ሙሴ በኮሬብ ካስቀመጣቸው ከሁለቱ የድንጋይ ጽላቶች በቀር ምንም አልነበረበትም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the Lord,
verses.fr: Au moment où les sacrificateurs sortirent du lieu saint, la nuée remplit la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህናቱም ከመቅደሱ በመጡ ጊዜ ደመናው የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞላው።

verses.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord had filled the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs ne purent pas y rester pour faire le service, à cause de la nuée; car la gloire de l''Eternel remplissait la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶ ነበርና ካህናቱ ከደመናው የተነሣ ለማገልገል ይቆሙ ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.en: Then spake Solomon, The Lord said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.fr: Alors Salomon dit: L''Eternel veut habiter dans l''obscurité!
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም። እግዚአብሔር። በጨለማው ውስጥ እኖራለሁ ብሎአል፤

verses.en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
verses.fr: J''ai bâti une maison qui sera ta demeure, un lieu où tu résideras éternellement!
verses.am: እኔም ለዘላለም የምትኖርበት ማደሪያ ቤት በእውነት ሠራሁልህ አለ።

verses.en: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
verses.fr: Le roi tourna son visage, et bénit toute l''assemblée d''Israël; et toute l''assemblée d''Israël était debout.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ፊቱን ዘወር አድርጎ የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ መረቀ፤ የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
verses.fr: Et il dit: Béni soit l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, qui a parlé de sa bouche à David, mon père, et qui accomplit par sa puissance ce qu''il avait déclaré en disant:
verses.am: አባቴም ዳዊት ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ በልቡ አሰበ።

verses.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
verses.fr: Depuis le jour où j''ai fait sortir d''Egypte mon peuple d''Israël, je n''ai point choisi de ville parmi toutes les tribus d''Israël pour qu''il y fût bâti une maison où résidât mon nom, mais j''ai choisi David pour qu''il régnât sur mon peuple d''Israël!
verses.am: አባቴም ዳዊት ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ በልቡ አሰበ።

verses.en: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: David, mon père, avait l''intention de bâtir une maison au nom de l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አባቴን ዳዊትን። ለስሜ ቤት ትሠራ ዘንድ በልብህ አስበሃልና ይህን በልብህ ማሰብህ መልካም አደረግህ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à David, mon père: Puisque tu as eu l''intention de bâtir une maison à mon nom, tu as bien fait d''avoir eu cette intention.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከወገብህ የሚወጣው ልጅህ እርሱ ለስሜ ቤት ይሠራል እንጂ ቤት የምትሠራልኝ አንተ አይደለህም አለው።

verses.en: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
verses.fr: Seulement, ce ne sera pas toi qui bâtiras la maison; mais ce sera ton fils, sorti de tes entrailles, qui bâtira la maison à mon nom.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የተናገረውን ቃል አጸና፤ እግዚአብሔርም ተስፋ እንደ ሰጠ በአባቴ በዳዊት ፋንታ ተነሣሁ፥ በእስራኤልም ዙፋን ላይ ተቀመጥሁ፥ ለእስራኤልም አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ሠራሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and have built an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a accompli la parole qu''il avait prononcée. Je me suis élevé à la place de David, mon père, et je me suis assis sur le trône d''Israël, comme l''avait annoncé l''Eternel, et j''ai bâti la maison au nom de l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ከግብጽም ምድር ባወጣቸው ጊዜ ከአባቶቻችን ጋር ያደረገው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ላለበት ታቦት ስፍራ በዚያ አደረግሁለት።

verses.en: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the Lord, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: J''y ai disposé un lieu pour l''arche où est l''alliance de l''Eternel, l''alliance qu''il a faite avec nos pères quand il les fit sortir du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ እያዩ ሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ፊት ቆሞ እጆቹን ወደ ሰማይ ዘረጋ።

verses.en: And Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
verses.fr: Salomon se plaça devant l''autel de l''Eternel, en face de toute l''assemblée d''Israël. Il étendit ses mains vers le ciel,
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። የእስራኤል አምላክ አቤቱ፥ በላይ በሰማይ በታችም በምድር አንተን የሚመስል አምላክ የለም፤ በፍጹም ልባቸው በፊትህ ለሚሄዱ ባሪያዎችህ ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ፥

verses.en: And he said, Lord God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:
verses.fr: et il dit: O Eternel, Dieu d''Israël! Il n''y a point de Dieu semblable à toi, ni en haut dans les cieux, ni en bas sur la terre: tu gardes l''alliance et la miséricorde envers tes serviteurs qui marchent en ta présence de tout leur coeur!
verses.am: ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የሰጠኸውን ተስፋ የጠበቅህ፤ በአፍህ ተናገርህ፥ እንደ ዛሬው ቀንም በእጅህ ፈጸምኸው።

verses.en: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
verses.fr: Ainsi tu as tenu parole à ton serviteur David, mon père; et ce que tu as déclaré de ta bouche, tu l''accomplis en ce jour par ta puissance.
verses.am: አሁንም የእስራኤል አምላክ አቤቱ። አንተ በፊቴ እንደ ሄድህ ልጆችህ መንገዳቸውን ቢጠብቁ፥ በእስራኤል ዙፋን የሚቀመጥ ሰው በፊቴ አታጣም ብለህ ተስፋ የሰጠኸውን ለአባቴ ለዳዊት ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Therefore now, Lord God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.
verses.fr: Maintenant, Eternel, Dieu d''Israël, observe la promesse que tu as faite à David, mon père, en disant: Tu ne manqueras jamais devant moi d''un successeur assis sur le trône d''Israël, pourvu que tes fils prennent garde à leur voie et qu''ils marchent en ma présence comme tu as marché en ma présence.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የተናገርኸው ቃል፥ እባክህ፥ ይጽና።

verses.en: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
verses.fr: Oh! qu''elle s''accomplisse, Dieu d''Israël, la promesse que tu as faite à ton serviteur David, mon père!
verses.am: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ከሰው ጋር በምድር ላይ ይኖራልን? እነሆ፥ ሰማይ ከሰማያትም በላይ ያለው ሰማይ ይይዝህ ዘንድ አይችልም፤ ይልቁንስ እኔ የሠራሁት ቤት እንዴት ያንስ!

verses.en: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
verses.fr: Mais quoi! Dieu habiterait-il véritablement sur la terre? Voici, les cieux et les cieux des cieux ne peuvent te contenir: combien moins cette maison que je t''ai bâtie!
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ወደ ባሪያህ ጸሎትና ልመና ተመልከት፥ ዛሬም ባሪያህ በፊትህ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎትና ጥሪውን ስማ፤

verses.en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Lord my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
verses.fr: Toutefois, Eternel, mon Dieu, sois attentif à la prière de ton serviteur et à sa supplication; écoute le cri et la prière que t''adresse aujourd''hui ton serviteur.
verses.am: ባሪያህ ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎት ትሰማ ዘንድ። በዚያ ስሜ ይሆናል ወዳልኸው ስፍራ ወደዚህ ቤት ዓይኖችህ ሌሊትና ቀን የተገለጡ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.
verses.fr: Que tes yeux soient nuit et jour ouverts sur cette maison, sur le lieu dont tu as dit: Là sera mon nom! Ecoute la prière que ton serviteur fait en ce lieu.
verses.am: ባሪያህና ሕዝብህ እስራኤል ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልዩትን ልመና ስማ፤ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ ሰምተህም ይቅር በል።

verses.en: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.fr: Daigne exaucer la supplication de ton serviteur et de ton peuple d''Israël, lorsqu''ils prieront en ce lieu! Exauce du lieu de ta demeure, des cieux, exauce et pardonne!
verses.am: ሰው ባልንጀራውን ቢበድል፥ በላዩም መሐላ ቢጫን፥ እርሱም መጥቶ በዚህ ቤት በመሠዊያህ ፊት ቢምል፥

verses.en: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un pèche contre son prochain et qu''on lui impose un serment pour le faire jurer, et s''il vient jurer devant ton autel, dans cette maison, -
verses.am: በሰማይ ስማ አድርግም፤ በባሪያዎችህም ላይ ዳኛ ሁን፤ በበደለኛውም ላይ ፍረድ፥ መንገዱንም በራሱ ላይ መልስበት፤ ንጹሑን አጽድቀው፥ እንደ ጽድቁም ክፈለው።

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
verses.fr: coute-le des cieux, agis, et juge tes serviteurs; condamne le coupable, et fais retomber sa conduite sur sa tête; rends justice à l''innocent, et traite-le selon son innocence!
verses.am: ሕዝብህ እስራኤል አንተን ስለ በደሉ በጠላቶቻቸው ፊት ድል በተመቱ ጊዜ፥ ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ በዚህም ቤት ቢጸልዩና ቢለምኑህ፥

verses.en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:
verses.fr: Quand ton peuple d''Israël sera battu par l''ennemi, pour avoir péché contre toi; s''ils reviennent à toi et rendent gloire à ton nom, s''ils t''adressent des prières et des supplications dans cette maison, -
verses.am: አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፤ የሕዝብህንም የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፥ ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጠሃት ምድር መልሳቸው።

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.
verses.fr: exauce-les des cieux, pardonne le péché de ton peuple d''Israël, et ramène-les dans le pays que tu as donné à leurs pères!
verses.am: አንተን ስለ በደሉ ሰማይ በተዘጋ ጊዜ ዝናብም ባልዘነበ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚህ ስፍራ ቢጸልዩ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ ባስጨነቅሃቸውም ጊዜ ከኃጢአታቸው ቢመለሱ፥ አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፤

verses.en: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
verses.fr: Quand le ciel sera fermé et qu''il n''y aura point de pluie, à cause de leurs péchés contre toi, s''ils prient dans ce lieu et rendent gloire à ton nom, et s''ils se détournent de leurs péchés, parce que tu les auras châtiés, -
verses.am: የሚሄዱበትንም መልካም መንገድ በማሳየት የባሪያዎችህንና የሕዝብህን የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፤ ለሕዝብህም ርስት አድርገህ ለሰጠሃት ምድር ዝናብ ስጥ።

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
verses.fr: exauce-les des cieux, pardonne le péché de tes serviteurs et de ton peuple d''Israël, à qui tu enseigneras la bonne voie dans laquelle ils doivent marcher, et fais venir la pluie sur la terre que tu as donnée en héritage à ton peuple!
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ራብ፥ ወይም ቸነፈር፥ ወይም ዋግ፥ ወይም አረማሞ፥ ወይም አንበጣ፥ ወይም ኩብኩባ ቢሆን፥ የሕዝብህም ጠላት የአገሩን ቀበሌዎች ከብቦ ቢያስጨንቃቸው፥ መቅሠፍትና ደዌ ሁሉ ቢሆን፥

verses.en: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
verses.fr: Quand la famine, la peste, la rouille, la nielle, les sauterelles d''une espèce ou d''une autre, seront dans le pays, quand l''ennemi assiégera ton peuple dans son pays, dans ses portes, quand il y aura des fléaux ou des maladies quelconques;
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው የልቡን ሕመም አውቆ ጸሎትና ልመና ቢጸልይ፥ እጆቹንም ወደዚህ ቤት ቢዘረጋ፥

verses.en: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
verses.fr: si un homme, si tout ton peuple d''Israël fait entendre des prières et des supplications, et que chacun reconnaisse la plaie de son coeur et étende les mains vers cette maison, -
verses.am: አንተ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ስምህን ያውቁ ዘንድ እንደ ሕዝብህም እንደ እስራኤል ይፈሩህ ዘንድ፥ በዚህም በሠራሁት ቤት ስምህ እንደተጠራ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንግዳው የሚለምንህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)
verses.fr: exauce-le des cieux, du lieu de ta demeure, et pardonne; agis, et rends à chacun selon ses voies, toi qui connais le coeur de chacun, car seul tu connais le coeur de tous les enfants des hommes,
verses.am: አንተ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ስምህን ያውቁ ዘንድ እንደ ሕዝብህም እንደ እስራኤል ይፈሩህ ዘንድ፥ በዚህም በሠራሁት ቤት ስምህ እንደተጠራ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንግዳው የሚለምንህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.en: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.fr: et ils te craindront tout le temps qu''ils vivront dans le pays que tu as donné à nos pères!
verses.am: አንተ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ስምህን ያውቁ ዘንድ እንደ ሕዝብህም እንደ እስራኤል ይፈሩህ ዘንድ፥ በዚህም በሠራሁት ቤት ስምህ እንደተጠራ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንግዳው የሚለምንህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.en: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;
verses.fr: Quand l''étranger, qui n''est pas de ton peuple d''Israël, viendra d''un pays lointain, à cause de ton nom,
verses.am: ሕዝብህም ጠላቶቻቸውን ለመውጋት አንተ በምትልካቸው መንገድ ቢወጡ፥ አንተም ወደ መረጥሃት ከተማ እኔም ለስምህ ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ለእግዚአብሔር ቢጸልዩ፥

verses.en: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
verses.fr: car on saura que ton nom est grand, ta main forte, et ton bras étendu, quand il viendra prier dans cette maison, -
verses.am: ጸሎታቸውንና ልመናቸውን በሰማይ ስማ፥ ፍርድንም አድርግላቸው።

verses.en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.
verses.fr: exauce-le des cieux, du lieu de ta demeure, et accorde à cet étranger tout ce qu''il te demandera, afin que tous les peuples de la terre connaissent ton nom pour te craindre, comme ton peuple d''Israël, et sachent que ton nom est invoqué sur cette maison que j''ai bâtie!
verses.am: የማይበድልም ሰው የለምና አንተን ቢበድሉ፥ ተቈጥተህም ለጠላቶቻቸው አሳልፈህ ብትሰጣቸው ሩቅ ወይም ቅርብ ወደ ሆነ ወደ ጠላቶች አገር ቢማረኩም፥

verses.en: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the Lord toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:
verses.fr: Quand ton peuple sortira pour combattre son ennemi, en suivant la voie que tu lui auras prescrite; s''ils adressent à l''Eternel des prières, les regards tournés vers la ville que tu as choisie et vers la maison que j''ai bâtie à ton nom,
verses.am: በተማረኩበትም አገር ሆነው በልባቸው ንስሐ ቢገቡ፥ በማራኪዎቹም አገር ሳሉ ተመልሰው። ኃጢአት ሠርተናል፥ በድለንማል፥ ክፉንም አድርገናል ብለው ቢለምኑህ፥

verses.en: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.fr: exauce des cieux leurs prières et leurs supplications, et fais-leur droit!
verses.am: በማረኩአቸው በጠላቶቻቸው አገር ሳሉ በፍጹም ልባቸውና በፍጹም ነፍሳቸው ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ሰጠሃት ወደ ምድራቸው ወደ መረጥሃትም ከተማ ለስምህም ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ቢጸልዩ፥

verses.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
verses.fr: Quand ils pécheront contre toi, car il n''y a point d''homme qui ne pèche, quand tu seras irrité contre eux et que tu les livreras à l''ennemi, qui les emmènera captifs dans un pays ennemi, lointain ou rapproché;
verses.am: ጸሎታቸውንና ልመናቸውን በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፥

verses.en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;
verses.fr: s''ils rentrent en eux-mêmes dans le pays où ils seront captifs, s''ils reviennent à toi et t''adressent des supplications dans le pays de ceux qui les ont emmenés, et qu''ils disent: Nous avons péché, nous avons commis des iniquités, nous avons fait le mal!
verses.am: ፍርድንም አድርግላቸው፥ አንተንም የበደሉህን ሕዝብህን፥ በአንተም ላይ ያደረጉትን በደላቸውን ሁሉ ይቅር በል፤ ይራሩላቸውም ዘንድ በማረኩአቸው ፊት ምሕረት ስጣቸው፤

verses.en: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.fr: s''ils reviennent à toi de tout leur coeur et de toute leur âme, dans le pays de leurs ennemis qui les ont emmenés captifs, s''ils t''adressent des prières, les regards tournés vers leur pays que tu as donné à leurs pères, vers la ville que tu as choisie et vers la maison que j''ai bâtie à ton nom, -
verses.am: ከግብፅ ምድር ከብረት እቶን ውስጥ ያወጣሃቸው ሕዝብህና ርስትህ ናቸውና።

verses.en: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
verses.fr: exauce des cieux, du lieu de ta demeure, leurs prières et leurs supplications, et fais-leur droit;
verses.am: በጠሩህ ጊዜ ሁሉ ትሰማቸው ዘንድ ለባሪያህና ለሕዝብህ ለእስራኤል ልመና ዓይኖችህ የተገለጡ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
verses.fr: pardonne à ton peuple ses péchés et toutes ses transgressions contre toi; excite la compassion de ceux qui les retiennent captifs, afin qu''ils aient pitié d''eux,
verses.am: ጌታዬ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አባቶቻችንን ከግብጽ ባወጣህ ጊዜ በባሪያህ በሙሴ እጅ እንደ ተናገርህ ርስት ይሆኑህ ዘንድ ከምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ ለይተሃቸዋልና።

verses.en: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
verses.fr: car ils sont ton peuple et ton héritage, et tu les as fait sortir d''Egypte, du milieu d''une fournaise de fer!
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ይህችን ጸሎትና ልመና ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ጸልዮ በፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ በጕልበቱ ተንበርክኮ እጁንም ወደ ሰማይ ዘርግቶ ነበርና ከእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ፊት ተነሣ።

verses.en: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
verses.fr: Que tes yeux soient ouverts sur la supplication de ton serviteur et sur la supplication de ton peuple d''Israël, pour les exaucer en tout ce qu''ils te demanderont!
verses.am: ቆሞም የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ በታላቅ ድምፅ ሲመርቅ እንዲህ አለ።

verses.en: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord God.
verses.fr: Car tu les as séparés de tous les autres peuples de la terre pour en faire ton héritage, comme tu l''as déclaré par Moïse, ton serviteur, quand tu fis sortir d''Egypte nos pères, Seigneur Eternel!
verses.am: እንደ ተናገረው ተስፋ ሁሉ ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል ዕረፍትን የሰጠ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን፤ በባሪያው በሙሴ ከሰጠው ከመልካም ተስፋ ሁሉ አንድ ቃል አልወደቀም።

verses.en: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the Lord, he arose from before the altar of the Lord, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
verses.fr: Lorsque Salomon eut achevé d''adresser à l''Eternel toute cette prière et cette supplication, il se leva de devant l''autel de l''Eternel, où il était agenouillé, les mains étendues vers le ciel.
verses.am: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ከአባቶቻችን ጋር እንደ ነበረ ከእኛ ጋር ይሁን፤ አይተወን፥ አይጣለንም፤

verses.en: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
verses.fr: Debout, il bénit à haute voix toute l''assemblée d''Israël, en disant:
verses.am: በመንገዱም ሁሉ እንሄድ ዘንድ፥ ለአባቶቻችንም ያዘዛትን ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ትእዛዙንም እንጠብቅ ዘንድ፥ ልባችንን ወደ እርሱ ያዘነብል ዘንድ።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel, qui a donné du repos à son peuple d''Israël, selon toutes ses promesses! De toutes les bonnes paroles qu''il avait prononcées par Moïse, son serviteur, aucune n''est restée sans effet.
verses.am: ለባሪያውና ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል በየዕለቱ ፍርድን ያደርግ ዘንድ ይህች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የለመንኋት ቃል በቀንና በሌሊት ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር የቀረበች ትሁን፤

verses.en: The Lord our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
verses.fr: Que l''Eternel, notre Dieu, soit avec nous, comme il a été avec nos pères; qu''il ne nous abandonne point et ne nous délaisse point,
verses.am: የምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከእርሱም በቀር ሌላ እንደሌለ ያውቅ ዘንድ።

verses.en: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
verses.fr: mais qu''il incline nos coeurs vers lui, afin que nous marchions dans toutes ses voies, et que nous observions ses commandements, ses lois et ses ordonnances, qu''il a prescrits à nos pères!
verses.am: እንደ ዛሬው ቀን በሥርዓቱ ትሄዱ ዘንድ፥ ትእዛዙንም ትጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ ከአምላካችን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ልባችሁ ፍጹም ይሁን።

verses.en: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the Lord, be nigh unto the Lord our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:
verses.fr: Que ces paroles, objet de mes supplications devant l''Eternel, soient jour et nuit présentes à l''Eternel, notre Dieu, et qu''il fasse en tout temps droit à son serviteur et à son peuple d''Israël,
verses.am: ንጉሡም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መሥዋዕት ሠዉ።

verses.en: That all the people of the earth may know that the Lord is God, and that there is none else.
verses.fr: afin que tous les peuples de la terre reconnaissent que l''Eternel est Dieu, qu''il n''y en a point d''autre!
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ይሠዋ ዘንድ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ በሬዎችና መቶ ሀያ ሺህ በጎች አቀረበ። ንጉሡና የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እንዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ቀደሱ።

verses.en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the Lord our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
verses.fr: Que votre coeur soit tout à l''Eternel, notre Dieu, comme il l''est aujourd''hui, pour suivre ses lois et pour observer ses commandements.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያለው የናሱ መሠዊያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቁርባን የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ስብ ይይዝ ዘንድ ታናሽ ስለ ነበረ፥ በዚያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ስብ አሳርጎአልና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ፊት የነበረውን የአደባባዩ መካከል ንጉሡ በዚያ ቀን ቀደሰ።

verses.en: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the Lord.
verses.fr: Le roi et tout Israël avec lui offrirent des sacrifices devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ሰሎሞን ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምሮ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ ድረስ ያለው ታላቅ ጉባኤ፥ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሰባት ቀን በዓሉን አደረጉ።

verses.en: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the Lord, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Salomon immola vingt-deux mille boeufs et cent vingt mille brebis pour le sacrifice d''actions de grâces qu''il offrit à l''Eternel. Ainsi le roi et tous les enfants d''Israël firent la dédicace de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሕዝቡን አሰናበተ፤ እነርሱም ንጉሡን መረቁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለባሪያው ለዳዊትና ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል ስላደረገው ቸርነት ሁሉ በልባቸው ተደስተው ሐሤትም አድርገው ወደ ስፍራቸው ሄዱ። a

verses.en: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the Lord was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.fr: En ce jour, le roi consacra le milieu du parvis, qui est devant la maison de l''Eternel; car il offrit là les holocaustes, les offrandes, et les graisses des sacrifices d''actions de grâces, parce que l''autel d''airain qui est devant l''Eternel était trop petit pour contenir les holocaustes, les offrandes, et les graisses des sacrifices d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያለው የናሱ መሠዊያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቁርባን የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ስብ ይይዝ ዘንድ ታናሽ ስለ ነበረ፥ በዚያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ስብ አሳርጎአልና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ፊት የነበረውን የአደባባዩ መካከል ንጉሡ በዚያ ቀን ቀደሰ።

verses.en: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the Lord our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.
verses.fr: Salomon célébra la fête en ce temps-là, et tout Israël avec lui. Une grande multitude, venue depuis les environs de Hamath jusqu''au torrent d''Egypte, s''assembla devant l''Eternel, notre Dieu, pendant sept jours, et sept autres jours, soit quatorze jours.
verses.am: ፤ በዚያም ዘመን ሰሎሞን ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምሮ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ ድረስ ያለው ታላቅ ጉባኤ፥ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሰባት ቀን በዓሉን አደረጉ።

verses.en: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the Lord had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, il renvoya le peuple. Et ils bénirent le roi, et s''en allèrent dans leurs tentes, joyeux et le coeur content pour tout le bien que l''Eternel avait fait à David, son serviteur, et à Israël, son peuple.
verses.am: ፤ በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሕዝቡን አሰናበተ፤ እነርሱም ንጉሡን መረቁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለባሪያው ለዳዊትና ለሕዝቡ ለእስራኤል ስላደረገው ቸርነት ሁሉ በልባቸው ተደስተው ሐሤትም አድርገው ወደ ስፍራቸው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the Lord, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,
verses.fr: Lorsque Salomon eut achevé de bâtir la maison de l''Eternel, la maison du roi, et tout ce qu''il lui plut de faire,
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት፥ የንጉሡን ቤትና ሰሎሞን የወደደውን የልቡን አሳብ ሁሉ ሠርቶ በፈጸመ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That the Lord appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
verses.fr: l''Eternel apparut à Salomon une seconde fois, comme il lui était apparu à Gabaon.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በገባዖን ለሰሎሞን እንደ ተገለጠለት ዳግመኛ ተገለጠለት።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel lui dit: J''exauce ta prière et ta supplication que tu m''as adressées, je sanctifie cette maison que tu as bâtie pour y mettre à jamais mon nom, et j''aurai toujours là mes yeux et mon coeur.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። በፊቴ የጸለይኸውን ጸሎትህንና ልመናህን ሰምቻለሁ፤ ለዘላለምም ስሜ በዚያ ያድር ዘንድ ይህን የሠራኸውን ቤት ቀድሻለሁ፤ ዓይኖቼና ልቤም በዘመኑ ሁሉ በዚያ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:
verses.fr: Et toi, si tu marches en ma présence comme a marché David, ton père, avec sincérité de coeur et avec droiture, faisant tout ce que je t''ai commandé, si tu observes mes lois et mes ordonnances,
verses.am: ዳዊትም አባትህ በየዋህ ልብና በቅንነት እንደ ሄደ አንተ ደግሞ በፊቴ ብትሄድ፥ ያዘዝሁህንም ሁሉ ብታደርግ፥ ሥርዓቴንም ፍርዴንም ብትጠብቅ፥

verses.en: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.
verses.fr: j''établirai pour toujours le trône de ton royaume en Israël, comme je l''ai déclaré à David, ton père, en disant: Tu ne manqueras jamais d''un successeur sur le trône d''Israël.
verses.am: እኔ። ከእስራኤል ዙፋን ከዘርህ ሰው አታጣም ብዬ ለአባትህ ለዳዊት እንደ ተናገርሁ፥ የመንግሥትህን ዙፋን በእስራኤል ላይ ለዘላለም አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
verses.fr: Mais si vous vous détournez de moi, vous et vos fils, si vous n''observez pas mes commandements, mes lois que je vous ai prescrites, et si vous allez servir d''autres dieux et vous prosterner devant eux,
verses.am: እናንተና ልጆቻችሁ ግን እኔን ከመከትል ብትመለሱ፥ የሰጠኋችሁንም ትእዛዜንና ሥርዓቴን ባትጠብቁ፥ ሄዳችሁም ሌሎችን አማልክት ብታመልኩ፥ ብትሰግዱላቸውም፥

verses.en: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
verses.fr: j''exterminerai Israël du pays que je lui ai donné, je rejetterai loin de moi la maison que j''ai consacrée à mon nom, et Israël sera un sujet de sarcasme et de raillerie parmi tous les peuples.
verses.am: እስራኤልን ከሰጠኋቸው ምድር አጠፋቸዋለሁ፤ ለስሜም የቀደስሁትን ይህን ቤት ከፊቴ እጥለዋለሁ፤ እስራኤልም በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ምሳሌና ተረት ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the Lord done thus unto this land, and to this house?
verses.fr: Et si haut placée qu''ait été cette maison, quiconque passera près d''elle sera dans l''étonnement et sifflera. On dira: Pourquoi l''Eternel a-t-il ainsi traité ce pays et cette maison?
verses.am: ከፍ ከፍ ብሎ የነበረውም ይህ ቤት ባድማ ይሆናል፤ በዚያም የሚያልፍ ሁሉ እያፍዋጨ። እግዚአብሔር በዚህ አገርና በዚህ ቤት ስለምን እንዲህ አደረገ? ብሎ ይደነቃል።

verses.en: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the Lord their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the Lord brought upon them all this evil.
verses.fr: Et l''on répondra: Parce qu''ils ont abandonné l''Eternel, leur Dieu, qui a fait sortir leurs pères du pays d''Egypte, parce qu''ils se sont attachés à d''autres dieux, se sont prosternés devant eux et les ont servis; voilà pourquoi l''Eternel a fait venir sur eux tous ces maux.
verses.am: መልሰውም። ከግብጽ ምድር አባቶቻቸውን ያወጣውን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ሌሎችንም አማልክት ስለ ተከተሉ፥ ስለ ሰገዱላቸውም፥ ስለ አመለኩአቸውም፥ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አመጣባቸው ይላሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the Lord, and the king's house,
verses.fr: Au bout de vingt ans, Salomon avait bâti les deux maisons, la maison de l''Eternel et la maison du roi.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት ሁለቱን ቤቶች የሠራበት ሀያ ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.fr: Alors, comme Hiram, roi de Tyr, avait fourni à Salomon des bois de cèdre et des bois de cyprès, et de l''or, autant qu''il en voulut, le roi Salomon donna à Hiram vingt villes dans le pays de Galilée.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን በገሊላ ምድር ያሉትን ሀያ ከተሞች ለኪራም ሰጠው። የጢሮስም ንጉሥ ኪራም የሚሻውን ያህል የዝግባና የጥድ እንጨት የሚሻውንም ያህል ወርቅ ሁሉ ለሰሎሞን ሰጥቶት ነበር።

verses.en: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
verses.fr: Hiram sortit de Tyr, pour voir les villes que lui donnait Salomon. Mais elles ne lui plurent point,
verses.am: ኪራምም ሰሎሞን የሰጠውን ከተሞች ያይ ዘንድ ከጢሮስ ወጣ፤ ደስም አላሰኙትም።

verses.en: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
verses.fr: et il dit: Quelles villes m''as-tu données là, mon frère? Et il les appela pays de Cabul, nom qu''elles ont conservé jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: እርሱም። ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ የሰጠኸኝ እነዚህ ከተሞች ምንድር ናቸው? አለ። እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ የከቡል አገር ተብለው ተጠሩ።

verses.en: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
verses.fr: Hiram avait envoyé au roi cent vingt talents d''or.
verses.am: ኪራምም መቶ ሀያ መክሊት ወርቅ ለንጉሡ ላከ።

verses.en: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the Lord, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.fr: Voici ce qui concerne les hommes de corvée que leva le roi Salomon pour bâtir la maison de l''Eternel et sa propre maison, Millo, et le mur de Jérusalem, Hatsor, Meguiddo et Guézer.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የራሱን ቤት፥ ሚሎንም፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር፥ ሐጾርንም፥ መጊዶንም፥ ጌዝርንም ይሠራ ዘንድ ገባሮችን መልምሎ ነበር።

verses.en: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.
verses.fr: Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, était venu s''emparer de Guézer, l''avait incendiée, et avait tué les Cananéens qui habitaient dans la ville. Puis il l''avait donnée pour dot à sa fille, femme de Salomon.
verses.am: የግብጽም ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ወጥቶ ጌዝርን ይዞ ነበር፥ በእሳትም አቃጥሎ ነበር፥ በከተማም የኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ገድሎ ነበር፤ ለልጁም ለሰሎምን ሚስት ትሎት አድርጎ ሰጥቶአት ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
verses.fr: Et Salomon bâtit Guézer, Beth-Horon la basse,
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ጌዝርን፥ የታችኛውንም ቤት

verses.en: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
verses.fr: Baalath, et Thadmor, au désert dans le pays,
verses.am: ሖሮን፥ ባዕላትንም፥ በምድረ በዳም አገር ያለችውን ተድሞርን፥

verses.en: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.fr: toutes les villes servant de magasins et lui appartenant, les villes pour les chars, les villes pour la cavalerie, et tout ce qu''il plut à Salomon de bâtir à Jérusalem, au Liban, et dans tout le pays dont il était le souverain.
verses.am: ለሰሎሞንም የነበሩትን የዕቃ ቤት ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የሰረገላውንም ከተሞች፥ የፈረሰኞችንም ከተሞች፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሊባኖስም በመንግሥቱም ምድር ሁሉ ሰሎሞን ይሠራ ዘንድ የወደደውን ሁሉ ሠራ።

verses.en: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,
verses.fr: Tout le peuple qui était resté des Amoréens, des Héthiens, des Phéréziens, des Héviens et des Jébusiens, ne faisant point partie des enfants d''Israël,
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ዘንድ ያልነበሩትን ከአሞራውያንና ከኬጢያውያን፥ ከፌርዛውያን፥ ከኤዊያውያንና ከኢያቡሳውያን የቀሩትን፥

verses.en: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
verses.fr: leurs descendants qui étaient restés après eux dans le pays et que les enfants d''Israël n''avaient pu dévouer par interdit, Salomon les leva comme esclaves de corvée, ce qu''ils ont été jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ያጠፉአቸው ዘንድ ያልቻሉትን፥ በኋላቸው የቀሩትን ልጆቻቸውን፥ ሰሎሞን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ገባሮች አድርጎ መለመላቸው።

verses.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.fr: Mais Salomon n''employa point comme esclaves les enfants d''Israël; car ils étaient des hommes de guerre, ses serviteurs, ses chefs, ses officiers, les commandants de ses chars et de sa cavalerie.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ማንንም ባሪያ አላደረገም፤ እነርሱ ግን ሰልፈኞች፥ ሎሌዎችም፥ መሳፍንትም፥ አለቆችም፥ የሰረገሎችና የፈረሶች ባልደራሶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.fr: Les chefs préposés par Salomon sur les travaux étaient au nombre de cinq cent cinquante, chargés de surveiller les ouvriers.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በሚሠራው ሥራ ላይ ሠራተኛውን ሕዝብ የሚያዝዙ አለቆች አምስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
verses.fr: La fille de Pharaon monta de la cité de David dans sa maison que Salomon lui avait construite. Ce fut alors qu''il bâtit Millo.
verses.am: የፈርዖንም ልጅ ከዳዊት ከተማ ሰሎሞን ወደ ሠራላት ወደ ቤትዋ ወጣች በዚያን ጊዜም ሚሎን ሠራ።

verses.en: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the Lord, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the Lord. So he finished the house.
verses.fr: Salomon offrit trois fois dans l''année des holocaustes et des sacrifices d''actions de grâces sur l''autel qu''il avait bâti à l''Eternel, et il brûla des parfums sur celui qui était devant l''Eternel. Et il acheva la maison.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በየዓመቱ ሦስት ጊዜ የሚቃጠለውንና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር በሠራው መሠዊያ ላይ ያሳርግ ነበር፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ባለው መሠዊያ ላይ ዕጣን ያሳርግ ነበር፤ ቤቱንም ጨረሰ።

verses.en: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon construisit des navires à Etsjon-Guéber, près d''Eloth, sur les bords de la mer Rouge, dans le pays d''Edom.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን በኤዶምያስ ምድር በኤርትራ ባሕር ዳር በኤሎት አጠገብ ባለችው በዔጽዮንጋብር መርከቦችን ሠራ።

verses.en: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.fr: Et Hiram envoya sur ces navires, auprès des serviteurs de Salomon, ses propres serviteurs, des matelots connaissant la mer.
verses.am: ኪራምም በእነዚያ መርከቦች ከሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች ጋር የባሕሩን ነገር የሚያውቁ መርከበኞች ባሪያዎቹን ሰደደ።

verses.en: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
verses.fr: Ils allèrent à Ophir, et ils y prirent de l''or, quatre cent vingt talents, qu''ils apportèrent au roi Salomon.
verses.am: ወደ ኦፊርም መጡ፥ ከዚያም አራት መቶ ሀያ መክሊተ ወርቅ ወሰዱ፥ ወደ ንጉሡም ወደ ሰሎሞን ይዘው መጡ።

verses.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the Lord, she came to prove him with hard questions.
verses.fr: La reine de Séba apprit la renommée que possédait Salomon, à la gloire de l''Eternel, et elle vint pour l''éprouver par des énigmes.
verses.am: የሳባም ንግሥት በእግዚአብሔር ስም የወጣለትን የሰሎሞንን ዝና በሰማች ጊዜ በእንቆቅልሽ ትፈትነው ዘንድ መጣች።

verses.en: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.fr: Elle arriva à Jérusalem avec une suite fort nombreuse, et avec des chameaux portant des aromates, de l''or en très grande quantité, et des pierres précieuses. Elle se rendit auprès de Salomon, et elle lui dit tout ce qu''elle avait dans le coeur.
verses.am: በግመሎችም ላይ ሽቱና እጅግ ብዙ ወርቅ የከበረም ዕንቍ አስጭና ከታላቅ ጓዝ ጋር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ገባች፤ ወደ ሰሎሞንም በመጣች ጊዜ በልብዋ ያለውን ሁሉ አጫወተችው።

verses.en: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
verses.fr: Salomon répondit à toutes ses questions, et il n''y eut rien que le roi ne sût lui expliquer.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የጠየቀችውን ሁሉ ፈታላት፤ ሊፈታላት ያልቻለውና ከንጉሡ የተሰወረ ነገር አልነበረም።

verses.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,
verses.fr: La reine de Séba vit toute la sagesse de Salomon, et la maison qu''il avait bâtie,
verses.am: የሳባም ንግሥት የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ ሁሉ፥ ሠርቶትም የነበረውን ቤት፥

verses.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the Lord; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.fr: et les mets de sa table, et la demeure de ses serviteurs, et les fonctions et les vêtements de ceux qui le servaient, et ses échansons, et ses holocaustes qu''il offrait dans la maison de l''Eternel. Hors d''elle même,
verses.am: የማዕዱንም መብል፥ የብላቴኖቹንም አቀማመጥ፥ የሎሌዎቹንም አሠራር አለባበሳቸውንም፥ ጠጅ አሳላፊዎቹንም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የሚያሳርገውን መሥዋዕት ባየች ጊዜ ነፍስ አልቀረላትም።

verses.en: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.
verses.fr: elle dit au roi: C''était donc vrai ce que j''ai appris dans mon pays au sujet de ta position et de ta sagesse!
verses.am: ንጉሡንም አለችው። ስለ ነገርህና ስለ ጥበብህ በአገሬ ሳለሁ የሰማሁት ዝና እውነት ነው።

verses.en: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
verses.fr: Je ne le croyais pas, avant d''être venue et d''avoir vu de mes yeux. Et voici, on ne m''en a pas dit la moitié. Tu as plus de sagesse et de prospérité que la renommée ne me l''a fait connaître.
verses.am: እኔም መጥቼ በዓይኔ እስካይ ድረስ የነገሩኝን አላመንሁም ነበር፤ እነሆም፥ እኩሌታውን አልነገሩኝም ነበር፤ ጥበብህና ሥራህ ከሰማሁት ዝና ይበልጣል።

verses.en: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.
verses.fr: Heureux tes gens, heureux tes serviteurs qui sont continuellement devant toi, qui entendent ta sagesse!
verses.am: በፊትህ ሁልጊዜ የሚቆሙ ጥበብህንም የሚሰሙ ሰዎችህና እነዚህ ባሪያዎችህ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the Lord loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel, ton Dieu, qui t''a accordé la faveur de te placer sur le trône d''Israël! C''est parce que l''Eternel aime à toujours Israël, qu''il t''a établi roi pour que tu fasses droit et justice.
verses.am: አንተን የወደደ፥ በእስራኤልም ዙፋን ያስቀመጠህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር የተባረከ ይሁን፤ እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን ለዘላለም ወድዶታልና ስለዚህ ጽድቅና ፍርድ ታደርግ ዘንድ ንጉሥ አድርጎ አስነሣህ።

verses.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.fr: Elle donna au roi cent vingt talents d''or, une très grande quantité d''aromates, et des pierres précieuses. Il ne vint plus autant d''aromates que la reine de Séba en donna au roi Salomon.
verses.am: ለንጉሡም መቶ ሀያ መክሊት ወርቅ እጅግም ብዙ ሽቱ የከበረም ዕንቍ ሰጠችው፤ የሳባ ንግሥት ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እንደ ሰጠችው ያለ የሽቱ ብዛት ከዚያ ወዲያ አልመጣም ነበር።

verses.en: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
verses.fr: Les navires de Hiram, qui apportèrent de l''or d''Ophir, amenèrent aussi d''Ophir une grande quantité de bois de sandal et des pierres précieuses.
verses.am: ከኦፊርም ወርቅ ያመጡ የኪራም መርከቦች እጅግ ብዙ የሰንደል እንጨትና የከበረ ዕንቍ ከኦፊር አመጡ።

verses.en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the Lord, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
verses.fr: Le roi fit avec le bois de sandal des balustrades pour la maison de l''Eternel et pour la maison du roi, et des harpes et des luths pour les chantres. Il ne vint plus de ce bois de sandal, et on n''en a plus vu jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ከሰንደሉ እንጨት ለእግዚአብሔር ቤትና ለንጉሡ ቤት መከታ፥ ለመዘምራኑም መሰንቆና በገና አደረገ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ እንደዚያ ያለ የሰንደል እንጨት ከቶ አልመጣም አልታየምም።

verses.en: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon donna à la reine de Séba tout ce qu''elle désira, ce qu''elle demanda, et lui fit en outre des présents dignes d''un roi tel que Salomon. Puis elle s''en retourna et alla dans son pays, elle et ses serviteurs.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን፥ በገዛ እጁ ከሰጣት ሌላ፥ የወደደችውን ሁሉ ከእርሱም የለመነችውን ሁሉ ለሳባ ንግሥት ሰጣት፤ እርስዋም ተመልሳ ከባሪያዎችዋ ጋር ወደ ምድርዋ ሄደች።

verses.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
verses.fr: Le poids de l''or qui arrivait à Salomon chaque année était de six cent soixante-six talents d''or,
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከጥፍጥፍ ወርቅ ሁለት መቶ አላበሽ አግሬ ጋሻ አሠራ፤ በአንዱም አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻ ውስጥ የገባው ወርቅ ስድስት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.en: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
verses.fr: outre ce qu''il retirait des négociants et du trafic des marchands, de tous les rois d''Arabie, et des gouverneurs du pays.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከጥፍጥፍ ወርቅ ሁለት መቶ አላበሽ አግሬ ጋሻ አሠራ፤ በአንዱም አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻ ውስጥ የገባው ወርቅ ስድስት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon fit deux cents grands boucliers d''or battu, pour chacun desquels il employa six cents sicles d''or,
verses.am: ከጥፍጥፍም ወርቅ ሦስት መቶ ጋሻ አሠራ፤ በአንዱም ጋሻ የገባው ወርቅ ሦስት ምናን ነበረ፤ ንጉሡም የሊባኖስ ዱር በተባለው ቤት ውስጥ አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.fr: et trois cents autres boucliers d''or battu, pour chacun desquels il employa trois mines d''or; et le roi les mit dans la maison de la forêt du Liban.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ደግሞ ከዝሆን ጥርስ ታላቅ ዙፋን አሠራ፥ በጥሩም ወርቅ ለበጠው።
