verses.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
verses.fr: Le roi fit un grand trône d''ivoire, et le couvrit d''or pur.
verses.am: ወደ ዙፋንም የሚያስሄዱ ስድስት እርከኖች ነበሩ፤ በስተ ኋላውም ያለው የዙፋኑ ራስ ክብ ነበረ፤ በዚህና በዚያ በመቀመጫው አጠገብ ሁለት የክንድ መደገፊያዎች ነበሩበት፥ በመደገፊያዎቹም አጠገብ ሁለት አንበሶች ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
verses.fr: Ce trône avait six degrés, et la partie supérieure en était arrondie par derrière; il y avait des bras de chaque côté du siège; deux lions étaient près des bras,
verses.am: በስድስቱም እርከኖች ላይ በዚህና በዚያ አሥራ ሁለት አንበሶች ቆመው ነበር፤ በመንግሥታት ሁሉ እንዲህ ያለ ሥራ አልተሠራም።

verses.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.fr: et douze lions sur les six degrés de part et d''autre. Il ne s''est rien fait de pareil pour aucun royaume.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን የሚጠጣበት ዕቃ ሁሉ ወርቅ ነበረ፥ የሊባኖስ ዱር የተባለውም ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ ጥሩ ወርቅ እንጂ ብር አልነበረም። በሰሎሞን ዘመን ብር ከቶ አይቈጠርም ነበር።

verses.en: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.fr: Toutes les coupes du roi Salomon étaient d''or, et toute la vaisselle de la maison de la forêt du Liban était d''or pur. Rien n''était d''argent: on n''en faisait aucun cas du temps de Salomon.
verses.am: ለንጉሡም ከኪራም መርከቦች ጋር የተርሴስ መርከቦች ነበሩት፤ በሦስት በሦስት ዓመትም አንድ ጊዜ የተርሴስ መርከቦች ወርቅና ብር፥ የዝሆንም ጥርስ፥ ዝንጀሮና ዝንጕርጕር ወፍ ይዘው ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.fr: Car le roi avait en mer des navires de Tarsis avec ceux de Hiram; et tous les trois ans arrivaient les navires de Tarsis, apportant de l''or et de l''argent, de l''ivoire, des singes et des paons.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን በባለጠግነትና በጥበብ ከምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ በልጦ ነበር።

verses.en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon fut plus grand que tous les rois de la terre par les richesses et par la sagesse.
verses.am: ምድርም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር በልቡ ያኖረለትን ጥበቡን ይሰማ ዘንድ የሰሎሞንን ፊት ይመኝ ነበር።

verses.en: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.fr: Tout le monde cherchait à voir Salomon, pour entendre la sagesse que Dieu avait mise dans son coeur.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም እያንዳንዱ በዓመቱ በዓመቱ ገጸ በረከቱን፥ የብርና የወርቅ ዕቃ፥ ልብስና የጦር መሣሪያ፥ ሽቱም፥ ፈረሶችና በቅሎች እየያዘ ይመጣ ነበር።

verses.en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.fr: Et chacun apportait son présent, des objets d''argent et des objets d''or, des vêtements, des armes, des aromates, des chevaux et des mulets; et il en était ainsi chaque année.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ሰረገሎችንና ፈረሰኞችን ሰበሰበ፤ አንድ ሺህ አራት መቶ ሰረገሎች፥ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት፥ በሰረገሎችም ከተሞች ከንጉሡም ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Salomon rassembla des chars et de la cavalerie; il avait quatorze cents chars et douze mille cavaliers, qu''il plaça dans les villes où il tenait ses chars et à Jérusalem près du roi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ብሩን በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ድንጋይ እንዲበዛ አደረገው፤ የዝግባም እንጨት ብዛት በቈላ እንደሚበቅል ሾላ ሆነ።

verses.en: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
verses.fr: Le roi rendit l''argent aussi commun à Jérusalem que les pierres, et les cèdres aussi nombreux que les sycomores qui croissent dans la plaine.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ፈረሶችን ከግብጽና ከቀዌ አገር አስመጣ፤ የንጉሡም ነገዴዎች በገንዘብ እየገዙ ከቀዌ ያመጡአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.fr: C''était de l''Egypte que Salomon tirait ses chevaux; une caravane de marchands du roi les allait chercher par troupes à un prix fixe:
verses.am: አንዱም ሰረገላ በስድስት መቶ፥ አንዱም ፈረስ በመቶ አምሳ ብር ከግብጽ ይወጣ ነበር። እንዲሁም ለኬጢያውያንና ለሶርያ ነገሥታት ሁሉ በእጃቸው ያወጡላቸው ነበር። a

verses.en: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
verses.fr: un char montait et sortait d''Egypte pour six cents sicles d''argent, et un cheval pour cent cinquante sicles. Ils en amenaient de même avec eux pour tous les rois des Héthiens et pour les rois de Syrie.
verses.am: ፤ አንዱም ሰረገላ በስድስት መቶ፥ አንዱም ፈረስ በመቶ አምሳ ብር ከግብጽ ይወጣ ነበር። እንዲሁም ለኬጢያውያንና ለሶርያ ነገሥታት ሁሉ በእጃቸው ያወጡላቸው ነበር። a

verses.en: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites:
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon aima beaucoup de femmes étrangères, outre la fille de Pharaon: des Moabites, des Ammonites, des Edomites, des Sidoniennes, des Héthiennes,
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከፈርዖን ልጅ ሌላ፥ በሞዓባውያንና በአሞናውያን በኤዶማውያን በሲዶናውያንና በኬጢያውያን ሴቶች፥ በብዙ እንግዶች ሴቶች ፍቅር ተነደፈ።

verses.en: Of the nations concerning which the Lord said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
verses.fr: appartenant aux nations dont l''Eternel avait dit aux enfants d''Israël: Vous n''irez point chez elles, et elles ne viendront point chez vous; elles tourneraient certainement vos coeurs du côté de leurs dieux. Ce fut à ces nations que s''attacha Salomon, entraîné par l''amour.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ልጆች። አምላኮቻቸውን ትከተሉ ዘንድ ልባችሁን በእውነት ያዘነብላሉና ወደ እነርሱ አትግቡ፥ እነርሱም ወደ እናንተ አይግቡ ካላቸው ከአሕዛብ፥ ከእነዚህ ጋር ሰሎሞን በፍቅር ተጣበቀ።

verses.en: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.fr: Il eut sept cents princesses pour femmes et trois cents concubines; et ses femmes détournèrent son coeur.
verses.am: ለእርሱም ወይዛዝር የሆኑ ሰባት መቶ ሚስቶች ሦስት መቶም ቁባቶች ነበሩት፤ ሚስቶቹም ልቡን አዘነበሉት።

verses.en: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as was the heart of David his father.
verses.fr: A l''époque de la vieillesse de Salomon, ses femmes inclinèrent son coeur vers d''autres dieux; et son coeur ne fut point tout entier à l''Eternel, son Dieu, comme l''avait été le coeur de David, son père.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ሲሸመግል ሚስቶቹ ሌሎችን አማልክት ይከተል ዘንድ ልቡን አዘነበሉት፤ የአባቱ የዳዊት ልብ ከአምላኩ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ፍጹም እንደ ነበረ የሰሎሞን ልቡ እንዲሁ አልነበረም።

verses.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.fr: Salomon alla après Astarté, divinité des Sidoniens, et après Milcom, l''abomination des Ammonites.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የሲዶናውያንን አምላክ አስታሮትን፥ የአሞናውያንንም ርኵሰት ሚልኮምን፥ ተከተለ።

verses.en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord, and went not fully after the Lord, as did David his father.
verses.fr: Et Salomon fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, et il ne suivit point pleinement l''Eternel, comme David, son père.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገርን አደረገ፥ እንደ አባቱም እንደ ዳዊት እግዚአብሔርን በመከተል ፍጹም አልሆነም።

verses.en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.fr: Alors Salomon bâtit sur la montagne qui est en face de Jérusalem un haut lieu pour Kemosch, l''abomination de Moab, et pour Moloc, l''abomination des fils d''Ammon.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ሰሎሞን ለሞዓብ ርኵሰት ለካሞሽ፥ ለአሞንም ልጆች ርኵሰት ለሞሎክ በኢየሩሳሌም ፊት ለፊት ባለው ተራራ ላይ መስገጃ ሠራ።

verses.en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
verses.fr: Et il fit ainsi pour toutes ses femmes étrangères, qui offraient des parfums et des sacrifices à leurs dieux.
verses.am: ለአማልክቶቻቸው ዕጣን ለሚያጥኑ መሥዋዕትም ለሚሠዉ ለእንግዶች ሚስቶቹ ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the Lord God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
verses.fr: L''Eternel fut irrité contre Salomon, parce qu''il avait détourné son coeur de l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, qui lui était apparu deux fois.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰሎሞንን አለው። ይህን ሠርተሃልና፥ ያዘዝሁህንም ቃል ኪዳኔንና ሥርዓቴን አልጠበቅህምና መንግሥትህን ከአንተ ቀዳድጄ ለባሪያህ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the Lord commanded.
verses.fr: Il lui avait à cet égard défendu d''aller après d''autres dieux; mais Salomon n''observa point les ordres de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰሎሞንን አለው። ይህን ሠርተሃልና፥ ያዘዝሁህንም ቃል ኪዳኔንና ሥርዓቴን አልጠበቅህምና መንግሥትህን ከአንተ ቀዳድጄ ለባሪያህ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore the Lord said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Salomon: Puisque tu as agi de la sorte, et que tu n''as point observé mon alliance et mes lois que je t''avais prescrites, je déchirerai le royaume de dessus toi et je le donnerai à ton serviteur.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከልጅህ እጅ እቀድደዋለሁ እንጂ ስለ አባትህ ስለ ዳዊት ይህን በዘመንህ አላደርግም።

verses.en: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
verses.fr: Seulement, je ne le ferai point pendant ta vie, à cause de David, ton père. C''est de la main de ton fils que je l''arracherai.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ስለ ባሪያዬ ስለ ዳዊትና ስለ መረጥኋት ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ለልጅህ አንድ ነገድ እሰጣለሁ እንጂ መንግሥቱን ሁሉ አልቀድድም።

verses.en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.
verses.fr: Je n''arracherai cependant pas tout le royaume; je laisserai une tribu à ton fils, à cause de David, mon serviteur, et à cause de Jérusalem, que j''ai choisie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከኤዶምያስ ነገሥታት ዘር የኤዶምያስን ሰው ሃዳድን ጠላት አድርጎ በሰሎሞን ላይ አስነሣው።

verses.en: And the Lord stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.
verses.fr: L''Eternel suscita un ennemi à Salomon: Hadad, l''Edomite, de la race royale d''Edom.
verses.am: ሃዳድ ገና ብላቴና ሳለ ሃዳድና ከእርሱ ጋር ጥቂቶቹ ከኤዶምያስ ሰዎች የሆኑ የአባቱ ባሪያዎች ወደ ግብጽ ኰብልለው ነበር።

verses.en: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
verses.fr: Dans le temps où David battit Edom, Joab, chef de l''armée, étant monté pour enterrer les morts, tua tous les mâles qui étaient en Edom;
verses.am: ሃዳድ ገና ብላቴና ሳለ ሃዳድና ከእርሱ ጋር ጥቂቶቹ ከኤዶምያስ ሰዎች የሆኑ የአባቱ ባሪያዎች ወደ ግብጽ ኰብልለው ነበር።

verses.en: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
verses.fr: il y resta six mois avec tout Israël, jusqu''à ce qu''il en eût exterminé tous les mâles.
verses.am: ከምድያምም ተነሥተው ወደ ፋራን መጡ፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ከፋራን ሰዎች ወሰዱ፥ ወደ ግብጽም መጡ፥ ወደ ግብጽም ንጉሥ ወደ ፈርዖን ዘንድ ገቡ፤ እርሱም ቤት ሰጥቶ ቀለብ ዳረገው፥ ምድርም ሰጠው።

verses.en: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
verses.fr: Ce fut alors qu''Hadad prit la fuite avec des Edomites, serviteurs de son père, pour se rendre en Egypte. Hadad était encore un jeune garçon.
verses.am: የሚስቱንም የእቴጌይቱን የቴቄምናስን እኅት እስኪያጋባው ድረስ ሃዳድ በፈርዖን ፊት እጅግ ባለምዋል ሆነ።

verses.en: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
verses.fr: Partis de Madian, ils allèrent à Paran, prirent avec eux des hommes de Paran, et arrivèrent en Egypte auprès de Pharaon, roi d''Egypte, Pharaon donna une maison à Hadad, pourvut à sa subsistance, et lui accorda des terres.
verses.am: የቴቄምናስ እኅት ጌንባትን ወለደችለት፥ ቴቄምናስም በፈርዖን ቤት አሳደገችው፤ ጌንባትም በፈርዖን ቤት በፈርዖን ልጆች መካከል ነበረ።

verses.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.fr: Hadad trouva grâce aux yeux de Pharaon, à tel point que Pharaon lui donna pour femme la soeur de sa femme, la soeur de la reine Thachpenès.
verses.am: ሃዳድም በግብጽ ሳለ ዳዊት ከአባቶቹ ጋር እንዳንቀላፋ፥ የሠራዊቱም አለቃ ኢዮአብ እንደ ሞተ በሰማ ጊዜ፥ ሃዳድ ፈርዖንን። ወደ አገሬ እሄድ ዘንድ አሰናብተኝ አለው።

verses.en: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.fr: La soeur de Thachpenès lui enfanta son fils Guenubath. Thachpenès le sevra dans la maison de Pharaon; et Guenubath fut dans la maison de Pharaon, au milieu des enfants de Pharaon.
verses.am: ፈርዖንም። እነሆ፥ ከእኔ ዘንድ ወደ አገርህ መሄድ የፈለግህ ምን አጥተህ ነው? አለው። እርሱም። አንዳች አላጣሁም፤ ነገር ግን ልሂድ ብሎ መለሰ። ሃዳድም ወደ አገሩ ተመለሰ፥ ሃዳድም ያደረገው ክፉ ነገር ይህ ነው፤ እስራኤልን አስጨነቀ፥ በኤዶምያስም ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
verses.fr: Lorsque Hadad apprit en Egypte que David était couché avec ses pères, et que Joab, chef de l''armée, était mort, il dit à Pharaon: Laisse-moi aller dans mon pays.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ከጌታው ከሱባ ንጉሥ ከአድርአዛር የኰበለለውን የኤልያዳን ልጅ ሬዞንን ጠላት አድርጎ አስነሣበት።

verses.en: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
verses.fr: Et Pharaon lui dit: Que te manque-t-il auprès de moi, pour que tu désires aller dans ton pays? Il répondit: Rien, mais laisse-moi partir.
verses.am: ዳዊትም የሱባን ሰዎች በገደለ ጊዜ ሬዞን ሰዎችን ሰብስቦ የጭፍራ አለቃ ሆነ፤ ወደ ደማስቆም ሄዱ፥ በዚያም ተቀመጡ፤ በደማስቆም ላይ አነገሡት።

verses.en: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
verses.fr: Dieu suscita un autre ennemi à Salomon: Rezon, fils d''Eliada, qui s''était enfui de chez son maître Hadadézer, roi de Tsoba.
verses.am: ሃዳድም ካደረገው ክፋት ሌላ በሰሎሞን ዘመን ሁሉ የእስራኤል ጠላት ነበረ።

verses.en: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.fr: Il avait rassemblé des gens auprès de lui, et il était chef de bande, lorsque David massacra les troupes de son maître. Ils allèrent à Damas, et s''y établirent, et ils régnèrent à Damas.
verses.am: ከሳሪራ አገር የሆነ የሰሎሞን ባሪያ የኤፍሬማዊው የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም በንጉሡ ላይ ዐመፀ፤ እናቱም ጽሩዓ የተባለች ባልቴት ሴት ነበረች።

verses.en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.fr: Il fut un ennemi d''Israël pendant toute la vie de Salomon, en même temps qu''Hadad lui faisait du mal, et il avait Israël en aversion. Il régna sur la Syrie.
verses.am: በንጉሡም ያመፀበት ምክንያት ይህ ነው፤ ሰሎሞን ሚሎን ሠራ፥ የአባቱንም የዳዊትን ከተማ ሰባራውን ጠገነ።

verses.en: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.fr: Jéroboam aussi, serviteur de Salomon, leva la main contre le roi. Il était fils de Nebath, Ephratien de Tseréda, et il avait pour mère une veuve nommée Tserua.
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓምም ጽኑዕ ኃያል ሰው ነበረ፤ ሰሎሞንም ጕልማሳው በሥራ የተመሰገነ መሆኑን ባየ ጊዜ በዮሴፍ ነገድ ሥራ ሁሉ ላይ ሾመው።

verses.en: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
verses.fr: Voici à quelle occasion il leva la main contre le roi. Salomon bâtissait Millo, et fermait la brèche de la cité de David, son père.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ኢዮርብዓም ከኢየሩሳሌም በወጣ ጊዜ ሴሎናዊው ነቢዩ አኪያ በመንገድ ላይ ተገናኘው፤ አኪያም አዲስ ልብስ ለብሶ ነበር ሁለቱም በሜዳው ለብቻቸው ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
verses.fr: Jéroboam était fort et vaillant; et Salomon, ayant vu ce jeune homme à l''oeuvre, lui donna la surveillance de tous les gens de corvée de la maison de Joseph.
verses.am: አኪያም የለበሰውን አዲስ ልብስ ይዞ ከአሥራ ሁለት ቈራረጠው።

verses.en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:
verses.fr: Dans ce temps-là, Jéroboam, étant sorti de Jérusalem, fut rencontré en chemin par le prophète Achija de Silo, revêtu d''un manteau neuf. Ils étaient tous deux seuls dans les champs.
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓምንም አለው። አሥር ቍራጭ ውሰድ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። እነሆ፥ ከሰሎሞን እጅ መንግሥቱን እቀድዳለሁ፥ አሥሩንም ነገዶች እሰጥሃለሁ፤

verses.en: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
verses.fr: Achija saisit le manteau neuf qu''il avait sur lui, le déchira en douze morceaux,
verses.am: ስለ ባሪያዬ ስለ ዳዊት ከእስራኤልም ነገድ ስለ መረጥኋት ከተማ ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ግን አንድ ነገድ ይቀርለታል፤

verses.en: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:
verses.fr: et dit à Jéroboam: Prends pour toi dix morceaux! Car ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Voici, je vais arracher le royaume de la main de Salomon, et je te donnerai dix tribus.
verses.am: ጥለውኛልና፥ ለሲዶናውያንም አምላክ ለአስታሮት፥ ለሞዓብም አምላክ ለካሞሽ፥ ለአሞንም ልጆች አምላክ ለሚልኮም ሰግደዋልና፥ አባቱም ዳዊት እንዳደረገ በፊቴ ቅን ነገር ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ ሥርዓቴንና ፍርዴንም ይጠብቁ ዘንድ በመንገዴ አልሄዱምና።

verses.en: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
verses.fr: Mais il aura une tribu, à cause de mon serviteur David, et à cause de Jérusalem, la ville que j''ai choisie sur toutes les tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: መንግሥቱንም ሁሉ ከእጁ አልወስድም፤ ትእዛዜንና ሥርዓቴን ስለ ጠበቀው ስለ መረጥሁት ስለ ባሪያዬ ስለ ዳዊት ግን በዕድሜው ሁሉ አለቃ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.
verses.fr: Et cela, parce qu''ils m''ont abandonné, et se sont prosternés devant Astarté, divinité des Sidoniens, devant Kemosch, dieu de Moab, et devant Milcom, dieu des fils d''Ammon, et parce qu''ils n''ont point marché dans mes voies pour faire ce qui est droit à mes yeux et pour observer mes lois et mes ordonnances, comme l''a fait David, père de Salomon.
verses.am: መንግሥቱንም ከልጁ እጅ እወስዳለሁ፥ ለአንተም አሥሩን ነገድ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
verses.fr: Je n''ôterai pas de sa main tout le royaume, car je le maintiendrai prince tout le temps de sa vie, à cause de David, mon serviteur, que j''ai choisi, et qui a observé mes commandements et mes lois.
verses.am: ስሜንም ባኖርሁባት በዚያች በመረጥኋት ከተማ በኢየሩሳሌም ለባሪያዬ ለዳዊት በፊቴ ሁልጊዜ መብራት ይሆንለት ዘንድ ለልጁ አንድ ነገድ እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.
verses.fr: Mais j''ôterai le royaume de la main de son fils, et je t''en donnerai dix tribus;
verses.am: አንተንም እወስድሃለሁ፥ ነፍስህም በወደደችው ሁሉ ላይ ትነግሣለች፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ንጉሥ ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
verses.fr: je laisserai une tribu à son fils, afin que David, mon serviteur, ait toujours une lampe devant moi à Jérusalem, la ville que j''ai choisie pour y mettre mon nom.
verses.am: ባሪያዬም ዳዊት እንዳደረገ፥ ያዘዝሁህን ሁሉ ብትሰማ፥ በመንገዴም ብትሄድ፥ በፊቴም የቀናውን ብታደርግ፥ ሥርዓቴንና ትእዛዜን ብትጠብቅ፥ ከአንተ ጋር እሆናለሁ፥ ለዳዊትም እንደ ሠራሁለት ጽኑ ቤት እሠራልሃለሁ፥ እስራኤልንም ለአንተ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
verses.fr: Je te prendrai, et tu régneras sur tout ce que ton âme désirera, tu seras roi d''Israël.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የዳዊትን ዘር አስጨንቃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን በዘመን ሁሉ አይደለም።

verses.en: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
verses.fr: Si tu obéis à tout ce que je t''ordonnerai, si tu marches dans mes voies et si tu fais ce qui est droit à mes yeux, en observant mes lois et mes commandements, comme l''a fait David, mon serviteur, je serai avec toi, je te bâtirai une maison stable, comme j''en ai bâti une à David, et je te donnerai Israël.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ኢዮርብዓምን ሊገድለው ወደደ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም ተነሥቶ ወደ ግብጽ ኰበለለ፥ ወደ ግብጽም ንጉሥ ወደ ሺሻቅ መጣ፥ ሰሎሞንም እስኪሞት ድረስ በግብጽ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
verses.fr: J''humilierai par là la postérité de David, mais ce ne sera pas pour toujours.
verses.am: የቀረውም የሰሎሞን ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ ጥበቡም፥ እነሆ፥ በሰሎሞን ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.fr: Salomon chercha à faire mourir Jéroboam. Et Jéroboam se leva et s''enfuit en Egypte auprès de Schischak, roi d''Egypte; il demeura en Egypte jusqu''à la mort de Salomon.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በኢየሩሳሌም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ የነገሠበት ዘመን አርባ ዓመት ነበረ።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Salomon, tout ce qu''il a fait, et sa sagesse, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des actes de Salomon?
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ሮብዓም በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.fr: Salomon régna quarante ans à Jérusalem sur tout Israël.
verses.am: ፤ ሰሎሞንም በኢየሩሳሌም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ የነገሠበት ዘመን አርባ ዓመት ነበረ።

verses.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Puis Salomon se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré dans la ville de David, son père. Roboam, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ፤ ሰሎሞንም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ሮብዓም በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.fr: Roboam se rendit à Sichem, car tout Israël était venu à Sichem pour le faire roi.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሁሉ ያነግሡት ዘንድ ወደ ሴኬም መጥተው ነበርና ሮብዓም ወደ ሴኬም ሄደ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
verses.fr: Lorsque Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, eut des nouvelles, il était encore en Egypte, où il s''était enfui loin du roi Salomon, et c''était en Egypte qu''il demeurait.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ፥ እርሱም ከንጉሡ ከሰሎሞን ፊት ኰብልሎ በግብጽ ተቀምጦ ነበርና፥ በግብጽም ሳለ ልከው ጠርተውት ነበርና

verses.en: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
verses.fr: On l''envoya appeler. Alors Jéroboam et toute l''assemblée d''Israël vinrent à Roboam et lui parlèrent ainsi:
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓምና የእስራኤል ጉባኤ ሁሉ መጥተው ለሮብዓም።

verses.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
verses.fr: Ton père a rendu notre joug dur; toi maintenant, allège cette rude servitude et le joug pesant que nous a imposé ton père. Et nous te servirons.
verses.am: አባትህ ቀንበር አክብዶብን ነበር፤ አሁንም አንተ ጽኑውን የአባትህን አገዛዝ፥ በላያችንም የጫነውን የከበደውን ቀንበር አቃልልልን፤ እኛም እንገዛልሃለን ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Allez, et revenez vers moi dans trois jours. Et le peuple s''en alla.
verses.am: እርሱም። ሂዱ፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ አላቸው። ሕዝቡም ሄዱ።

verses.en: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?
verses.fr: Le roi Roboam consulta les vieillards qui avaient été auprès de Salomon, son père, pendant sa vie, et il dit: Que conseillez-vous de répondre à ce peuple?
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ እመልስለት ዘንድ የምትመክሩኝ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ አባቱ ሰሎሞን በሕይወቱ ሳለ በፊቱ ይቆሙ ከነበሩት ሽማግሌዎች ጋር ተማከረ።

verses.en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.fr: Et voici ce qu''ils lui dirent: Si aujourd''hui tu rends service à ce peuple, si tu leur cèdes, et si tu leur réponds par des paroles bienveillantes, ils seront pour toujours tes serviteurs.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ አሁን ባሪያ ብትሆን ብትገዛላቸውም፥ መልሰህም በገርነት ብትናገራቸው፥ በዘመኑ ሁሉ ባሪያዎች ይሆኑልሃል ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:
verses.fr: Mais Roboam laissa le conseil que lui donnaient les vieillards, et il consulta les jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui et qui l''entouraient.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ሽማግሌዎች የመከሩትን ምክር ትቶ ከእርሱ ጋር ካደጉትና በፊቱ ይቆሙ ከነበሩት ብላቴኖች ጋር ተማከረ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Que conseillez-vous de répondre à ce peuple qui me tient ce langage: Allège le joug que nous a imposé ton père?
verses.am: እርሱም። አባትህ የጫኑብንን ቀንበር አቃልልልን ለሚሉኝ ሕዝብ እመልስላቸው ዘንድ የምትመክሩኝ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
verses.fr: Et voici ce que lui dirent les jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui: Tu parleras ainsi à ce peuple qui t''a tenu ce langage: Ton père a rendu notre joug pesant, et toi, allège-le-nous! tu leur parleras ainsi: Mon petit doigt est plus gros que les reins de mon père.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ያደጉት ብላቴኖች። አባትህ ቀንበር አክብዶብናል፥ አንተ ግን አቃልልልን ለሚሉህ ሕዝብ። ታናሺቱ ጣቴ ከአባቴ ወገብ ትወፍራለች።

verses.en: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.fr: Maintenant, mon père vous a chargés d''un joug pesant, et moi je vous le rendrai plus pesant; mon père vous a châtiés avec des fouets, et moi je vous châtierai avec des scorpions.
verses.am: አሁንም አባቴ ከባድ ቀንበር ጭኖባችኋል፥ እኔ ግን በቀንበራችሁ ላይ እጨምራለሁ፤ አባቴ በአለንጋ ገርፎአችኋል፥ እኔ ግን በጊንጥ እገርፋችኋለሁ በላቸው ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
verses.fr: Jéroboam et tout le peuple vinrent à Roboam le troisième jour, suivant ce qu''avait dit le roi: Revenez vers moi dans trois jours.
verses.am: ንጉሡም። በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ ብሎ እንደ ተናገረ ኢዮርብዓምና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ ሮብዓም መጡ።

verses.en: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;
verses.fr: Le roi répondit durement au peuple. Il laissa le conseil que lui avaient donné les vieillards,
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሽማግሌዎች የመከሩትን ምክር ትቶ ለሕዝቡ ጽኑ ምላሽ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.fr: et il leur parla ainsi d''après le conseil des jeunes gens: Mon père a rendu votre joug pesant, et moi je vous le rendrai plus pesant; mon père vous a châtiés avec des fouets, et moi je vous châtierai avec des scorpions.
verses.am: እንደ ብላቴኖችም ምክር። አባቴ ቀንበር አክብዶባችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በቀንበራችሁ ላይ እጨምራለሁ፤ አባቴ በአለንጋ ገርፎአችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በጊንጥ እገርፋችኋለሁ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the Lord, that he might perform his saying, which the Lord spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.fr: Ainsi le roi n''écouta point le peuple; car cela fut dirigé par l''Eternel, en vue de l''accomplissement de la parole que l''Eternel avait dite par Achija de Silo à Jéroboam, fils de Nebath.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሴሎናዊው በአኪያ አድርጎ ለናባጥ ልጅ ለኢዮርብዓም የተናገረውን ነገር እንዲያጸና ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ተመድቦ ነበርና ንጉሡ ሕዝቡን አልሰማም።

verses.en: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
verses.fr: Lorsque tout Israël vit que le roi ne l''écoutait pas, le peuple répondit au roi: Quelle part avons-nous avec David? Nous n''avons point d''héritage avec le fils d''Isaï! A tes tentes, Israël! Maintenant, pourvois à ta maison, David! Et Israël s''en alla dans ses tentes.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ንጉሡ እንዳልሰማቸው ባዩ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ ለንጉሡ። በዳዊት ዘንድ ምን ክፍል አለን? በእሴይም ልጅ ዘንድ ርስት የለንም። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ወደ ድንኳኖቻችሁ ተመለሱ፤ ዳዊት ሆይ፥ አሁን ቤትህን ተመልከት ብለው መለሱለት። እስራኤልም ወደ ድንኳኖቻቸው ሄዱ።

verses.en: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël qui habitaient les villes de Juda furent les seuls sur qui régna Roboam.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ከተሞች በተቀመጡት በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ግን ሮብዓም ነገሠባቸው።

verses.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Alors le roi Roboam envoya Adoram, qui était préposé aux impôts. Mais Adoram fut lapidé par tout Israël, et il mourut. Et le roi Roboam se hâta de monter sur un char, pour s''enfuir à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም አስገባሪውን አዶኒራምን ሰደደ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በድንጋይ ደበደቡት፥ ሞተም። ንጉሡም ሮብዓም ፈጥኖ ወደ ሰረገላው ወጣ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሸሸ።

verses.en: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi qu''Israël s''est détaché de la maison de David jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: እስራኤልም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከዳዊት ቤት ሸፈተ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.fr: Tout Israël ayant appris que Jéroboam était de retour, ils l''envoyèrent appeler dans l''assemblée, et ils le firent roi sur tout Israël. La tribu de Juda fut la seule qui suivit la maison de David.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ኢዮርብዓም እንደ ተመለሰ በሰሙ ጊዜ ልከው ወደ ሸንጎአቸው ጠሩት፥ በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ላይ አነገሡት። ከብቻው ከይሁዳ ነገድ በቀረ የዳዊትን ቤት የተከተለ አንድ ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.fr: Roboam, arrivé à Jérusalem, rassembla toute la maison de Juda et la tribu de Benjamin, cent quatre-vingt mille hommes d''élite propres à la guerre, pour qu''ils combattissent contre la maison d''Israël afin de la ramener sous la domination de Roboam, fils de Salomon.
verses.am: ሮብዓምም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፥ የእስራኤልንም ቤት ወግተው መንግሥቱን ወደ ሰሎሞን ልጅ ወደ ሮብዓም ይመልሱ ዘንድ ከይሁዳ ቤት ሁሉና ከብንያም ነገድ የተመረጡትን አንድ መቶ ሰማንያ ሺህ ሰልፈኞች ሰዎች ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.fr: Mais la parole de Dieu fut ainsi adressée à Schemaeja, homme de Dieu:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ሳማያ።

verses.en: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.fr: Parle à Roboam, fils de Salomon, roi de Juda, et à toute la maison de Juda et de Benjamin, et au reste du peuple. Et dis-leur:
verses.am: ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓምና ለይሁዳ ለብንያምም ቤት ሁሉ ለቀረውም ሕዝብ ሁሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the Lord, and returned to depart, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Ne montez point, et ne faites pas la guerre à vos frères, les enfants d''Israël! Que chacun de vous retourne dans sa maison, car c''est de par moi que cette chose est arrivée. Ils obéirent à la parole de l''Eternel, et ils s''en retournèrent, selon la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ነገር ከእኔ ዘንድ ነውና አትውጡ፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ወንድሞቻችሁን አትውጉ፤ እያንዳንዱም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ ብለህ ንገራቸው ሲል መጣ። የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ሰሙ፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል ተመልሰው ሄዱ።

verses.en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
verses.fr: Jéroboam bâtit Sichem sur la montagne d''Ephraïm, et il y demeura; puis il en sortit, et bâtit Penuel.
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓምም በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ሴኬምን ሠርቶ በዚያ ተቀመጠ፤ ደግሞም ከዚያ ወጥቶ ጵኒኤልን ሠራ።

verses.en: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
verses.fr: Jéroboam dit en son coeur: Le royaume pourrait bien maintenant retourner à la maison de David.
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓምም በልቡ። አሁን መንግሥቱ ወደ ዳዊት ቤት ይመለሳል።

verses.en: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.
verses.fr: Si ce peuple monte à Jérusalem pour faire des sacrifices dans la maison de l''Eternel, le coeur de ce peuple retournera à son seigneur, à Roboam, roi de Juda, et ils me tueront et retourneront à Roboam, roi de Juda.
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝብ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት መሥዋዕትን ያቀርብ ዘንድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ቢወጣ፥ የዚህ ሕዝብ ልብ ወደ ጌታቸው ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ ሮብዓም ይመለሳል፥ እኔንም ይገድሉኛል አለ።

verses.en: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Après s''être consulté, le roi fit deux veaux d''or, et il dit au peuple: Assez longtemps vous êtes montés à Jérusalem; Israël! voici ton Dieu, qui t''a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ተማከረ፥ ሁለትም የወርቅ ጥጆች አድርጎ። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ትወጡ ዘንድ ይበዛባችኋል፤ ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጡህን አማልክቶችህን እይ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.
verses.fr: Il plaça l''un de ces veaux à Béthel, et il mit l''autre à Dan.
verses.am: አንዱን በቤቴል፥ ሁለተኛውንም በዳን አኖረ።

verses.en: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.
verses.fr: Ce fut là une occasion de péché. Le peuple alla devant l''un des veaux jusqu''à Dan.
verses.am: ለአንዱ ጥጃ ይሰግድ ዘንድ ሕዝቡ እስከ ዳን ድረስ ይሄድ ነበርና ይህ ኃጢአት ሆነ።

verses.en: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.fr: Jéroboam fit une maison de hauts lieux, et il créa des sacrificateurs pris parmi tout le peuple et n''appartenant point aux fils de Lévi.
verses.am: በኮረብቶቹም ላይ መስገጃዎች ሠራ፥ ከሌዊ ልጆች ካይደሉ ከሕዝብ ሁሉ ካህናትን አደረገ።

verses.en: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.
verses.fr: Il établit une fête au huitième mois, le quinzième jour du mois, comme la fête qui se célébrait en Juda, et il offrit des sacrifices sur l''autel. Voici ce qu''il fit à Béthel afin que l''on sacrifiât aux veaux qu''il avait faits. Il plaça à Béthel les prêtres des hauts lieux qu''il avait élevés.
verses.am: በስምንተኛው ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛውም ቀን በይሁዳ እንደሚደረግ በዓል ያለ በዓል አደረገ፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ ሠዋ፤ ለሠራቸውም ጥጆች ይሠዋ ዘንድ እንዲሁ በቤቴል አደረገ፤ ለኮረብታ መስገጃዎችም የመረጣቸውን ካህናት በቤቴል አኖራቸው።

verses.en: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
verses.fr: Et il monta sur l''autel qu''il avait fait à Béthel, le quinzième jour du huitième mois, mois qu''il avait choisi de son gré. Il fit une fête pour les enfants d''Israël, et il monta sur l''autel pour brûler des parfums.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን በልቡ ባሰበው ቀን በቤቴል በሠራው መሠዊያ ላይ ሠዋ፤ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች በዓል አደረገላቸው፤ በመሠዊያውም ሠዋ፥ ዕጣንም ዐጠነ። a

verses.en: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the Lord unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
verses.fr: Voici, un homme de Dieu arriva de Juda à Béthel, par la parole de l''Eternel, pendant que Jéroboam se tenait à l''autel pour brûler des parfums.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ከይሁዳ ወደ ቤቴል መጣ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም ዕጣን እያጠነ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And he cried against the altar in the word of the Lord, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the Lord; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.
verses.fr: Il cria contre l''autel, par la parole de l''Eternel, et il dit: Autel! autel! ainsi parle l''Eternel: Voici, il naîtra un fils à la maison de David; son nom sera Josias; il immolera sur toi les prêtres des hauts lieux qui brûlent sur toi des parfums, et l''on brûlera sur toi des ossements d''hommes!
verses.am: በመሠዊያውም ላይ። መሠዊያ ሆይ፥ መሠዊያ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ስሙ ኢዮስያስ የሚባል ልጅ ለዳዊት ቤት ይወለዳል፤ ዕጣንም የሚያጥኑብህን የኮረብታ መስገጃዎቹን ካህናት ይሠዋብሃል፥ የሰዎቹንም አጥንት ያቃጥልብሃል ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ጮኸ።

verses.en: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the Lord hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
verses.fr: Et le même jour il donna un signe, en disant: C''est ici le signe que l''Eternel a parlé: Voici, l''autel se fendra, et la cendre qui est dessus sera répandue.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን። እግዚአብሔር የተናገረው ምልክት ይህ ነው፤ እነሆ፥ መሠዊያው ይሰነጠቃል፥ በላዩም ያለው አመድ ይፈስሳል ብሎ ምልክት ሰጠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
verses.fr: Lorsque le roi entendit la parole que l''homme de Dieu avait criée contre l''autel de Béthel, il avança la main de dessus l''autel, en disant: Saisissez le! Et la main que Jéroboam avait étendue contre lui devint sèche, et il ne put la ramener à soi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በቤቴል ባለው መሠዊያ ላይ የጮኸውን ነገር በሰማ ጊዜ፥ ኢዮርብዓም እጁን ከመሠዊያው አንሥቶ። ያዙት አለ። በእርሱም ላይ የዘረጋት እጅ ደረቀች፥ ወደ እርሱም ይመልሳት ዘንድ አልተቻለውም።

verses.en: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.
verses.fr: L''autel se fendit, et la cendre qui était dessus fut répandue, selon le signe qu''avait donné l''homme de Dieu, par la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ሰጠው ምልክት መሠዊያው ተሰነጠቀ፥ አመዱም ከመሠዊያው ፈሰሰ።

verses.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the Lord thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the Lord, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
verses.fr: Alors le roi prit la parole, et dit à l''homme de Dieu: Implore l''Eternel, ton Dieu, et prie pour moi, afin que je puisse retirer ma main. L''homme de Dieu implora l''Eternel, et le roi put retirer sa main, qui fut comme auparavant.
verses.am: ንጉሡም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው። አሁን የአምላክህን የእግዚአብሔርን ፊት ለምን፥ እጄም ወደ እኔ ትመለስ ዘንድ ስለ እኔ ጸልይ አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ለመነ፥ የንጉሡም እጅ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሰች፥ እንደ ቀድሞም ሆነች።

verses.en: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
verses.fr: Le roi dit à l''homme de Dieu: Entre avec moi dans la maison, tu prendras quelque nourriture, et je te donnerai un présent.
verses.am: ንጉሡም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ቤቴ ና እንጀራም ብላ፥ በረከትም እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
verses.fr: L''homme de Dieu dit au roi: Quand tu me donnerais la moitié de ta maison, je n''entrerais pas avec toi. Je ne mangerai point de pain, et je ne boirai point d''eau dans ce lieu-ci;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ንጉሡን። የቤትህን እኩሌታ እንኳ ብትሰጠኝ ከአንተ ጋር አልገባም፥ በዚህም ስፍራ እንጀራ አልበላም፥ ውኃም አልጠጣም፤

verses.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the Lord, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.
verses.fr: car cet ordre m''a été donné, par la parole de l''Eternel: Tu ne mangeras point de pain et tu ne boiras point d''eau, et tu ne prendras pas à ton retour le chemin par lequel tu seras allé.
verses.am: እንጀራ አትብላ፥ ውኃም አትጠጣ፥ በመጣህበትም መንገድ አትመለስ በሚል በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ታዝዤአለሁና አለው።

verses.en: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.
verses.fr: Et il s''en alla par un autre chemin, il ne prit pas à son retour le chemin par lequel il était venu à Béthel.
verses.am: በሌላም መንገድ ሄደ፥ ወደ ቤቴልም በመጣበት መንገድ አልተመለሰም።

verses.en: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
verses.fr: Or il y avait un vieux prophète qui demeurait à Béthel. Ses fils vinrent lui raconter toutes les choses que l''homme de Dieu avait faites à Béthel ce jour-là, et les paroles qu''il avait dites au roi. Lorsqu''ils en eurent fait le récit à leur père,
verses.am: በቤቴልም አንድ ሽማግሌ ነቢይ ይቀመጥ ነበር፤ ልጆቹም ወደ እርሱ መጥተው በዚያ ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በቤቴል ያደረገውን ሥራ ሁሉ ነገሩት ደግሞም ለንጉሡ የተናገረውን ቃል ሁሉ ለአባታቸው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
verses.fr: il leur dit: Par quel chemin s''en est-il allé? Ses fils avaient vu par quel chemin s''en était allé l''homme de Dieu qui était venu de Juda.
verses.am: አባታቸውም። በማናቸው መንገድ ሄደ? አላቸው። ልጆቹም ከይሁዳ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ሰው የሄደበትን መንገድ አመለከቱት።

verses.en: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
verses.fr: Et il dit à ses fils: Sellez-moi l''âne. Ils lui sellèrent l''âne, et il monta dessus.
verses.am: ልጆቹንም። አህያውን ጫኑልኝ አላቸው፤ አህያውንም በጫኑለት ጊዜ ተቀመጠበት።

verses.en: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
verses.fr: Il alla après l''homme de Dieu, et il le trouva assis sous un térébinthe. Il lui dit: Es-tu l''homme de Dieu qui est venu de Juda? Il répondit: Je le suis.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም ሰው በኋላ ሄደ፤ በአድባርም ዛፍ በታች ተቀምጦ አገኘውና። ከይሁዳ የመጣህ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው አንተ ነህን? አለው። እርሱም። እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.en: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
verses.fr: Alors il lui dit: Viens avec moi à la maison, et tu prendras quelque nourriture.
verses.am: እርሱም። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ቤቴ ና፥ እንጀራም ብላ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
verses.fr: Mais il répondit: Je ne puis ni retourner avec toi, ni entrer chez toi. Je ne mangerai point de pain, je ne boirai point d''eau avec toi en ce lieu-ci;
verses.am: እርሱም። ከአንተ ጋር እመለስና እገባ ዘንድ አይቻለኝም፤ በዚህም ስፍራ ከአንተ ጋር እንጀራ አልበላም፥ ውኃም አልጠጣም፤

verses.en: For it was said to me by the word of the Lord, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
verses.fr: car il m''a été dit, par la parole de l''Eternel: Tu n''y mangeras point de pain et tu n''y boiras point d''eau, et tu ne prendras pas à ton retour le chemin par lequel tu seras allé.
verses.am: በዚያ እንጀራ አትብላ፥ ውኃም አትጠጣ፥ በመጣህበትም መንገድ አትመለስ በሚል በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ተብሎልኛልና አለ።

verses.en: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the Lord, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
verses.fr: Et il lui dit: Moi aussi, je suis prophète comme toi; et un ange m''a parlé de la part de l''Eternel, et m''a dit: Ramène-le avec toi dans ta maison, et qu''il mange du pain et boive de l''eau. Il lui mentait.
verses.am: እርሱም። እኔ ደግሞ እንደ አንተ ነቢይ ነኝ፤ መልአክም። እንጀራ ይበላ ዘንድ ውኃም ይጠጣ ዘንድ ከአንተ ጋር ወደ ቤትህ መልሰው ብሎ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ተናገረኝ አለው። ዋሽቶም ተናገረው።

verses.en: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.fr: L''homme de Dieu retourna avec lui, et il mangea du pain et but de l''eau dans sa maison.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ተመለሰ፥ በቤቱም እንጀራ በላ፥ ውኃም ጠጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the Lord came unto the prophet that brought him back:
verses.fr: Comme ils étaient assis à table, la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée au prophète qui l''avait ramené.
verses.am: በማዕድም ተቀምጠው ሳሉ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ መለሰው ነቢይ መጣ፤

verses.en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the Lord, and hast not kept the commandment which the Lord thy God commanded thee,
verses.fr: Et il cria à l''homme de Dieu qui était venu de Juda: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Parce que tu as été rebelle à l''ordre de l''Eternel, et que tu n''as pas observé le commandement que l''Eternel, ton Dieu, t''avait donné;
verses.am: ከይሁዳም ወደ መጣው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በእግዚአብሔር አፍ ላይ ዐምፀሃልና፥ አምላክህም እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘህን ትእዛዝ አልጠበቅህምና፥

verses.en: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the Lord did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
verses.fr: parce que tu es retourné, et que tu as mangé du pain et bu de l''eau dans le lieu dont il t''avait dit: Tu n''y mangeras point de pain et tu n''y boiras point d''eau, -ton cadavre n''entrera pas dans le sépulcre de tes pères.
verses.am: ተመልሰህም። እንጀራ አትብላ፥ ውኃም አትጠጣ ባለህ ስፍራ እንጀራ በልተሃልና፥ ውኃም ጠጥተሃልና ሬሳህ ወደ አባቶችህ መቃብር አይደርስም ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.fr: Et quand le prophète qu''il avait ramené eut mangé du pain et qu''il eut bu de l''eau, il sella l''âne pour lui.
verses.am: እንጀራም ከበላ፥ ውኃም ከጠጣ በኋላ አህያውን ጫነለት።

verses.en: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
verses.fr: L''homme de Dieu s''en alla: et il fut rencontré dans le chemin par un lion qui le tua. Son cadavre était étendu dans le chemin; l''âne resta près de lui, et le lion se tint à côté du cadavre.
verses.am: ተመልሶም በሄደ ጊዜ በመንገዱ ላይ አንበሳ አግኝቶ ገደለው፤ ሬሳውም በመንገድ ላይ ተጋድሞ ነበር፥ አህያውም በእርሱ አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር፤ አንበሳውም ደግሞ በሬሳው አጠገብ ቆሞ ነበር።

verses.en: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.fr: Et voici, des gens qui passaient virent le cadavre étendu dans le chemin et le lion se tenant à côté du cadavre; et ils en parlèrent à leur arrivée dans la ville où demeurait le vieux prophète.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ መንገድ አላፊ ሰዎች ሬሳው በመንገዱ ወድቆ አንበሳውም በሬሳው አጠገብ ቆሞ አዩ መጥተውም ሽማግሌው ነቢይ ተቀምጦባት በነበረው ከተማ አወሩ።

verses.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the Lord: therefore the Lord hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake unto him.
verses.fr: Lorsque le prophète qui avait ramené du chemin l''homme de Dieu l''eut appris, il dit: C''est l''homme de Dieu qui a été rebelle à l''ordre de l''Eternel, et l''Eternel l''a livré au lion, qui l''a déchiré et l''a fait mourir, selon la parole que l''Eternel lui avait dite.
verses.am: ያም ከመንገድ የመለሰው ነቢይ ያን በሰማ ጊዜ። በእግዚአብሔር አፍ ላይ ያመፀ ያ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተናገረው ቃል፥ እግዚአብሔር ለአንበሳ አሳልፎ ሰጥቶታል፤ ሰብሮም ገድሎታል አለ።

verses.en: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
verses.fr: Puis, s''adressant à ses fils, il dit: Sellez-moi l''âne. Ils le sellèrent,
verses.am: ልጆቹንም። አህያ ጫኑልኝ አላቸው፤ እነርሱም ጫኑለት።

verses.en: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
verses.fr: et il partit. Il trouva le cadavre étendu dans le chemin, et l''âne et le lion qui se tenaient à côté du cadavre. Le lion n''avait pas dévoré le cadavre et n''avait pas déchiré l''âne.
verses.am: ሄደም፥ ሬሳውም በመንገድ ወድቆ፥ በሬሳውም አጠገብ አህያውና አንበሳው ቆመው፥ አንበሳው ሬሳውን ሳይበላው፥ አህያውንም ሳይሰብረው አገኘ።

verses.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
verses.fr: Le prophète releva le cadavre de l''homme de Dieu, le plaça sur l''âne, et le ramena; et le vieux prophète rentra dans la ville pour le pleurer et pour l''enterrer.
verses.am: ነቢዩም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው ሬሳ አነሣ፥ በአህያውም ላይ ጭኖ መለሰው፤ ያለቅስለትና ይቀብረው ዘንድ ወደ ገዛ ከተማው ይዞት መጣ።

verses.en: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
verses.fr: Il mit son cadavre dans le sépulcre, et l''on pleura sur lui, en disant: Hélas, mon frère!
verses.am: ሬሳውንም በገዛ መቃብሩ አኖረው፤ ዋይ ዋይ ወንድሜ ሆይ እያሉ አለቀሱለት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
verses.fr: Après l''avoir enterré, il dit à ses fils: Quand je serai mort, vous m''enterrerez dans le sépulcre où est enterré l''homme de Dieu, vous déposerez mes os à côté de ses os.
verses.am: ከቀበረውም በኋላ ልጆቹን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው። በሞትሁ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው በተቀበረበት መቃብር ቅበሩኝ፤ አጥንቶቼንም በአጥንቶቹ አጠገብ አኑሩ፤

verses.en: For the saying which he cried by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
verses.fr: Car elle s''accomplira, la parole qu''il a criée, de la part de l''Eternel, contre l''autel de Béthel et contre toutes les maisons des hauts lieux qui sont dans les villes de Samarie.
verses.am: በቤቴል ባለው መሠዊያ ላይ፥ በሰማርያም ከተሞች ውስጥ ባሉ በኮረብታዎቹ መስገጃዎች ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ቃል የጮኸው ነገር በእውነት ይደርሳልና።

verses.en: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
verses.fr: Après cet événement, Jéroboam ne se détourna point de sa mauvaise voie. Il créa de nouveau des prêtres des hauts lieux pris parmi tout le peuple; quiconque en avait le désir, il le consacrait prêtre des hauts lieux.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢዮርብዓም ከክፉ መንገድ አልተመለሰም፥ ነገር ግን ለኮረብታዎቹ መስገጃዎች አብልጦ ከሕዝብ ሁሉ ካህናትን አደረገ፤ የሚወድደውንም ሁሉ ይቀድስ ነበር፥ እርሱም ለኮርብታዎቹ መስገጃዎች ካህን ይሆን ነበር።

verses.en: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
verses.fr: Ce fut là une occasion de péché pour la maison de Jéroboam, et c''est pour cela qu''elle a été exterminée et détruite de dessus la face de la terre.
verses.am: እስኪፈርስም ከምድርም እስኪጠፋ ድረስ ይህ ነገር ለኢዮርብዓም ቤት ኃጢአት ሆነ።

verses.en: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
verses.fr: Dans ce temps-là, Abija, fils de Jéroboam, devint malade.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት የኢዮርብዓም ልጅ አብያ ታመመ።

verses.en: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.
verses.fr: Et Jéroboam dit à sa femme: Lève-toi, je te prie, et déguise-toi pour qu''on ne sache pas que tu es la femme de Jéroboam, et va à Silo. Voici, là est Achija, le prophète; c''est lui qui m''a dit que je serais roi de ce peuple.
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓምም ሚስቱን። ተነሺ፥ የኢዮርብዓምም ሚስት እንደ ሆንሽ እንዳትታወቂ ልብስሽን ለውጪና ወደ ሴሎ ሂጂ፤ እነሆ፥ በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ እንድነግሥ የነገረኝ ነቢዩ አኪያ በዚያ አለ።

verses.en: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.
verses.fr: Prends avec toi dix pains, des gâteaux et un vase de miel, et entre chez lui; il te dira ce qui arrivera à l''enfant.
verses.am: በእጅሽም አሥር እንጀራና እንጎቻዎች አንድም ምንቸት ማር ይዘሽ ወደ እርሱ ሂጂ፤ በልጁም የሚሆነውን ይነግርሻል አላት።

verses.en: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
verses.fr: La femme de Jéroboam fit ainsi; elle se leva, alla à Silo, et entra dans la maison d''Achija. Achija ne pouvait plus voir, car il avait les yeux fixes par suite de la vieillesse.
verses.am: የኢዮርብዓምም ሚስት እንዲሁ አደረገች፥ ተነሥታም ወደ ሴሎ ሄደች፤ ወደ አኪያም ቤት መጣች። አኪያም ስለ መሸምገሉ ዓይኖቹ ፈዝዘው ነበርና፤ ማየት አልቻለም።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.
verses.fr: L''Eternel avait dit à Achija: La femme de Jéroboam va venir te consulter au sujet de son fils, parce qu''il est malade. Tu lui parleras de telle et de telle manière. Quand elle arrivera, elle se donnera pour une autre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አኪያን። እነሆ፥ ስለ ታመመው ልጅዋ ትጠይቅህ ዘንድ የኢዮርብዓም ሚስት ትመጣለች፤ ሌላ ሴትም መስላ ተሰውራለችና በገባች ጊዜ እንዲህና እንዲህ በላት አለው።

verses.en: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.
verses.fr: Lorsque Achija entendit le bruit de ses pas, au moment où elle franchissait la porte, il dit: Entre, femme de Jéroboam; pourquoi veux-tu te donner pour une autre? Je suis chargé de t''annoncer des choses dures.
verses.am: እርስዋም በደጅ ስትገባ አኪያ የእግርዋን ኮቴ ሰማ፥ እንዲህም አለ። የኢዮርብዓም ሚስት ሆይ፥ ግቢ፤ ስለ ምንስ ሌላ ሴት መሰልሽ? እኔም ብርቱ ወሬ ይዤ ተልኬልሻለሁ።

verses.en: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,
verses.fr: Va, dis à Jéroboam: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: Je t''ai élevé du milieu du peuple, je t''ai établi chef de mon peuple d''Israël,
verses.am: ሂጂ፥ ለኢዮርብዓምም እንዲህ በዪው። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ከሕዝብ መካከል ለይቼ ከፍ አድርጌህ ነበር፥ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ አድርጌህ ነበር፥

verses.en: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;
verses.fr: j''ai arraché le royaume de la maison de David et je te l''ai donné. Et tu n''as pas été comme mon serviteur David, qui a observé mes commandements et qui a marché après moi de tout son coeur, ne faisant que ce qui est droit à mes yeux.
verses.am: ከዳዊትም ቤት መንግሥቱን ቀድጄ ሰጥቼህ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በፍጹም ልቡ እንደ ተከተለኝ፥ በፊቴም ቅን ነገር ብቻ እንዳደረገ፥ ትእዛዜንም እንደ ጠበቀ እንደ ባሪያዬ እንደ ዳዊት አልሆንህም።

verses.en: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:
verses.fr: Tu as agi plus mal que tous ceux qui ont été avant toi, tu es allé te faire d''autres dieux, et des images de fonte pour m''irriter, et tu m''as rejeté derrière ton dos!
verses.am: ከአንተም አስቀድመው ከነበሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ ክፉ ሠራህ፤ ታስቈጣኝም ዘንድ ሄደህ ሌሎችን አማልክትና ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎች አደረግህ፥ ወደ ኋላህም ጣልኸኝ።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.
verses.fr: Voilà pourquoi je vais faire venir le malheur sur la maison de Jéroboam; j''exterminerai quiconque appartient à Jéroboam, celui qui est esclave et celui qui est libre en Israël, et je balaierai la maison de Jéroboam comme on balaie les ordures, jusqu''à ce qu''elle ait disparu.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ በኢዮርብዓም ቤት ላይ መከራ አመጣለሁ፥ ከኢዮርብአምም በእስራኤል ዘንድ የታሰረውንና የተለቀቀውን ወንድ ሁሉ እቈርጣለሁ፤ ሰውም ፋንድያን እስኪጠፋ ድረስ እንደሚጠርግ እኔ የኢዮርብዓምን ቤት ፈጽሜ እጠርጋለሁ።

verses.en: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.fr: Celui de la maison de Jéroboam qui mourra dans la ville sera mangé par les chiens, et celui qui mourra dans les champs sera mangé par les oiseaux du ciel. Car l''Eternel a parlé.
verses.am: ከኢዮርብዓምም ወገን በከተማይቱ ውስጥ የሞተውን ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በሜዳውም የሞተውን የሰማይ ወፎች ይበሉታል፤ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና።

verses.en: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
verses.fr: Et toi, lève-toi, va dans ta maison. Dès que tes pieds entreront dans la ville, l''enfant mourra.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ተነሥተሽ ወደ ቤትሽ ሂጂ፤ እግርሽም ወደ ከተማ በገባ ጊዜ ልጁ ይሞታል።

verses.en: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the Lord God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
verses.fr: Tout Israël le pleurera, et on l''enterrera; car il est le seul de la maison de Jéroboam qui sera mis dans un sépulcre, parce qu''il est le seul de la maison de Jéroboam en qui se soit trouvé quelque chose de bon devant l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ያለቅሱለታል፥ ይቀብሩትማል፤ በእስራኤል አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በኢዮርብዓም ቤት በዚህ ልጅ መልካም ነገር ተገኝቶበታልና ከኢዮርብዓም እርሱ ብቻ ይቀበራል።

verses.en: Moreover the Lord shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
verses.fr: L''Eternel établira sur Israël un roi qui exterminera la maison de Jéroboam ce jour-là. Et n''est-ce pas déjà ce qui arrive?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ያስነሣል፤ እርሱም በዚያ ዘመን የኢዮርብዓምን ቤት ያጠፋል።

verses.en: For the Lord shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the Lord to anger.
verses.fr: L''Eternel frappera Israël, et il en sera de lui comme du roseau qui est agité dans les eaux; il arrachera Israël de ce bon pays qu''il avait donné à leurs pères, et il les dispersera de l''autre côté du fleuve, parce qu''ils se sont fait des idoles, irritant l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜም ሸምበቆ በውኃ ውስጥ እንደሚንቀሳቀስ እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ እስራኤልን ይመታል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያስቈጡ ዘንድ የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ተክለዋልና ለአባቶቻቸው ከሰጣቸው ከዚች ከመልካሚቱ ምድር እስራኤልን ይነቅላል፥ በወንዙም ማዶ ይበትናቸዋል።

verses.en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: Il livrera Israël à cause des péchés que Jéroboam a commis et qu''il a fait commettre à Israël.
verses.am: ስለ በደለውና እስራኤልንም ስላሳተበት ስለ ኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት እስራኤልን ይጥላል።

verses.en: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
verses.fr: La femme de Jéroboam se leva, et partit. Elle arriva à Thirtsa; et, comme elle atteignait le seuil de la maison, l''enfant mourut.
verses.am: የኢዮርብዓምም ሚስት ተነሥታ ሄደች፥ ወደ ቴርሳ መጣች፤ ወደ ቤቱም መድረክ በገባች ጊዜ ልጁ ሞተ።

verses.en: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.
verses.fr: On l''enterra, et tout Israël le pleura, selon la parole que l''Eternel avait dite par son serviteur Achija, le prophète.
verses.am: በባሪያውም በነቢዩ በአኪያ እንደ ተነገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል እስራኤል ሁሉ ቀበሩት አለቀሱለትም።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Jéroboam, comment il fit la guerre et comment il régna, cela est écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël.
verses.am: የቀረውም የኢዮርብዓም ነገር፥ እንዴት እንደ ተዋጋ፥ እንዴትም እንደ ነገሠ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Jéroboam régna vingt-deux ans, puis il se coucha avec ses pères. Et Nadab, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓምም የነገሠበት ዘመን ሀያ ሁለት ዓመት ነበረ፤ ከአባቶቹም ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ ልጁም ናዳብ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.fr: Roboam, fils de Salomon, régna sur Juda. Il avait quarante et un ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna dix-sept ans à Jérusalem, la ville que l''Eternel avait choisie sur toutes les tribus d''Israël pour y mettre son nom. Sa mère s''appelait Naama, l''Ammonite.
verses.am: የሰሎሞንም ልጅ ሮብዓም በይሁዳ ነገሠ፤ ሮብዓምም ንጉሥ በሆነ ጊዜ የአርባ አንድ ዓመት ጉልማሳ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ስሙን ያኖርባት ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ በመረጣት ከተማ በኢየሩሳሌም አሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ የእናቱም ስም ናዕማ ነበረ፤ እርስዋም አሞናዊት ነበረች።

verses.en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the Lord, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.
verses.fr: Juda fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel; et, par les péchés qu''ils commirent, ils excitèrent sa jalousie plus que ne l''avaient jamais fait leurs pères.
verses.am: ይሁዳም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ሠራ፤ አባቶቻቸውም ከሠሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ አብዝተው በሠሩት ኃጢአት አስቈጡት።

verses.en: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
verses.fr: Ils se bâtirent, eux aussi, des hauts lieux avec des statues et des idoles sur toute colline élevée et sous tout arbre vert.
verses.am: እነርሱም ደግሞ ከፍ ባለው ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ፥ ቅጠሉ ከለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች መስገጃዎችንና ሐውልቶችን የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችንም ለራሳቸው ሠሩ።

verses.en: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Il y eut même des prostitués dans le pays. Ils imitèrent toutes les abominations des nations que l''Eternel avait chassées devant les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በምድርም ውስጥ ሰዶማውያን ነበሩ፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ፊት እግዚአብሔር ያሳደዳቸውን የአሕዛብን ርኵሰት ሁሉ ያደርጉ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
verses.fr: La cinquième année du règne de Roboam, Schischak, roi d''Egypte, monta contre Jérusalem.
verses.am: ሮብዓምም በነገሠ በአምስተኛው ዓመት የግብጽ ንጉሥ ሺሻቅ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ መጣ።

verses.en: And he took away the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.fr: Il prit les trésors de la maison de l''Eternel et les trésors de la maison du roi, il prit tout. Il prit tous les boucliers d''or que Salomon avait faits.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት መዛግብትንና የንጉሥ ቤት መዛግብትን ወሰደ፤ ሁሉንም ወሰደ፤ ሰሎሞንም የሠራውን የወርቁን ጋሻ ሁሉ ወሰደ።

verses.en: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king's house.
verses.fr: Le roi Roboam fit à leur place des boucliers d''airain, et il les remit aux soins des chefs des coureurs, qui gardaient l''entrée de la maison du roi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም በፋንታው የናስ ጋሾችን ሠራ፥ የንጉሥንም ቤት ደጅ በሚጠብቁ በዘበኞች አለቆች እጅ አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the Lord, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
verses.fr: Toutes les fois que le roi allait à la maison de l''Eternel, les coureurs les portaient; puis ils les rapportaient dans la chambre des coureurs.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ዘወትር ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ሲገባ ዘበኞች ይሸከሙአቸው ነበር፤ መልሰውም በዘበኞች ቤት ውስጥ ያኖሩአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Roboam, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda?
verses.am: የቀረውም የሮብዓም ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
verses.fr: Il y eut toujours guerre entre Roboam et Jéroboam.
verses.am: በዘመኑም ሁሉ በሮብዓምና በኢዮርብዓም መካከል ሰልፍ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Roboam se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré avec ses pères dans la ville de David. Sa mère s''appelait Naama, l''Ammonite. Et Abijam, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ሮብዓምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ። ልጁም አብያም በፋንታው ነገሠ። a

verses.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
verses.fr: La dix-huitième année du règne de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, Abijam régna sur Juda.
verses.am: የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም በነገሠ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት አብያም በይሁዳ ላይ ንጉሥ ሆነ።

verses.en: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. and his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.fr: Il régna trois ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Maaca, fille d''Abisalom.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም መዓካ የተባለች የአቤሴሎም ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as the heart of David his father.
verses.fr: Il se livra à tous les péchés que son père avait commis avant lui; et son coeur ne fut point tout entier à l''Eternel, son Dieu, comme l''avait été le coeur de David, son père.
verses.am: ከእርሱ አስቀድሞ ባደረገው በአባቱ ኃጢአት ሁሉ ሄደ፤ ልቡም እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት ልብ ከአምላኩ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ፍጹም አልነበረም።

verses.en: Nevertheless for David's sake did the Lord his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
verses.fr: Mais à cause de David, l''Eternel, son Dieu, lui donna une lampe à Jérusalem, en établissant son fils après lui et en laissant subsister Jérusalem.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ልጁን ከእርሱ በኋላ ያስነሣ ዘንድ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ያጸና ዘንድ አምላኩ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ዳዊት በኢየሩሳሌም መብራት ሰጠው፤

verses.en: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.fr: Car David avait fait ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, et il ne s''était détourné d''aucun de ses commandements pendant toute sa vie, excepté dans l''affaire d''Urie, le Héthien.
verses.am: ዳዊት በዘመኑ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አድርጎ ነበርና፥ ካዘዘውም ነገር ሁሉ ፈቀቅ አላለም ነበርና።

verses.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
verses.fr: Il y eut guerre entre Roboam et Jéroboam, tant que vécut Roboam.
verses.am: በኢዮርብዓምና በሮብዓም ልጅ በአብያም መካከል በዘመኑ ሁሉ ጠብ ነበረ።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.fr: Le reste des actions d''Abijam, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda? Il y eut guerre entre Abijam et Jéroboam.
verses.am: የቀረውም የአብያም ነገር፥ ያደርገውም ሁሉ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? በአብያምና በኢዮርብዓምም መካከል ሰልፍ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Abijam se coucha avec ses pères, et on l''enterra dans la ville de David. Et Asa, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: አብያምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ቀበሩት። ልጁም አሳ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
verses.fr: La vingtième année de Jéroboam, roi d''Israël, Asa régna sur Juda.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኢዮርብዓም በሀያኛውም ዓመት አሳ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.fr: Il régna quarante et un ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Maaca, fille d''Abisalom.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም አርባ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም መዓካ የተባለች የአቤሴሎም ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, as did David his father.
verses.fr: Asa fit ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, comme David, son père.
verses.am: አሳ እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.en: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
verses.fr: Il ôta du pays les prostitués, et il fit disparaître toutes les idoles que ses pères avaient faites.
verses.am: ከአገሩም ሰዶማውያንን አስወገደ፥ አባቶቹም ያደረጉትን ጣዖታትን ሁሉ አራቀ።

verses.en: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
verses.fr: Et même il enleva la dignité de reine à Maaca, sa mère, parce qu''elle avait fait une idole pour Astarté. Asa abattit son idole, et la brûla au torrent de Cédron.
verses.am: በማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ጣዖት ስለሠራች እናቱን መዓካን እቴጌ እንዳትሆን ሻራት፤ ጣዖትዋንም ሰበረው፥ በቄድሮንም ፈፋ አጠገብ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the Lord all his days.
verses.fr: Mais les hauts lieux ne disparurent point, quoique le coeur d''Asa fût en entier à l''Eternel pendant toute sa vie.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኮረብቶች ላይ ያሉትን መስገጃዎች አላራቀም፤ የአሳ ልብ ግን በዘመኑ ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ፍጹም ነበረ።

verses.en: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the Lord, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.fr: Il mit dans la maison de l''Eternel les choses consacrées par son père et par lui-même, de l''argent, de l''or et des vases.
verses.am: አባቱ የቀደሰውንና እርሱም የቀደሰውን ወርቅና ብር ዕቃውንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አገባው።

verses.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.fr: Il y eut guerre entre Asa et Baescha, roi d''Israël, pendant toute leur vie.
verses.am: በአሳና በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በባኦስ መካከል በዘመናቸው ሁሉ ሰልፍ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.fr: Baescha, roi d''Israël, monta contre Juda; et il bâtit Rama, pour empêcher ceux d''Asa, roi de Juda, de sortir et d''entrer.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ባኦስ በይሁዳ ላይ ወጣ፤ ከይሁዳ ንጉሥ ከአሳ ዘንድ ማንም እንዳይወጣ ወደ እርሱም ማንም እንዳይገባ አድርጎ ራማን ሠራ።

verses.en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.fr: Asa prit tout l''argent et tout l''or qui étaient restés dans les trésors de la maison de l''Eternel et les trésors de la maison du roi, et il les mit entre les mains de ses serviteurs qu''il envoya vers Ben-Hadad, fils de Thabrimmon, fils de Hezjon, roi de Syrie, qui habitait à Damas. Le roi Asa lui fit dire:
verses.am: አሳም በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በንጉሥ ቤት መዛግብት የቀረውን ብርና ወርቅ ሁሉ ወስዶ በባሪያዎቹ እጅ ሰጣቸው፤ ንጉሡም አሳ በደማስቆ ለተቀመጠው ለአዚን ልጅ ለጠብሪሞን ልጅ ለሶርያ ንጉሥ ለወልደ አዴር።

verses.en: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.fr: Qu''il y ait une alliance entre moi et toi, comme il y en eut une entre mon père et ton père. Voici, je t''envoie un présent en argent et en or. Va, romps ton alliance avec Baescha, roi d''Israël, afin qu''il s''éloigne de moi.
verses.am: በእኔና በአንተ መካከል በአባቴና በአባትህም መካከል ቃል ኪዳን ጸንቶአል፤ እነሆ፥ ብርና ወርቅ ገጸ በረከት ሰድጄልሃለሁ፤ እርሱ ከእኔ ዘንድ እንዲርቅ ሄደህ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከባኦስ ጋር ያለህን ቃል ኪዳን አፍርስ ብሎ ሰደደ።

verses.en: So Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.fr: Ben-Hadad écouta le roi Asa; il envoya les chefs de son armée contre les villes d''Israël, et il battit Ijjon, Dan, Abel-Beth-Maaca, tout Kinneroth, et tout le pays de Nephthali.
verses.am: ወልደ አዴርም ለንጉሡ ለአሳ እሺ አለው፤ የሠራዊቱንም አለቆች በእስራኤል ከተሞች ላይ ሰድዶ ዒዮንንና ዳንን፥ አቤልቤት መዓካንና ኪኔሬትን ሁሉ የንፍታሌምንም አገር ሁሉ መታ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
verses.fr: Lorsque Baescha l''apprit, il cessa de bâtir Rama, et il resta à Thirtsa.
verses.am: ባኦስም ያን በሰማ ጊዜ ራማን መሥራት ትቶ በቴርሳ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.fr: Le roi Asa convoqua tout Juda, sans exempter personne, et ils emportèrent les pierres et le bois que Baescha employait à la construction de Rama; et le roi Asa s''en servit pour bâtir Guéba de Benjamin et Mitspa.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አሳ በይሁዳ ሁሉ ላይ አዋጅ ነገረ፤ ማንም ነጻ አልነበረም፤ ባኦስም የሠራበትን የራማን ድንጋይና እንጨት ወሰዱ፥ ንጉሡም አሳ የብንያምን ጌባንና ምጽጳን ሠራበት።

verses.en: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.fr: Le reste de toutes les actions d''Asa, tous ses exploits et tout ce qu''il a fait, et les villes qu''il a bâties, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda? Toutefois, à l''époque de sa vieillesse, il eut les pieds malades.
verses.am: የቀረውም የአሳ ነገር ሁሉ፥ ጭከናውም ሁሉ፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ የሠራቸውም ከተሞች፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? ነገር ግን በሸመገለ ጊዜ እግሮቹ ታመሙ።

verses.en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Asa se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré avec ses pères dans la ville de David, son père. Et Josaphat, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: አሳም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ። ልጁም ኢዮሣፍጥ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
verses.fr: Nadab, fils de Jéroboam, régna sur Israël, la seconde année d''Asa, roi de Juda. Il régna deux ans sur Israël.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሁለተኛው ዓመት የኢዮርብዓም ልጅ ናዳብ በእስራኤል ላይ ነገሠ፤ በእስራኤልም ላይ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel; et il marcha dans la voie de son père, se livrant aux péchés que son père avait fait commettre à Israël.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፥ በአባቱም መንገድ እስራኤልንም ባሳተበት ኃጢአት ሄደ።

verses.en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
verses.fr: Baescha, fils d''Achija, de la maison d''Issacar, conspira contre lui, et Baescha le tua à Guibbethon, qui appartenait aux Philistins, pendant que Nadab et tout Israël assiégeaient Guibbethon.
verses.am: ከይሳኮርም ቤት የሆነ የአኪያ ልጅ ባኦስ ተማማለበት፤ ናዳብና እስራኤልም ሁሉ ገባቶንን ከብበው ነበርና ባኦስ በፍልስጥኤም አገር ባለው በገባቶን ገደለው።

verses.en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Baescha le fit périr la troisième année d''Asa, roi de Juda, et il régna à sa place.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሳ በሦስተኛው ዓመት ባኦስ ናዳብን ገደለው፥ በፋንታውም ነገሠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the Lord, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut roi, il frappa toute la maison de Jéroboam, il n''en laissa échapper personne et il détruisit tout ce qui respirait, selon la parole que l''Eternel avait dite par son serviteur Achija de Silo,
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሦስተኛው ዓመት የአኪያ ልጅ ባኦስ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ በቴርሳ ንጉሥ ሆኖ ሀያ አራት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger.
verses.fr: cause des péchés que Jéroboam avait commis et qu''il avait fait commettre à Israël, irritant ainsi l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሦስተኛው ዓመት የአኪያ ልጅ ባኦስ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ በቴርሳ ንጉሥ ሆኖ ሀያ አራት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Nadab, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሦስተኛው ዓመት የአኪያ ልጅ ባኦስ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ በቴርሳ ንጉሥ ሆኖ ሀያ አራት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.fr: Il y eut guerre entre Asa et Baescha, roi d''Israël, pendant toute leur vie.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፥ በኢዮርብዓምም መንገድ እስራኤልንም ባሳተበት ኃጢአት ሄደ።

verses.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
verses.fr: La troisième année d''Asa, roi de Juda, Baescha, fils d''Achija, régna sur tout Israël à Thirtsa. Il régna vingt-quatre ans.
verses.am: ፤ በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሦስተኛው ዓመት የአኪያ ልጅ ባኦስ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ በቴርሳ ንጉሥ ሆኖ ሀያ አራት ዓመት ነገሠ።
