verses.en: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, et il marcha dans la voie de Jéroboam, se livrant aux péchés que Jéroboam avait fait commettre à Israël.
verses.am: ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፥ በኢዮርብዓምም መንገድ እስራኤልንም ባሳተበት ኃጢአት ሄደ።

verses.en: Then the word of the Lord came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel fut ainsi adressée à Jéhu, fils de Hanani, contre Baescha:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በባኦስ ላይ እንዲህ ብሎ ወደ አናኒ ልጅ ወደ ኢዩ መጣ።

verses.en: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
verses.fr: Je t''ai élevé de la poussière, et je t''ai établi chef de mon peuple d''Israël; mais parce que tu as marché dans la voie de Jéroboam, et que tu as fait pécher mon peuple d''Israël, pour m''irriter par leurs péchés,
verses.am: እኔ ከመሬት አስነሥቼ በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ አድርጌሃለሁ፤ አንተ ግን በኢዮርብዓም መንገድ ሄደሃል፥ በኃጢአታቸውም ያስቈጡኝ ዘንድ ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን አስተሃቸዋል።

verses.en: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.fr: voici, je vais balayer Baescha et sa maison, et je rendrai ta maison semblable à la maison de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath.
verses.am: ስለዚህም፥ እነሆ፥ ባኦስንና ቤቱን ፈጽሜ እጠርጋለሁ፤ ቤትህንም እንደ ናባጥ ልጅ እንደ ኢዮርብዓም ቤት አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.fr: Celui de la maison de Baescha qui mourra dans la ville sera mangé par les chiens, et celui des siens qui mourra dans les champs sera mangé par les oiseaux du ciel.
verses.am: ከባኦስም ወገን በከተማይቱ ውስጥ የሚሞተውን ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በሜዳውም የሚሞተውን የሰማይ ወፎች ይበሉታል።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Baescha, ce qu''il a fait, et ses exploits, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: የቀረውም የባኦስ ነገር፥ ሥራውና ጭከናውም፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Baescha se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré à Thirtsa. Et Ela, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ባኦስም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በቴርሳም ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ኤላ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the Lord against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the Lord, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel s''était manifestée par le prophète Jéhu, fils de Hanani, contre Baescha et contre sa maison, soit à cause de tout le mal qu''il avait fait sous les yeux de l''Eternel, en l''irritant par l''oeuvre de ses mains et en devenant semblable à la maison de Jéroboam, soit parce qu''il avait frappé la maison de Jéroboam.
verses.am: በእጁም ሥራ ያስቈጣው ዘንድ፥ እንደ ኢዮርብዓም ቤት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስላደረገው ክፋት ሁሉ እርሱንም ስለ ገደለው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በባኦስና በቤቱ ላይ ወደ አናኒ ልጅ ወደ ነቢዩ ወደ ኢዩ መጣ።

verses.en: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
verses.fr: La vingt-sixième année d''Asa, roi de Juda, Ela, fils de Baescha, régna sur Israël à Thirtsa. Il régna deux ans.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሀያ ስድስተኛው ዓመት የባኦስ ልጅ ኤላ በእስራኤል ላይ በቴርሳ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.
verses.fr: Son serviteur Zimri, chef de la moitié des chars, conspira contre lui. Ela était à Thirtsa, buvant et s''enivrant dans la maison d''Artsa, chef de la maison du roi à Thirtsa.
verses.am: የእኩሌቶቹም ሰረገሎች አለቃ ዘምሪ ተማማለበት፤ ኤላም በቴርሳ ነበረ፥ በቴርሳም በነበረው በቤት አሽከሮች አለቃ በኦሳ ቤት ይሰክር ነበር።

verses.en: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Zimri entra, le frappa et le tua, la vingt-septième année d''Asa, roi de Juda, et il régna à sa place.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሀያ ሰባተኛው ዓመት ዘምሪ ገብቶ መታው ገደለውም፥ በፋንታውም ነገሠ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut roi et qu''il fut assis sur son trône, il frappa toute la maison de Baescha, il ne laissa échapper personne qui lui appartînt, ni parent ni ami.
verses.am: ንጉሥም በሆነ ጊዜ፥ በዙፋኑም በተቀመጠ ጊዜ፥ የባኦስን ቤት ሁሉ መታ፤ ከዘመዶችና ከወዳጆች ሁሉ አንድ ወንድ እንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.en: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet.
verses.fr: Zimri détruisit toute la maison de Baescha, selon la parole que l''Eternel avait dite contre Baescha par Jéhu, le prophète,
verses.am: የቀረውም የኤላ ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.fr: cause de tous les péchés que Baescha et Ela, son fils, avaient commis et qu''ils avaient fait commettre à Israël, irritant par leurs idoles l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: የቀረውም የኤላ ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions d''Ela, et tout ce qu''il a fait, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሳ በሀያ ሰባተኛው ዓመት ዘምሪ በቴርሳ ሰባት ቀን ነገሠ። ሕዝቡም በፍልስጥኤም አገር የነበረው ገባቶንን ከብበው ነበር።

verses.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
verses.fr: La vingt-septième année d''Asa, roi de Juda, Zimri régna sept jours à Thirtsa. Le peuple campait contre Guibbethon, qui appartenait aux Philistins.
verses.am: ከተማይቱንም ከብበው የነበሩ ሕዝብ ዘምሪ እንደ ዐመፀ፥ ንጉሡንም እንደ ገደለ ሰሙ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በዚያ ቀን በሰፈሩ ውስጥ የሠራዊቱን አለቃ ዘንበሪን አነገሡ።

verses.en: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.fr: Et le peuple qui campait apprit cette nouvelle: Zimri a conspiré, et même il a tué le roi! Et ce jour-là, tout Israël établit dans le camp pour roi d''Israël Omri, chef de l''armée.
verses.am: ዘንበሪም ከእርሱም ጋር እስራኤል ሁሉ ከገባቶን ወጥተው ቴርሳን ከበቡ።

verses.en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.fr: Omri et tout Israël avec lui partirent de Guibbethon, et ils assiégèrent Thirtsa.
verses.am: ዘምሪም ከተማይቱ እንደ ተያዘች ባየ ጊዜ ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት ግንብ ውስጥ ገባ፥ የንጉሡንም ቤት በራሱ ላይ በእሳት አቃጠለ፤

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died.
verses.fr: Zimri, voyant que la ville était prise, se retira dans le palais de la maison du roi, et brûla sur lui la maison du roi. C''est ainsi qu''il mourut,
verses.am: ስላደረገውም ኃጢአት፥ እስራኤልንም ስላሳተበት ኃጢአት፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አድርጎአልና፥ በኢዮርብዓምም መንገድ ሄዶአልና ሞተ።

verses.en: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the Lord, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
verses.fr: cause des péchés qu''il avait commis en faisant ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, en marchant dans la voie de Jéroboam, et en se livrant aux péchés que Jéroboam avait commis pour faire pécher Israël.
verses.am: የቀረውም የዘምሪ ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ዐመፅ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Zimri, et la conspiration qu''il forma, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ የእስራኤል ሕዝብ በሁለት ተከፈለ፤ የሕዝቡም እኩሌታ የጎናትን ልጅ ታምኒን ያነግሡት ዘንድ ተከተለው፤ እኩሌታውም ዘንበሪን ተከተለ።

verses.en: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
verses.fr: Alors le peuple d''Israël se divisa en deux partis: une moitié du peuple voulait faire roi Thibni, fils de Guinath, et l''autre moitié était pour Omri.
verses.am: ዘንበሪንም የተከተለ ሕዝብ የጎናትን ልጅ ታምኒን በተከተለ ሕዝብ ላይ በረታ፤ ታምኒም ሞተ፥ ዘንበሪም ነገሠ።

verses.en: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
verses.fr: Ceux qui suivaient Omri l''emportèrent sur ceux qui suivaient Thibni, fils de Guinath. Thibni mourut, et Omri régna.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በአሳ በሠላሳ አንደኛው ዓመት ዘንበሪ በእስራኤል ላይ አሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ። በቴርሳም ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
verses.fr: La trente et unième année d''Asa, roi de Juda, Omri régna sur Israël. Il régna douze ans. Après avoir régné six ans à Thirtsa,
verses.am: ከሳምርም በሁለት መክሊት ብር የሰማርያን ተራራ ገዛ፤ በተራራውም ላይ ሠራ፥ የሠራውንም ከተማ በተራራው ባለቤት በሳምር ስም ሰማርያ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
verses.fr: il acheta de Schémer la montagne de Samarie pour deux talents d''argent; il bâtit sur la montagne, et il donna à la ville qu''il bâtit le nom de Samarie, d''après le nom de Schémer, seigneur de la montagne.
verses.am: ዘንበሪም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፥ ከእርሱም አስቀድሞ ከነበሩት ይልቅ እጅግ ከፋ።

verses.en: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the Lord, and did worse than all that were before him.
verses.fr: Omri fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, et il agit plus mal que tous ceux qui avaient été avant lui.
verses.am: በናባጥም ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም መንገድ ሁሉ በምናምንቴም ነገራቸው የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ያስቈጡት ዘንድ እስራኤልን ባሳተበት ኃጢአት ሄደ።

verses.en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.fr: Il marcha dans toute la voie de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, et se livra aux péchés que Jéroboam avait fait commettre à Israël, irritant par leurs idoles l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: የቀረውም ዘንበሪ ያደረገው ነገር፥ የሠራውም ጭከና፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions d''Omri, ce qu''il a fait, et ses exploits, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: ዘንበሪም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በሰማርያም ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም አክዓብ በፋንታው ነገሠ።

verses.en: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Omri se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré à Samarie. Et Achab, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ በሠላሳ ስምንተኛው ዓመት የዘንበሪ ልጅ አክዓብ በእስራኤል ላይ ነገሠ፤ የዘንበሪም ልጅ አክዓብ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማሪያ ሀያ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
verses.fr: Achab, fils d''Omri, régna sur Israël, la trente-huitième année d''Asa, roi de Juda. Achab, fils d''Omri, régna vingt-deux ans sur Israël à Samarie.
verses.am: የዘንበሪም ልጅ አክዓብ ከእርሱ በፊት ከነበሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.en: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord above all that were before him.
verses.fr: Achab, fils d''Omri, fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, plus que tous ceux qui avaient été avant lui.
verses.am: በናባጥም ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ኃጢአት መሄድ ታናሽ ነገር መሰለው፥ የሲዶናውያንንም ንጉሥ የኤትበኣልን ልጅ ኤልዛቤልን አገባ፥ ሄዶም በኣልን አመለከ ሰገደለትም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
verses.fr: Et comme si c''eût été pour lui peu de chose de se livrer aux péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, il prit pour femme Jézabel, fille d''Ethbaal, roi des Sidoniens, et il alla servir Baal et se prosterner devant lui.
verses.am: በሰማርያም በሠራው በበኣል ቤት ውስጥ ለበኣል መሠዊያ አቆመ።

verses.en: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
verses.fr: Il éleva un autel à Baal dans la maison de Baal qu''il bâtit à Samarie,
verses.am: አክዓብም የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ተከለ፤ አክዓብም ከእርሱ በፊት ከነበሩት ሁሉ ይልቅ የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያስቈጣውን ነገር አበዛ።

verses.en: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.fr: et il fit une idole d''Astarté. Achab fit plus encore que tous les rois d''Israël qui avaient été avant lui, pour irriter l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: በእርሱም ዘመን የቤቴል ሰው አኪኤል ኢያሪኮን ሠራ፤ በነዌም ልጅ በኢያሱ እጅ እንደ ተነገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል፥ በበኵር ልጅ በአቢሮን መሠረትዋን አደረገ፥ በታናሹ ልጁም በሠጉብ በሮችዋን አቆመ። a

verses.en: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.fr: De son temps, Hiel de Béthel bâtit Jéricho; il en jeta les fondements au prix d''Abiram, son premier-né, et il en posa les portes au prix de Segub, son plus jeune fils, selon la parole que l''Eternel avait dite par Josué, fils de Nun.
verses.am: ፤ በእርሱም ዘመን የቤቴል ሰው አኪኤል ኢያሪኮን ሠራ፤ በነዌም ልጅ በኢያሱ እጅ እንደ ተነገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል፥ በበኵር ልጅ በአቢሮን መሠረትዋን አደረገ፥ በታናሹ ልጁም በሠጉብ በሮችዋን አቆመ። a

verses.en: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the Lord God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
verses.fr: Elie, le Thischbite, l''un des habitants de Galaad, dit à Achab: L''Eternel est vivant, le Dieu d''Israël, dont je suis le serviteur! il n''y aura ces années-ci ni rosée ni pluie, sinon à ma parole.
verses.am: በገለዓድ ቴስቢ የነበረው ቴስብያዊው ኤልያስ አክዓብን። በፊቱ የቆምሁት የእስራኤል አምላክ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ከአፌ ቃል በቀር በእነዚህ ዓመታት ጠልና ዝናብ አይሆንም አለው።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,
verses.fr: Et la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Elie, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል እንዲህ ሲል ለእርሱ መጣለት።

verses.en: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.fr: Pars d''ici, dirige-toi vers l''orient, et cache-toi près du torrent de Kerith, qui est en face du Jourdain.
verses.am: ከዚህ ተነሥተህ ወደ ምሥራቅ ሂድ፥ በዮርዳኖስም ትይዩ ባለው በኮራት ፈፋ ውስጥ ተሸሸግ።

verses.en: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
verses.fr: Tu boiras de l''eau du torrent, et j''ai ordonné aux corbeaux de te nourrir là.
verses.am: ከወንዙም ትጠጣለህ፥ ቍራዎችም በዚያ ይመግቡህ ዘንድ አዝዣለሁ።

verses.en: So he went and did according unto the word of the Lord: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.fr: Il partit et fit selon la parole de l''Eternel, et il alla s''établir près du torrent de Kerith, qui est en face du Jourdain.
verses.am: ሄደም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃልም አደረገ። ሄዶም በዮርዳኖስ ትይዩ ባለው በኮራት ፈፋ ውስጥ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
verses.fr: Les corbeaux lui apportaient du pain et de la viande le matin, et du pain et de la viande le soir, et il buvait de l''eau du torrent.
verses.am: ቍራዎቹም በየጥዋትና በየማታው እንጀራና ሥጋ ያመጡለት ነበር፤ ከወንዙም ይጠጣ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
verses.fr: Mais au bout d''un certain temps le torrent fut à sec, car il n''était point tombé de pluie dans le pays.
verses.am: ከብዙ ቀንም በኋላ በምድር ላይ ዝናብ አልነበረምና ወንዙ ደረቀ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,
verses.fr: Alors la parole de l''Eternel lui fut adressée en ces mots:
verses.am: ተነሥተህም በሲዶና አጠገብ ወዳለችው ወደ ሰራፕታ ሂድ፥ በዚያም ተቀመጥ፤

verses.en: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, va à Sarepta, qui appartient à Sidon, et demeure là. Voici, j''y ai ordonné à une femme veuve de te nourrir.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ትመግብህ ዘንድ አንዲት ባልቴት አዝዣለሁ የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል መጣለት።

verses.en: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
verses.fr: Il se leva, et il alla à Sarepta. Comme il arrivait à l''entrée de la ville, voici, il y avait là une femme veuve qui ramassait du bois. Il l''appela, et dit: Va me chercher, je te prie, un peu d''eau dans un vase, afin que je boive.
verses.am: ተነሥቶም ወደ ሰራፕታ ሄደ፤ ወደ ከተማይቱም በር በደረሰ ጊዜ አንዲት ባልቴት በዚያ እንጨት ትለቅም ነበር፤ እርሱም ጠርቶ። የምጠጣው ጥቂት ውኃ በጽዋ ታመጭልኝ ዘንድ እለምንሻለሁ አላት።

verses.en: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
verses.fr: Et elle alla en chercher. Il l''appela de nouveau, et dit: Apporte-moi, je te prie, un morceau de pain dans ta main.
verses.am: ውኃም ልታመጣለት በሄደች ጊዜ ወደ እርስዋ ጠርቶ፥ ቁራሽ እንጀራ በእጅሽ ይዘሽ ትመጭ ዘንድ እለምንሻለሁ አላት።

verses.en: And she said, As the Lord thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verses.fr: Et elle répondit: L''Eternel, ton Dieu, est vivant! je n''ai rien de cuit, je n''ai qu''une poignée de farine dans un pot et un peu d''huile dans une cruche. Et voici, je ramasse deux morceaux de bois, puis je rentrerai et je préparerai cela pour moi et pour mon fils; nous mangerons, après quoi nous mourrons.
verses.am: እርስዋም። አምላክህ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! በማድጋ ካለው ከእፍኝ ዱቄት፥ በማሰሮም ካለው ከጥቂት ዘይት በቀር እንጀራ የለኝም፤ እነሆም፥ ገብቼ ለእኔና ለልጄ እጋግረው ዘንድ በልተነውም እንሞት ዘንድ ጥቂት እንጨት እሰበስባለሁ አለች።

verses.en: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
verses.fr: Elie lui dit: Ne crains point, rentre, fais comme tu as dit. Seulement, prépare-moi d''abord avec cela un petit gâteau, et tu me l''apporteras; tu en feras ensuite pour toi et pour ton fils.
verses.am: ኤልያስም አላት። አትፍሪ፤ ይልቅስ ሄደሽ እንዳልሺው አድርጊ፤ አስቀድመሽ ግን ከዱቄቱ ለእኔ ታናሽ እንጎቻ አድርገሽ አምጭልኝ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ለአንቺና ለልጅሽ አድርጊ፤

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the Lord sendeth rain upon the earth.
verses.fr: Car ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël: La farine qui est dans le pot ne manquera point et l''huile qui est dans la cruche ne diminuera point, jusqu''au jour où l''Eternel fera tomber de la pluie sur la face du sol.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና። በምድር ላይ እግዚአብሔር ዝናብ እስከሚሰጥበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ዱቄቱ ከማድጋ አይጨረስም፥ ዘይቱም ከማሰሮው አይጎድልም።

verses.en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
verses.fr: Elle alla, et elle fit selon la parole d''Elie. Et pendant longtemps elle eut de quoi manger, elle et sa famille, aussi bien qu''Elie.
verses.am: እርስዋም ሄዳ እንደ ኤልያሳ ቃል አደረገች፤ እርስዋና እርሱ ቤትዋም ብዙ ቀን በሉ።

verses.en: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Elijah.
verses.fr: La farine qui était dans le pot ne manqua point, et l''huile qui était dans la cruche ne diminua point, selon la parole que l''Eternel avait prononcée par Elie.
verses.am: በኤልያስም እጅ እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ዱቄቱ ከማድጋው አልተጨረሰም፥ ዘይቱም ከማሰሮው አልጎደለም።

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
verses.fr: Après ces choses, le fils de la femme, maîtresse de la maison, devint malade, et sa maladie fut si violente qu''il ne resta plus en lui de respiration.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ የባለቤቲቱ ልጅ ታመመ፤ ትንፋሹም እስኪታጣ ድረስ ደዌው እጅግ ከባድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
verses.fr: Cette femme dit alors à Elie: Qu''y a-t-il entre moi et toi, homme de Dieu? Es-tu venu chez moi pour rappeler le souvenir de mon iniquité, et pour faire mourir mon fils?
verses.am: እርስዋም ኤልያስን። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? ኃጢአቴንስ ታሳስብ ዘንድ፥ ልጄንስ ትገድል ዘንድ ወደ እኔ መጥተሃልን? አለችው።

verses.en: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
verses.fr: Il lui répondit: Donne-moi ton fils. Et il le prit du sein de la femme, le monta dans la chambre haute où il demeurait, et le coucha sur son lit.
verses.am: ኤልያስም። ልጅሽን ስጪኝ አላት። ከብብትዋም ወስዶ ተቀምጦበት ወደ ነበረው ሰገነት አወጣው በአልጋውም ላይ አጋደመው።

verses.en: And he cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
verses.fr: Puis il invoqua l''Eternel, et dit: Eternel, mon Dieu, est-ce que tu affligerais, au point de faire mourir son fils, même cette veuve chez qui j''ai été reçu comme un hôte?
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም። አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ልጅዋን በመግደልህ ይህችን ትቀልበኝ የነበረቺቱን ባልቴት እንዲህ ደግሞ አስጨነቅኻትን? ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.
verses.fr: Et il s''étendit trois fois sur l''enfant, invoqua l''Eternel, et dit: Eternel, mon Dieu, je t''en prie, que l''âme de cet enfant revienne au dedans de lui!
verses.am: በብላቴናውም ላይ ሦስት ጊዜ ተዘረጋበት፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም። አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ የዚህ ብላቴና ነፍስ ወደ እርሱ ትመለስ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And the Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.fr: L''Eternel écouta la voix d''Elie, et l''âme de l''enfant revint au dedans de lui, et il fut rendu à la vie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የኤልያስን ቃል ሰማ፤ የብላቴናው ነፍስ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሰች፥ እርሱም ዳነ።

verses.en: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
verses.fr: Elie prit l''enfant, le descendit de la chambre haute dans la maison, et le donna à sa mère. Et Elie dit: Vois, ton fils est vivant.
verses.am: ኤልያስም ብላቴናውን ይዞ ከሰገነቱ ወደ ቤት አወረደው፥ ኤልያስም። እነሆ፥ ልጅሽ በሕይወት ይኖራል ብሎ ለእናቱ ሰጣት።

verses.en: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in thy mouth is truth.
verses.fr: Et la femme dit à Elie: Je reconnais maintenant que tu es un homme de Dieu, et que la parole de l''Eternel dans ta bouche est vérité.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም ኤልያስን። የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆንህ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በአፍህ እውነት እንደ ሆነ አሁን አወቅሁ አለችው።

verses.en: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the Lord came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
verses.fr: Bien des jours s''écoulèrent, et la parole de l''Eternel fut ainsi adressée à Elie, dans la troisième année: Va, présente-toi devant Achab, et je ferai tomber de la pluie sur la face du sol.
verses.am: ከብዙ ቀንም በኋላ በሦስተኛው ዓመት። ሂድ፥ ለአክዓብ ተገለጥ፥ በምድር ላይም ዝናብ እሰጣለሁ የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ኤልያስ መጣ።

verses.en: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
verses.fr: Et Elie alla, pour se présenter devant Achab. La famine était grande à Samarie.
verses.am: ኤልያስም ለአክዓብ ይገለጥ ዘንድ ሄደ፤ በሰማርያም ራብ ጸንቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly:
verses.fr: Et Achab fit appeler Abdias, chef de sa maison. -Or Abdias craignait beaucoup l''Eternel;
verses.am: አክዓብም የቤቱን አዛዥ አብድዩን ጠራ፤ አብድዩ እግዚአብሔርን እጅግ ይፈራ ነበር።

verses.en: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the Lord, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.fr: et lorsque Jézabel extermina les prophètes de l''Eternel, Abdias prit cent prophètes qu''il cacha cinquante par cinquante dans une caverne, et il les avait nourris de pain et d''eau. -
verses.am: ኤልዛቤልም የእግዚአብሔርን ነቢያት ባስገደለች ጊዜ እርሱ መቶውን ነቢያት ወስዶ አምሳ አምሳውን በዋሻ ውስጥ ሸሽጎ እንጀራና ውኃ ይመግባቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
verses.fr: Achab dit à Abdias: Va par le pays vers toutes les sources d''eau et vers tous les torrents; peut-être se trouvera-t-il de l''herbe, et nous conserverons la vie aux chevaux et aux mulets, et nous n''aurons pas besoin d''abattre du bétail.
verses.am: አክዓብም አብድዩን። በአገሩ መካከል ወደ ውኃው ምንጭ ሁሉና ወደ ወንዝ ሁሉ ሂድ፤ እንስሶችም ሁሉ እንዳይጠፉ ፈረሶችንና በቅሎችን የምናድንበት ሣር ምናልባት እናገኛለን አለው።

verses.en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.fr: Ils se partagèrent le pays pour le parcourir; Achab alla seul par un chemin, et Abdias alla seul par un autre chemin.
verses.am: ሁለቱም የሚመለሱበትን አገር ተካፈሉ፤ አክዓብም ለብቻው በአንድ መንገድ አብድዩም ለብቻው በሌላ መንገድ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?
verses.fr: Comme Abdias était en route, voici, Elie le rencontra. Abdias, l''ayant reconnu, tomba sur son visage, et dit: Est-ce toi, mon seigneur Elie?
verses.am: አብድዩም በመንገድ ሲሄድ፥ እነሆ፥ ኤልያስ ተገናኘው፤ አብድዩም አወቀው፥ በግምባሩም ተደፍቶ። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ኤልያስ አንተ ነህን? አለ።

verses.en: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.fr: Il lui répondit: C''est moi; va, dis à ton maître: Voici Elie!
verses.am: ኤልያስም። እኔ ነኝ ሄደህ ለጌታህ። ኤልያስ ተገኝቶአል በል አለው።

verses.en: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
verses.fr: Et Abdias dit: Quel péché ai-je commis, pour que tu livres ton serviteur entre les mains d''Achab, qui me fera mourir?
verses.am: አብድዩም አለ። እኔን ባሪያህን እንዲገድል በአክዓብ እጅ አሳልፈህ ትሰጠኝ ዘንድ ምን ኃጢአት አድርጌአለሁ?

verses.en: As the Lord thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est vivant! il n''est ni nation ni royaume où mon maître n''ait envoyé pour te chercher; et quand on disait que tu n''y étais pas, il faisait jurer le royaume et la nation que l''on ne t''avait pas trouvé.
verses.am: አምላክህ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ጌታዬ ይፈልግህ ዘንድ ያልላከበት ሕዝብ ወይም መንግሥት የለም፤ ሁሉም። በዚህ የለም ባሉ ጊዜ አንተን እንዳላገኙ መንግሥቱንና ሕዝቡን አምሎአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.fr: Et maintenant tu dis: Va, dis à ton maître: Voici Elie!
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ። ሂድ፥ ኤልያስ ተገኘ ብለህ ለጌታህ ንገር ትለኛለህ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the Lord shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the Lord from my youth.
verses.fr: Puis, lorsque je t''aurai quitté l''esprit de l''Eternel te transportera je ne sais où; et j''irai informer Achab, qui ne te trouvera pas, et qui me tuera. Cependant ton serviteur craint l''Eternel dès sa jeunesse.
verses.am: እኔም ከአንተ ጥቂት ራቅ ስል የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ አንሥቶ ወደማላውቀው ስፍራ ይወስድሃል፤ እኔም ገብቼ ለአክዓብ ስናገር፥ ባያገኝህ ይገድለኛል፤ እኔም ባሪያህ ከትንሽነቴ ጀምሬ እግዚአብሔርን እፈራ ነበር።

verses.en: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the Lord, how I hid an hundred men of the Lord's prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.fr: N''a-t-on pas dit à mon seigneur ce que j''ai fait quand Jézabel tua les prophètes de l''Eternel? J''ai caché cent prophètes de l''Eternel, cinquante par cinquante dans une caverne, et je les ai nourris de pain et d''eau.
verses.am: ኤልዛቤል የእግዚአብሔርን ነቢያት ባስገደለች ጊዜ፥ መቶውን የእግዚአብሔር ነቢያት ወስጄ፥ አምሳ አምሳውንም በዋሻ ውስጥ ሸሽጌ፥ እንጀራና ውኃ የመገብኋቸው፥ ይህ ያደርግሁት ነገር በውኑ ለጌታዬ አልታወቀህምን?

verses.en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
verses.fr: Et maintenant tu dis: Va, dis à ton maître: Voici Elie! Il me tuera.
verses.am: አሁንም። ሄደህ ኤልያስ ተገኘ ብለህ ለጌታህ ንገር ትላለህ፤ እርሱም ይገድለኛል።

verses.en: And Elijah said, As the Lord of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
verses.fr: Mais Elie dit: L''Eternel des armées, dont je suis le serviteur, est vivant! aujourd''hui je me présenterai devant Achab.
verses.am: ኤልያስም። በፊቱ የቆምሁት የሠራዊት ጌታ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እኔ ዛሬ ለእርሱ እገለጣለሁ አለ።

verses.en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.fr: Abdias, étant allé à la rencontre d''Achab, l''informa de la chose. Et Achab se rendit au-devant d''Elie.
verses.am: አብድዩም አክዓብን ሊገናኘው ሄደ፥ ነገረውም፤ አክዓብም ኤልያስን ሊገናኘው መጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
verses.fr: A peine Achab aperçut-il Elie qu''il lui dit: Est-ce toi, qui jettes le trouble en Israël?
verses.am: አክዓብም ኤልያስን ባየው ጊዜ። እስራኤልን የምትገለባብጥ አንተ ነህን? አለው።

verses.en: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the Lord, and thou hast followed Baalim.
verses.fr: Elie répondit: Je ne trouble point Israël; c''est toi, au contraire, et la maison de ton père, puisque vous avez abandonné les commandements de l''Eternel et que tu es allé après les Baals.
verses.am: ኤልያስም። እስራኤልን የምትገለባብጡ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ትታችሁ በኣሊምን የተከተላችሁ፥ አንተና የአባትህ ቤት ናችሁ እንጂ እኔ አይደለሁም።

verses.en: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.
verses.fr: Fais maintenant rassembler tout Israël auprès de moi, à la montagne du Carmel, et aussi les quatre cent cinquante prophètes de Baal et les quatre cents prophètes d''Astarté qui mangent à la table de Jézabel.
verses.am: አሁንም ልከህ እስራኤልን ሁሉ፥ በኤልዛቤልም ማዕድ የሚበሉትን አራት መቶ አምሳ የበኣልን ነቢያት፥ አራት መቶም የማምለኪያ ዐፀድን ነቢያት ወደ እኔ ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ሰብስብ አለ።

verses.en: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
verses.fr: Achab envoya des messagers vers tous les enfants d''Israël, et il rassembla les prophètes à la montagne du Carmel.
verses.am: አክዓብም ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ልኮ ነቢያቱን ሁሉ ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the Lord be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
verses.fr: Alors Elie s''approcha de tout le peuple, et dit: Jusqu''à quand clocherez-vous des deux côtés? Si l''Eternel est Dieu, allez après lui; si c''est Baal, allez après lui! Le peuple ne lui répondit rien.
verses.am: ኤልያስም ወደ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ቀርቦ። እስከ መቼ ድረስ በሁለት አሳብ ታነክሳላችሁ? እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ቢሆን እርሱን ተከተሉ፤ በኣል ግን አምላክ ቢሆን እርሱን ተከተሉ አለ። ሕዝቡም አንዲት ቃል አልመለሱለትም።

verses.en: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the Lord; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
verses.fr: Et Elie dit au peuple: Je suis resté seul des prophètes de l''Eternel, et il y a quatre cent cinquante prophètes de Baal.
verses.am: ኤልያስም ሕዝቡን አለ። ከእግዚአብሔር ነቢያት እኔ ብቻ ቀርቻለሁ፤ የበኣል ነቢያት ግን አራት መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
verses.fr: Que l''on nous donne deux taureaux; qu''ils choisissent pour eux l''un des taureaux, qu''ils le coupent par morceaux, et qu''ils le placent sur le bois, sans y mettre le feu; et moi, je préparerai l''autre taureau, et je le placerai sur le bois, sans y mettre le feu.
verses.am: ሁለት ወይፈኖች ይሰጡን፤ እነርሱም አንድ ወይፈን ይምረጡ፥ እየብልቱም ይቍረጡት፥ በእንጨትም ላይ ያኑሩት፥ በበታቹም እሳት አይጨምሩ፤ እኔም ሁለተኛውን ወይፈን አዘጋጃለሁ፥ በእንጨቱም ላይ አኖረዋለሁ፥ በበታቹም እሳት አልጨምርም።

verses.en: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the Lord: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
verses.fr: Puis invoquez le nom de votre dieu; et moi, j''invoquerai le nom de l''Eternel. Le dieu qui répondra par le feu, c''est celui-là qui sera Dieu. Et tout le peuple répondit, en disant: C''est bien!
verses.am: እናንተም የአምላካችሁን ስም ጥሩ፥ እኔም የእግዚአብሔርን ስም እጠራለሁ፤ ሰምቶም በእሳት የሚመልስ አምላክ፥ እርሱ አምላክ ይሁን። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። ይህ ነገር መልካም ነው ብለው መለሱ።

verses.en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.
verses.fr: Elie dit aux prophètes de Baal: Choisissez pour vous l''un des taureaux, préparez-le les premiers, car vous êtes les plus nombreux, et invoquez le nom de votre dieu; mais ne mettez pas le feu.
verses.am: ኤልያስም የበኣልን ነቢያት። እናንተ ብዙዎች ናችሁና አስቀድማችሁ አንድ ወይፈን ምረጡና አዘጋጁ፤ የአምላካችሁንም ስም ጥሩ፥ በበታችሁም እሳት አትጨምሩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
verses.fr: Ils prirent le taureau qu''on leur donna, et le préparèrent; et ils invoquèrent le nom de Baal, depuis le matin jusqu''à midi, en disant: Baal réponds nous! Mais il n''y eut ni voix ni réponse. Et ils sautaient devant l''autel qu''ils avaient fait.
verses.am: ወይፈኑንም ወስደው አዘጋጁ፥ ከጠዋትም እስከ ቀትር ድረስ። በኣል ሆይ፥ ስማን እያሉ የበኣልን ስም ጠሩ። ድምፅም አልነበረም፥ የሚመልስም አልነበረም፤ በሠሩትም መሠዊያ ዙሪያ እያነከሱ ያሸበሽቡ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
verses.fr: A midi, Elie se moqua d''eux, et dit: Criez à haute voix, puisqu''il est dieu; il pense à quelque chose, ou il est occupé, ou il est en voyage; peut-être qu''il dort, et il se réveillera.
verses.am: በቀትርም ጊዜ ኤልያስ። አምላክ ነውና በታላቅ ቃል ጩኹ፤ ምናልባት አሳብ ይዞታል፥ ወይም ፈቀቅ ብሎአል፥ ወይም ወደ መንገድ ሄዶአል፥ ወይም ተኝቶ እንደ ሆነ መቀስቀስ ያስፈልገዋል እያለ አላገጠባቸው።

verses.en: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
verses.fr: Et ils crièrent à haute voix, et ils se firent, selon leur coutume, des incisions avec des épées et avec des lances, jusqu''à ce que le sang coulât sur eux.
verses.am: በታላቅም ቃል ይጮኹ፥ እንደ ልማዳቸውም ደማቸው እስኪፈስስ ድረስ ገላቸውን በካራና በቀጭኔ ይብዋጭሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
verses.fr: Lorsque midi fut passé, ils prophétisèrent jusqu''au moment de la présentation de l''offrande. Mais il n''y eut ni voix, ni réponse, ni signe d''attention.
verses.am: ቀትርም ካለፈ በኋላ መሥዋዕተ ሠርክ እስኪደርስ ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር፤ ድምፅም አልነበረም፥ የሚመልስና የሚያደምጥም አልነበረም።

verses.en: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the Lord that was broken down.
verses.fr: Elie dit alors à tout le peuple: Approchez-vous de moi! Tout le peuple s''approcha de lui. Et Elie rétablit l''autel de l''Eternel, qui avait été renversé.
verses.am: ኤልያስም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ። ወደ እኔ ቅረቡ አላቸው። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ። ፈርሶ የነበረውንም የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ አበጀ።

verses.en: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the Lord came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
verses.fr: Il prit douze pierres d''après le nombre des tribus des fils de Jacob, auquel l''Eternel avait dit: Israël sera ton nom;
verses.am: ኤልያስም። ስምህ እስራኤል ይሆናል የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ደረሰለት እንደ ያዕቆብ ልጆች ነገድ ቍጥር አሥራ ሁለቱን ድንጋዮች ወሰደ።

verses.en: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
verses.fr: et il bâtit avec ces pierres un autel au nom de l''Eternel. Il fit autour de l''autel un fossé de la capacité de deux mesures de semence.
verses.am: ከድንጋዮችም ለእግዚአብሔር ስም መሠዊያ ሠራ፤ በመሠዊያውም ዙሪያ ሁለት መስፈሪያ እህል የሚያዝ ጕድጓድ ቈፈረ።

verses.en: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
verses.fr: Il arrangea le bois, coupa le taureau par morceaux, et le plaça sur le bois. Puis il dit: Remplissez d''eau quatre cruches, et versez-les sur l''holocauste et sur le bois.
verses.am: እንጨቱንም በተርታ አደረገ፥ ወይፈኑንም በብልት በብልቱ ቈረጠ፥ በእንጨቱም ላይ አኖረና።

verses.en: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
verses.fr: Il dit: Faites-le une seconde fois. Et ils le firent une seconde fois. Il dit: Faites-le une troisième fois. Et ils le firent une troisième fois.
verses.am: አራት ጋን ውኃ ሙሉ በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና በእንጨቱ ላይ አፍስሱ አሉ። ደግሞም። ድገሙ አለ፤ እነርሱም ደገሙ። እርሱም። ሦስተኛ አድርጉ አለ፤ ሦስተኛም አደረጉ።

verses.en: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
verses.fr: L''eau coula autour de l''autel, et l''on remplit aussi d''eau le fossé.
verses.am: ውኃውም በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ፈሰሰ፤ ደግሞም ጕድጓዱን በውኃ ሞላው።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.
verses.fr: Au moment de la présentation de l''offrande, Elie, le prophète, s''avança et dit: Eternel, Dieu d''Abraham, d''Isaac et d''Israël! que l''on sache aujourd''hui que tu es Dieu en Israël, que je suis ton serviteur, et que j''ai fait toutes ces choses par ta parole!
verses.am: መሥዋዕተ ሠርክ በሚቀርብበት ጊዜ ነቢዩ ኤልያስ ቀርቦ። አቤቱ፥ የአብርሃምና የይስሐቅ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ሆይ፥ አንተ በእስራኤል ላይ አምላክ እንደ ሆንህ፥ እኔም ባሪያህ እንደ ሆንሁ፥ ይህንም ሁሉ በቃልህ እንዳደረግሁ ዛሬ ይገለጥ።

verses.en: Hear me, O Lord, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the Lord God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.
verses.fr: Réponds-moi, Eternel, réponds-moi, afin que ce peuple reconnaisse que c''est toi, Eternel, qui es Dieu, et que c''est toi qui ramènes leur coeur!
verses.am: አንተ፥ አቤቱ፥ አምላክ እንደ ሆንህ፥ ልባቸውንም ደግሞ እንደ መለስህ ይህ ሕዝብ ያውቅ ዘንድ ስማኝ፥ አቤቱ፥ ስማኝ አለ።

verses.en: Then the fire of the Lord fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.fr: Et le feu de l''Eternel tomba, et il consuma l''holocauste, le bois, les pierres et la terre, et il absorba l''eau qui était dans le fossé.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት ወደቀች፥ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕቱንም እንጨቱንም ድንጋዮቹንም አፈሩንም በላች፥ በጕድጓዱም ውስጥ ያለውን ውኃ ላሰች።

verses.en: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The Lord, he is the God; the Lord, he is the God.
verses.fr: Quand tout le peuple vit cela, ils tombèrent sur leur visage et dirent: C''est l''Eternel qui est Dieu! C''est l''Eternel qui est Dieu!
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ያንን ባዩ ጊዜ በግምባራቸው ተደፍተው። እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ ነው አሉ።

verses.en: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
verses.fr: Saisissez les prophètes de Baal, leur dit Elie; qu''aucun d''eux n''échappe! Et ils les saisirent. Elie les fit descendre au torrent de Kison, où il les égorgea.
verses.am: ኤልያስም። ከበኣል ነቢያት አንድ ሰው እንዳያመልጥ ያዙ አላቸው። ያዙአቸውም፤ ኤልያስም ወደ ቂሶን ወንዝ ወስዶ በዚያ አሳረዳቸው።

verses.en: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.
verses.fr: Et Elie dit à Achab: Monte, mange et bois; car il se fait un bruit qui annonce la pluie.
verses.am: ኤልያስም አክዓብን። የዝናቡ ውሽንፍር እጅግ ነውና ተነሥተህ ውጣ፥ ብላም ጠጣም አለው።

verses.en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
verses.fr: Achab monta pour manger et pour boire. Mais Elie monta au sommet du Carmel; et, se penchant contre terre, il mit son visage entre ses genoux,
verses.am: አክዓብም ሊበላና ሊጠጣ ወጣ፤ ኤልያስም ወደ ቀርሜሎስ አናት ወጣ፤ ፊቱንም በጕልበቱ መካከል አድርጎ በግምባሩ ተደፋ።

verses.en: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
verses.fr: et dit à son serviteur: Monte, regarde du côté de la mer. Le serviteur monta, il regarda, et dit: Il n''y a rien. Elie dit sept fois: Retourne.
verses.am: ብላቴናውንም። ወጥተህ ወደ ባሕሩ ተመልከት አለው። ወጥቶም ተመልክቶም። ምንም የለም አለ። እርሱም። ሰባት ጊዜ ተመላለስ አለው። ብላቴናውም ሰባት ጊዜ ተመላለሰ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down that the rain stop thee not.
verses.fr: A la septième fois, il dit: Voici un petit nuage qui s''élève de la mer, et qui est comme la paume de la main d''un homme. Elie dit: Monte, et dis à Achab: Attelle et descends, afin que la pluie ne t''arrête pas.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ጊዜ። እነሆ፥ የሰው እጅ የምታህል ታናሽ ደመና ከባሕር ወጥች አለ። እርሱም። ወጥተህ አክዓብን። ዝናብ እንዳይከለክልህ ሰረገላን ጭነህ ውረድ በለው አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verses.fr: En peu d''instants, le ciel s''obscurcit par les nuages, le vent s''établit, et il y eut une forte pluie. Achab monta sur son char, et partit pour Jizreel.
verses.am: ከጥቂትም ጊዜ በኋላ ሰማዩ ከደመናውና ከነፋሱ የተነሣ ጨለመ፥ ብዙም ዝናብ ሆነ፤ አክዓብም በሰረገላው ተቀምጦ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ሄደ።

verses.en: And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.fr: Et la main de l''Eternel fut sur Elie, qui se ceignit les reins et courut devant Achab jusqu''à l''entrée de Jizreel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም እጅ በኤልያስ ላይ ነበረች፤ ወገቡንም አሸንፍጦ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል እስኪገባ ድረስ በአክዓብ ፊት ይሮጥ ነበር።

verses.en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
verses.fr: Achab rapporta à Jézabel tout ce qu''avait fait Elie, et comment il avait tué par l''épée tous les prophètes.
verses.am: አክዓብም ኤልያስ ይህን ሁሉ እንዳደረገ፥ ነቢያትንም ሁሉ በሰይፍ እንደ ገደለ ለኤልዛቤል ነገራት።

verses.en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
verses.fr: Jézabel envoya un messager à Elie, pour lui dire: Que les dieux me traitent dans toute leur rigueur, si demain, à cette heure, je ne fais de ta vie ce que tu as fait de la vie de chacun d''eux!
verses.am: ኤልዛቤልም። ነገ በዚህ ጊዜ ነፍስህን ከእነዚህ እንደ አንዲቱ ነፍስ ባላደርጋት፥ አማልክት ይህን ያድርጉብኝ ይህንም ይጨምሩብኝ ብላ ወደ ኤልያስ መልእክተኛ ላከች።

verses.en: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
verses.fr: Elie, voyant cela, se leva et s''en alla, pour sauver sa vie. Il arriva à Beer-Schéba, qui appartient à Juda, et il y laissa son serviteur.
verses.am: ኤልያስም ፈርቶ ተነሣ፥ ነፍሱንም ሊያድን ሄደ፥ በይሁዳም ወዳለው ወደ ቤርሳቤህ መጥቶ ብላቴናውን በዚያ ተወ።

verses.en: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O Lord, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.
verses.fr: Pour lui, il alla dans le désert où, après une journée de marche, il s''assit sous un genêt, et demanda la mort, en disant: C''est assez! Maintenant, Eternel, prends mon âme, car je ne suis pas meilleur que mes pères.
verses.am: እርሱም አንድ ቀን የሚያህል መንገድ በምድረ በዳ ሄደ፤ መጥቶም ከክትክታ ዛፍ በታች ተቀመጠና። ይበቃኛል፤ አሁንም፥ አቤቱ፥ እኔ ከአባቶቼ አልበልጥምና ነፍሴን ውሰድ ብሎ እንዲሞት ለመነ።

verses.en: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
verses.fr: Il se coucha et s''endormit sous un genêt. Et voici, un ange le toucha, et lui dit: Lève-toi, mange.
verses.am: በክትክታውም ዛፍ በታች ተጋደመ እንቅልፍም አንቀላፋ፤ እነሆም፥ መልአክ ዳሰሰውና። ተነሥተህ ብላ አለው።

verses.en: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
verses.fr: Il regarda, et il y avait à son chevet un gâteau cuit sur des pierres chauffées et une cruche d''eau. Il mangea et but, puis se recoucha.
verses.am: ሲመለከትም፥ እነሆ፥ በራሱ አጠገብ የተጋገረ እንጎቻና በማሰሮ ውኃ አገኘ። በላም ጠጣም፥ ተመልሶም ተኛ።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel vint une seconde fois, le toucha, et dit: Lève-toi, mange, car le chemin est trop long pour toi.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ደግሞ ሁለተኛ ጊዜ መጥቶ ዳሰሰውና። የምትሄድበት መንገድ ሩቅ ነውና ተነሥተህ ብላ አለው።

verses.en: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
verses.fr: Il se leva, mangea et but; et avec la force que lui donna cette nourriture, il marcha quarante jours et quarante nuits jusqu''à la montagne de Dieu, à Horeb.
verses.am: ተነሥቶም በላ ጠጣም፤ በዚያም ምግብ ኃይል እስከ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ እስከ ኮሬብ ድረስ አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊት ሄደ።

verses.en: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the Lord came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?
verses.fr: Et là, il entra dans la caverne, et il y passa la nuit. Et voici, la parole de l''Eternel lui fut adressée, en ces mots: Que fais-tu ici, Elie?
verses.am: እዚያም ወዳለ ዋሻ መጣ፥ በዚያም አደረ፤ እነሆም። ኤልያስ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ምን ታደርጋለህ? የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እርሱ መጣ።

verses.en: And he said, I have been very jealous for the Lord God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
verses.fr: Il répondit: J''ai déployé mon zèle pour l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées; car les enfants d''Israël ont abandonné ton alliance, ils ont renversé tes autels, et ils ont tué par l''épée tes prophètes; je suis resté, moi seul, et ils cherchent à m''ôter la vie.
verses.am: እርሱም። ለሠራዊት አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር እጅግ ቀንቻለሁ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ቃል ኪዳንህን ትተዋልና፥ መሠዊያዎችህንም አፍርሰዋልና፥ ነቢያትህንም በሰይፍ ገድለዋልና፤ እኔም ብቻዬን ቀርቻለሁ፤ ነፍሴንም ሊወስዱአት ይሻሉ አለ።

verses.en: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the Lord. And, behold, the Lord passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the Lord; but the Lord was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the Lord was not in the earthquake:
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit: Sors, et tiens-toi dans la montagne devant l''Eternel! Et voici, l''Eternel passa. Et devant l''Eternel, il y eut un vent fort et violent qui déchirait les montagnes et brisait les rochers: l''Eternel n''était pas dans le vent. Et après le vent, ce fut un tremblement de terre: l''Eternel n''était pas dans le tremblement de terre.
verses.am: እርሱም። ውጣ፥ በተራራውም ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቁም አለ። እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር አለፈ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ትልቅና ብርቱ ነፋስ ተራሮቹን ሰነጠቀ ዓለቶቹንም ሰባበረ፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን በነፋሱ ውስጥ አልነበረም። ከነፋሱም በኋላ የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን በምድር መናወጥ ውስጥ አልነበረም።

verses.en: And after the earthquake a fire; but the Lord was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
verses.fr: Et après le tremblement de terre, un feu: l''Eternel n''était pas dans le feu. Et après le feu, un murmure doux et léger.
verses.am: ከምድር መናወጥ በኋላ እሳት ሆነ፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን በእሳቱ ውስጥ አልነበረም። ከእሳቱም በኋላ ትንሽ የዝምታ ድምፅ ሆነ።

verses.en: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?
verses.fr: Quand Elie l''entendit, il s''enveloppa le visage de son manteau, il sortit et se tint à l''entrée de la caverne. Et voici, une voix lui fit entendre ces paroles: Que fais-tu ici, Elie?
verses.am: ኤልያስም ያን በሰማ ጊዜ ፊቱን በመጐናጸፊያው ሸፈነ፥ ወጥቶም በዋሻው ደጃፍ ቆመ። እነሆ። ኤልያስ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ምን ታደርጋለህ? የሚል ድምፅ ወደ እርሱ መጣ።

verses.en: And he said, I have been very jealous for the Lord God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
verses.fr: Il répondit: J''ai déployé mon zèle pour l''Eternel, le Dieu des armées; car les enfants d''Israël ont abandonné ton alliance, ils ont renversé tes autels, et ils ont tué par l''épée tes prophètes; je suis resté, moi seul, et ils cherchent à m''ôter la vie.
verses.am: እርሱም። ለሠራዊት አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር እጅግ ቀንቻለሁ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ቃል ኪዳንህን ትተዋልና፥ መሠዊያዎችህንም አፍርሰዋልና፥ ነቢያትህንም በሰይፍ ገድለዋልና፤ እኔም ብቻዬን ቀርቻለሁ፤ ነፍሴንም ሊወስዱአት ይሻሉ አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit: Va, reprends ton chemin par le désert jusqu''à Damas; et quand tu seras arrivé, tu oindras Hazaël pour roi de Syrie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለው። ሂድ፥ በመጣህበትም መንገድ በምድረ በዳ ወደ ደማስቆ ተመለስ፤ ከዚያም በደረስህ ጊዜ በሶርያ ላይ ንጉሥ ይሆን ዘንድ አዛሄልን ቅባው፤

verses.en: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.
verses.fr: Tu oindras aussi Jéhu, fils de Nimschi, pour roi d''Israël; et tu oindras Elisée, fils de Schaphath, d''Abel-Mehola, pour prophète à ta place.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ላይ ንጉሥ ይሆን ዘንድ የናሜሲን ልጅ ኢዩን ቅባው፤ በፋንታህም ነቢይ ይሆን ዘንድ የአቤልምሖላን ሰው የሣፋጥን ልጅ ኤልሳዕን ቅባው ከአዛሄልም ሰይፍ ያመለጠውን ሁሉ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.
verses.fr: Et il arrivera que celui qui échappera à l''épée de Hazaël, Jéhu le fera mourir; et celui qui échappera à l''épée de Jéhu, Elisée le fera mourir.
verses.am: ኢዩ ይገድለዋል፤ ከኢዩም ሰይፍ ያመለጠውን ሁሉ ኤልሳዕ ይገድለዋል።

verses.en: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.
verses.fr: Mais je laisserai en Israël sept mille hommes, tous ceux qui n''ont point fléchi les genoux devant Baal, et dont la bouche ne l''a point baisé.
verses.am: እኔም ከእስራኤል ጕልበታቸውን ለበኣል ያላንበረከኩትን ሁሉ፥ በአፋቸውም ያልሳሙትን ሁሉ፥ ሰባት ሺህ ሰዎች ለእኔ አስቀራለሁ።

verses.en: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
verses.fr: Elie partit de là, et il trouva Elisée, fils de Schaphath, qui labourait. Il y avait devant lui douze paires de boeufs, et il était avec la douzième. Elie s''approcha de lui, et il jeta sur lui son manteau.
verses.am: ከዚያም ሄደ፥ የሣፋጥንም ልጅ ኤልሳዕን በአሥራ ሁለት ጥማድ በሬዎች ሲያርስ፥ እርሱም ከአሥራ ሁለተኛው ጋር ሆኖ አገኘው። ኤልያስም ወደ እርሱ አልፎ መጐናጸፊያውን ጣለበት።

verses.en: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?
verses.fr: Elisée, quittant ses boeufs, courut après Elie, et dit: Laisse-moi embrasser mon père et ma mère, et je te suivrai. Elie lui répondit: Va, et reviens; car pense à ce que je t''ai fait.
verses.am: በሬዎቹንም ተወ፥ ከኤልያስም በኋላ ሮጦ። አባቴንና እናቴን እስማቸው ዘንድ፥ እባክህ፥ ተወኝ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ እከተልሃለሁ አለው። እርሱም። ሂድና ተመለስ፤ ምን አድርጌልሃለሁ? አለው።

verses.en: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.
verses.fr: Après s''être éloigné d''Elie, il revint prendre une paire de boeufs, qu''il offrit en sacrifice; avec l''attelage des boeufs, il fit cuire leur chair, et la donna à manger au peuple. Puis il se leva, suivit Elie, et fut à son service.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ዘንድ ተመልሶ ሁለቱን በሬዎች ወስዶ አረዳቸው፥ ሥጋቸውንም በበሬዎቹ ዕቃ ቀቀለው፥ ለሕዝቡም ሰጣቸው፥ በሉም፤ እርሱም ተነሥቶ ኤልያስን ተከትሎ ሄደ፥ ያገለግለውም ነበር።

verses.en: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots; and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
verses.fr: Ben-Hadad, roi de Syrie, rassembla toute son armée; il avait avec lui trente-deux rois, des chevaux et des chars. Il monta, mit le siège devant Samarie et l''attaqua.
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር ጭፍራውን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ሠላሳ ሁለት ነገሥት ነበሩ፥ ፈረሶችና ሰረገሎችም ነበሩ፤ ወጥቶም ሰማርያን ከበበ፥ ወጋትም።

verses.en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Benhadad,
verses.fr: Il envoya dans la ville des messagers à Achab, roi d''Israël, et lui fit dire: Ainsi parle Ben-Hadad:
verses.am: ወደ እስራኤልም ንጉሥ ወደ አክዓብ።

verses.en: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.
verses.fr: Ton argent et ton or sont à moi, tes femmes et tes plus beaux enfants sont à moi.
verses.am: ወልደ አዴር እንዲህ ይላል። ብርህና ወርቅህ ለእኔ ነው፤ ሴቶችህና መልካካሞቹም ልጆችህ ለእኔ ናቸው ብሎ ወደ ከተማይቱ መልእክተኞችን ላከ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël répondit: Roi, mon seigneur, comme tu le dis, je suis à toi avec tout ce que j''ai.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ መልሶ። ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ አንተ እንዳልህ ነው፤ እኔ ለእኔም የሆነው ሁሉ የአንተ ነው አለ።

verses.en: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;
verses.fr: Les messagers retournèrent, et dirent: Ainsi parle Ben-Hadad: Je t''ai fait dire: Tu me livreras ton argent et ton or, tes femmes et tes enfants.
verses.am: ደግሞም መልእክተኞች ተመልሰው። ወልደ አዴር እንዲህ ይላል። ቀድሞ ብርህንና ወርቅህን ሴቶችህንና ልጆችህንም ትሰጠኛለህ ብዬ ልኬብህ ነበር፤

verses.en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.
verses.fr: J''enverrai donc demain, à cette heure, mes serviteurs chez toi; ils fouilleront ta maison et les maisons de tes serviteurs, ils mettront la main sur tout ce que tu as de précieux, et ils l''emporteront.
verses.am: ነገም በዚህ ጊዜ ባሪያዎቼን እልክብሃለሁ፥ ቤትህንም የባሪያዎችህንም ቤቶች ይበረብራሉ፤ ደስ የሚያሰኛቸውንም ሁሉ በእጃቸው አድርገው ይወስዳሉ አሉ።

verses.en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël appela tous les anciens du pays, et il dit: Sentez bien et comprenez que cet homme nous veut du mal; car il m''a envoyé demander mes femmes et mes enfants, mon argent et mon or, et je ne lui avais pas refusé!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የአገሩን ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ጠርቶ። ተመልከቱ፥ ይህም ሰው ክፉ እንዲሻ እዩ፤ ስለ ሴቶቼ ስለ ልጆቼ ስለ ብሬና ወርቄም ላከብኝ፥ እንቢም አላልሁም አለ።

verses.en: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
verses.fr: Tous les anciens et tout le peuple dirent à Achab: Ne l''écoute pas et ne consens pas.
verses.am: ሽማግሌዎችም ሁሉ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ። አትስማው፥ እሺም አትበለው አሉት።

verses.en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Benhadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
verses.fr: Et il dit aux messagers de Ben-Hadad: Dites à mon seigneur le roi: Je ferai tout ce que tu as envoyé demander à ton serviteur la première fois; mais pour cette chose, je ne puis pas la faire. Les messagers s''en allèrent, et lui portèrent la réponse.
verses.am: ለወልደ አዴርም መልእክተኞች። ለጌታዬ ለንጉሥ። ለእኔ ለባሪያህ በመጀመሪያ የላክህብኝ ሁሉ አደርጋለሁ፤ ይህን ግን አደርገው ዘንድ አይቻለኝም በሉት አላቸው። መልእክተኞችም ተመልሰው ይህን አወሩለት።

verses.en: And Benhadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
verses.fr: Ben-Hadad envoya dire à Achab: Que les dieux me traitent dans toute leur rigueur, si la poussière de Samarie suffit pour remplir le creux de la main de tout le peuple qui me suit!
verses.am: ወልደ አዴርም። ለሚከተለኝ ሕዝብ የሰማርያ ትቢያ ጭብጥ ጭብጥ ይበቃው እንደ ሆነ፥ አማልክት ይህን ያድርጉብኝ ይህን ይጨምሩብኝ ብሎ ላከበት።

verses.en: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
verses.fr: Et le roi d''Israël répondit: Que celui qui revêt une armure ne se glorifie pas comme celui qui la dépose!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ መልሶ። በቃ፤ ለሰልፍ የሚታጠቅ ጋሻ ጦሩን እንደሚያወልቅ አይመካ አለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Ben-hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.
verses.fr: Lorsque Ben-Hadad reçut cette réponse, il était à boire avec les rois sous les tentes, et il dit à ses serviteurs: Faites vos préparatifs! Et ils firent leurs préparatifs contre la ville.
verses.am: ወልደ አዴርም ያን ነገር በሰማ ጊዜ ከነገሥታቱ ጋር በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ይጠጣ ነበር፤ ባሪያዎቹንም። ተሰለፉ አላቸው፤ እነርሱም በከተማይቱ ትይዪ ተሰለፉ።

verses.en: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais voici, un prophète s''approcha d''Achab, roi d''Israël, et il dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Vois-tu toute cette grande multitude? Je vais la livrer aujourd''hui entre tes mains, et tu sauras que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ነቢይ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ወደ አክዓብ ቀርቦ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህን ብዙ ጭፍራ ሁሉ ታያለህን? እነሆ፥ ዛሬ በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃለህ አለ።

verses.en: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the Lord, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.
verses.fr: Achab dit: Par qui? Et il répondit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Par les serviteurs des chefs des provinces. Achab dit: Qui engagera le combat? Et il répondit: Toi.
verses.am: አክዓብም። በማን? አለ፤ እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በአውራጆቹ አለቆች ጕልማሶች አለ፤ እርሱም። ሰልፉን ማን ይጀምራል? አለ፤ እርሱም። አንተ አለው።

verses.en: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
verses.fr: Alors Achab passa en revue les serviteurs des chefs des provinces, et il s''en trouva deux cent trente-deux; et après eux, il passa en revue tout le peuple, tous les enfants d''Israël, et ils étaient sept mille.
verses.am: የአውራጆቹንም አለቆች ጕልማሶች ቈጠረ፥ ሁለት መቶም ሠላሳ ሁለት ነበሩ፤ ከእነርሱም በኋላ ሕዝቡን ሁሉ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ሁሉ፥ ቈጠረ፥ ሰባትም ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they went out at noon. But Benhadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.
verses.fr: Ils firent une sortie à midi. Ben-Hadad buvait et s''enivrait sous les tentes avec les trente-deux rois, ses auxiliaires.
verses.am: ቀትርም በሆነ ጊዜ ወጡ፤ ወልደ አዴር ረዳቶቹም ሠላሳ ሁለቱ ነገሥታት እየጠጡ በድንኳን ውስጥ ይሰክሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Benhadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs des chefs des provinces sortirent les premiers. Ben-Hadad s''informa, et on lui fit ce rapport: Des hommes sont sortis de Samarie.
verses.am: የአውራጆቹም አለቆች ጕልማሶች አስቀድመው ወጡ፤ ወልደ አዴርም መልእክተኞችን ላከ፥ እነርሱም። ሰዎች ከሰማርያ ወጥተዋል ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
verses.fr: Il dit: S''ils sortent pour la paix, saisissez-les vivants; et s''ils sortent pour le combat, saisissez-les vivants.
verses.am: እርሱም። ለዕርቅ ወይም ለሰልፍ መጥተው እንደ ሆነ በሕይወታቸው ያዙአቸው አለ።

verses.en: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
verses.fr: Lorsque les serviteurs des chefs des provinces et l''armée qui les suivait furent sortis de la ville,
verses.am: እነዚህም የአውራጆች አለቆች ጕልማሶች ከከተማይቱ ወጡ፥ ሠራዊትም ተከተላቸው።

verses.en: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Benhadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.
verses.fr: chacun frappa son homme, et les Syriens prirent la fuite. Israël les poursuivit. Ben-Hadad, roi de Syrie, se sauva sur un cheval, avec des cavaliers.
verses.am: ሁሉም በእያንዳንዱ በፊቱ የነበረውን ሰው ገደለ፥ ሶርያውያንም ሸሹ፤ እስራኤልም አሳደዱአቸው፥ የሶርያም ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር በፈረሱ አመለጠ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël sortit, frappa les chevaux et les chars, et fit éprouver aux Syriens une grande défaite.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥም ወጥቶ ፈረሶቹንና ሰረገሎቹን ያዘ፥ ሶርያውያንንም በታላቅ ውጊት ገደላቸው።

verses.en: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.
verses.fr: Alors le prophète s''approcha du roi d''Israël, et lui dit: Va, fortifie toi, examine et vois ce que tu as à faire; car, au retour de l''année, le roi de Syrie montera contre toi.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ቀርቦ። የሶርያ ንጉሥ በሚመጣው ዓመት ይመጣብሃልና ሂድ፥ በርታ፥ የምታደርገውንም ተመልከትና እወቅ አለው።

verses.en: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs du roi de Syrie lui dirent: Leur dieu est un dieu de montagnes; c''est pourquoi ils ont été plus forts que nous. Mais combattons-les dans la plaine, et l''on verra si nous ne serons pas plus forts qu''eux.
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ባሪያዎች እንዲህ አሉት። አምላካቸው የተራሮች አምላክ ነው፤ ስለዚህ በርትተውብን ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በሜዳ ላይ ከእነርሱ ጋር ብንዋጋ በእርግጥ እንበረታባቸዋለን።

verses.en: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
verses.fr: Fais encore ceci: ôte chacun des rois de son poste, et remplace-les par des chefs;
verses.am: ይህንም አድርግ፤ ከጭፍሮችህ ነገሥታቱን አርቅ፥ በፋንታቸውም አለቆችን ሹም።

verses.en: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
verses.fr: et forme-toi une armée pareille à celle que tu as perdue, avec autant de chevaux et autant de chars. Puis nous les combattrons dans la plaine, et l''on verra si nous ne serons pas plus forts qu''eux. Il les écouta, et fit ainsi.
verses.am: አንተም ቀድሞ እንደ ጠፋብህ ሠራዊት፥ ፈረሱን በፈረስ ፋንታ፥ ሰረገላውንም በሰረገላ ፋንታ፥ ሠራዊትን ቍጠር፤ በሜዳም ላይ ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዋጋለን፥ በእርግጥም እንበረታባቸዋለን። ምክራቸውንም ሰማ፥ እንዲሁም አደረገ። ፕ

verses.en: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
verses.fr: L''année suivante, Ben-Hadad passa les Syriens en revue, et monta vers Aphek pour combattre Israël.
verses.am: በሚመጣውም ዓመት ወልደ አዴር ሶርያውያንን አሰለፈ፥ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ይዋጋ ዘንድ ወደ አፌቅ ወጣ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël furent aussi passés en revue; ils reçurent des vivres, et ils marchèrent à la rencontre des Syriens. Ils campèrent vis-à-vis d''eux, semblables à deux petits troupeaux de chèvres, tandis que les Syriens remplissaient le pays.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተሰለፉ፥ ሊገጥሙአቸውም ወጡ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንደ ሁለት ትናንሾች የፍየል መንጋዎች ሆነው በፊታቸው ሰፈሩ፤ ሶርያውያን ግን ምድሩን ሞልተው ነበር።

verses.en: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the Lord, Because the Syrians have said, The Lord is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.fr: L''homme de Dieu s''approcha, et dit au roi d''Israël: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Parce que les Syriens ont dit: L''Eternel est un dieu des montagnes et non un dieu des vallées, je livrerai toute cette grande multitude entre tes mains, et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ቀርቦ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሶርያውያን። እግዚአብሔር የተራሮች አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሸለቆ አምላክ አይደለም ብለዋልና ይህን ታላቅ ጭፍራ ሁሉ በእጅህ አሳልፌ እሰጠዋለሁ፥ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ አለው።

verses.en: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.
verses.fr: Ils campèrent sept jours en face les uns des autres. Le septième jour, le combat s''engagea, et les enfants d''Israël tuèrent aux Syriens cent mille hommes de pied en un jour.
verses.am: እነዚህም በእነዚያ ትይዩ ሰባት ቀን ያህል ሰፈሩ፤ በሰባተኛውም ቀን ተጋጠሙ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከሶርያውያን በአንድ ቀን መቶ ሺህ እግረኛ ገደሉ።

verses.en: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Benhadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.
verses.fr: Le reste s''enfuit à la ville d''Aphek, et la muraille tomba sur vingt-sept mille hommes qui restaient. Ben-Hadad s''était réfugié dans la ville, où il allait de chambre en chambre.
verses.am: የቀሩትም ወደ አፌቅ ወደ ከተማይቱ ውስጥ ሸሹ፤ ቅጥሩም በቀሩት በሀያ ሰባት ሺህ ሰዎች ላይ ወደቀ። ወልደ አዴርም ሸሽቶ ወደ ከተማይቱ ወደ እልፍኙ ውስጥ ገባ።

verses.en: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.
verses.fr: Ses serviteurs lui dirent: Voici, nous avons appris que les rois de la maison d''Israël sont des rois miséricordieux; nous allons mettre des sacs sur nos reins et des cordes à nos têtes, et nous sortirons vers le roi d''Israël: peut-être qu''il te laissera la vie.
verses.am: ባሪያዎቹም። እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ቤት ነገሥታት መሐሪዎች እንደ ሆኑ ሰምተናል፤ በወገባችን ማቅ እንታጠቅ፥ በራሳችንም ገመድ እንጠምጥም፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ንጉሥ እንውጣ፤ ምናልባት ነፍስህን ይምራታል አሉት።

verses.en: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Benhadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.
verses.fr: Ils se mirent des sacs autour des reins et des cordes autour de la tête, et ils allèrent auprès du roi d''Israël. Ils dirent: Ton serviteur Ben-Hadad dit: Laisse-moi la vie! Achab répondit: Est-il encore vivant? Il est mon frère.
verses.am: ወገባቸውንም በማቅ ታጠቁ፥ በራሳቸውም ገመድ ጠመጠሙ፥ ወደ እስራኤልም ንጉሥ መጥተው። ባሪያህ ወልደ አዴር። ነፍሴን ትምራት ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ ብሎአል አሉት። እርሱም። ገና በሕይወቱ አለን? ወንድሜ ነው አለ።

verses.en: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Benhadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Benhadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
verses.fr: Ces hommes tirèrent de là un bon augure, et ils se hâtèrent de le prendre au mot et de dire: Ben-Hadad est ton frère! Et il dit: Allez, amenez-le. Ben-Hadad vint vers lui, et Achab le fit monter sur son char.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም የደግ ምልክት አደረጉትና ቃሉን ከአፉ ተቀብለው። ወንድምህ ወልደ አዴር አለ አሉት። እርሱም። ሂዱ፥ አምጡት አለ። ወልደ አዴርም ወደ እርሱ ወጣ፥ በሰረገላውም ላይ አስቀመጠው።

verses.en: And Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.
verses.fr: Ben-Hadad lui dit: Je te rendrai les villes que mon père a prises à ton père; et tu établiras pour toi des rues à Damas, comme mon père en avait établi à Samarie. Et moi, reprit Achab, je te laisserai aller, en faisant une alliance. Il fit alliance avec lui, et le laissa aller.
verses.am: ወልደ አዴርም። አባቴ ከአባትህ የወሰዳቸውን ከተሞች እመልስልሃለሁ፤ አባቴ በሰማርያ እንዳደረገ አንተ በደማስቆ ገበያ ታደርጋለህ አለው። አክዓብም። እኔም በዚህ ቃል ኪዳን እሰድድሃለሁ አለ። ከእርሱም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አድርጎ ሰደደው።

verses.en: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the Lord, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.
verses.fr: L''un des fils des prophètes dit à son compagnon, d''après l''ordre de l''Eternel: Frappe-moi, je te prie! Mais cet homme refusa de le frapper.
verses.am: ከነቢያትም ወገን አንድ ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ባልንጀራውን። ምታኝ አለው። ሰውዮውም ይመታው ዘንድ እንቢ አለ።

verses.en: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the Lord, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
verses.fr: Alors il lui dit: Parce que tu n''as pas obéi à la voix de l''Eternel, voici, quand tu m''auras quitté, le lion te frappera. Et quand il l''eut quitté, le lion le rencontra et le frappa.
verses.am: እርሱም። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰማህምና እነሆ፥ ከእኔ በራቅህ ጊዜ አንበሳ ይገድልሃል አለው። ከእርሱም በራቀ ጊዜ አንበሳ አግኝቶ ገደለው።

verses.en: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
verses.fr: Il trouva un autre homme, et il dit: Frappe-moi, je te prie! Cet homme le frappa et le blessa.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሌላ ሰው አግኝቶ። ምታኝ አለው። ሰውዮውም መታው፥ በመምታቱም አቈሰለው።

verses.en: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
verses.fr: Le prophète alla se placer sur le chemin du roi, et il se déguisa avec un bandeau sur les yeux.
verses.am: ነቢዩም ሄዶ በመንገድ አጠገብ ንጉሡን ቆየው፤ ዓይኖቹንም በቀጸላው ሸፍኖ ተሸሸገ።

verses.en: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.
verses.fr: Lorsque le roi passa, il cria vers lui, et dit: Ton serviteur était au milieu du combat; et voici, un homme s''approche et m''amène un homme, en disant: Garde cet homme; s''il vient à manquer, ta vie répondra de sa vie, ou tu paieras un talent d''argent!
verses.am: ንጉሡም ባለፈ ጊዜ ወደ እርሱ ጮኸ። ባሪያህ ወደ ሰልፍ መካከል ወጣ፤ እነሆም፥ አንድ ሰው ፈቀቅ ብሎ ወደ እኔ አንድ ሰው አመጣና። ይህን ሰው ጠብቅ፥ ቢኰበልልም ነፍስህ በነፍሱ ፋንታ ትሆናለች፥ ወይም አንድ መክሊት ብር ትከፍላለህ አለኝ።

verses.en: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.
verses.fr: Et pendant que ton serviteur agissait çà et là, l''homme a disparu. Le roi d''Israël lui dit: C''est là ton jugement; tu l''as prononcé toi-même.
verses.am: ባሪያህም ወዲህና ወዲያ ሲመለከት ጠፋ አለው። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ፍርድህ እንዲሁ ይሆናል፤ አንተ ፈርድኸዋል አለው።

verses.en: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.
verses.fr: Aussitôt le prophète ôta le bandeau de dessus ses yeux, et le roi d''Israël le reconnut pour l''un des prophètes.
verses.am: ፈጥኖም ቀጸላውን ከዓይኑ አነሣ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ከነቢያት ወገን እንደ ሆነ አወቀው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.
verses.fr: Il dit alors au roi: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Parce que tu as laissé échapper de tes mains l''homme que j''avais dévoué par interdit, ta vie répondra de sa vie, et ton peuple de son peuple.
verses.am: እርሱም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እኔ እርም ያልሁትን ሰው ከእጅህ አውጥተሃልና ነፍስህ በነፍሱ ፋንታ ሕዝብህም በሕዝቡ ፋንታ ይሆናሉ አለው።

verses.en: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël s''en alla chez lui, triste et irrité, et il arriva à Samarie.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ እየተቈጣና እየተናደደ ወደ ቤቱ ተመለሰ፥ ወደ ሰማርያም መጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
verses.fr: Après ces choses, voici ce qui arriva. Naboth, de Jizreel, avait une vigne à Jizreel, à côté du palais d''Achab, roi de Samarie.
verses.am: ለኢይዝራኤላዊውም ለናቡቴ በሰማርያ ንጉሥ በአክዓብ ቤት አጠገብ የወይን ቦታ ነበረው።

verses.en: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.
verses.fr: Et Achab parla ainsi à Naboth: Cède-moi ta vigne, pour que j''en fasse un jardin potager, car elle est tout près de ma maison. Je te donnerai à la place une vigne meilleure; ou, si cela te convient, je te paierai la valeur en argent.
verses.am: አክዓብም ናቡቴን። በቤቴ አቅራቢያ ነውና የአትክልት ቦታ አደርገው ዘንድ የወይን ቦታህን ስጠኝ፤ ስለ እርሱም ከእርሱ የተሻለ የወይን ቦታ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ ወይም ብትወድድ ግምቱን ገንዘብ እሰጥሃለሁ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: And Naboth said to Ahab, The Lord forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
verses.fr: Mais Naboth répondit à Achab: Que l''Eternel me garde de te donner l''héritage de mes pères!
verses.am: ናቡቴም አክዓብን። የአባቶቼን ርስት እሰጥህ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያርቅልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
verses.fr: Achab rentra dans sa maison, triste et irrité, à cause de cette parole que lui avait dite Naboth de Jizreel: Je ne te donnerai pas l''héritage de mes pères! Et il se coucha sur son lit, détourna le visage, et ne mangea rien.
verses.am: ኢይዝራኤላዊውም ናቡቴ። የአባቶቼን ርስት አልሰጥህም ብሎ ስለ ተናገረው አክዓብ ተቈጥቶና ተናድዶ ወደ ቤቱ ገባ። በአልጋውም ላይ ተጋድሞ ፊቱን ተሸፋፈነ፥ እንጀራም አልበላም።

verses.en: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?
verses.fr: Jézabel, sa femme, vint auprès de lui, et lui dit: Pourquoi as-tu l''esprit triste et ne manges-tu point?
verses.am: ሚስቱም ኤልዛቤል ወደ እርሱ መጥታ። ልብህ የሚያዝን እንጀራስ የማትበላ ስለምንድር ነው? አለችው።

verses.en: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.
verses.fr: Il lui répondit: J''ai parlé à Naboth de Jizreel, et je lui ai dit: Cède-moi ta vigne pour de l''argent; ou, si tu veux, je te donnerai une autre vigne à la place. Mais il a dit: Je ne te donnerai pas ma vigne!
verses.am: እርሱም። ኢይዝራኤላዊውን ናቡቴን። የወይንህን ቦታ በገንዘብ ስጠኝ፤ ወይም ብትወድድ በፋንታው ሌላ የወይን ቦታ እሰጥሃለሁ ብዬ ተናገርሁት፤ እርሱ ግን። የወይን ቦታዬን አልሰጥህም ብሎ ስለ መለሰልኝ ነው አላት።

verses.en: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.fr: Alors Jézabel, sa femme, lui dit: Est-ce bien toi maintenant qui exerces la souveraineté sur Israël? Lève-toi, prends de la nourriture, et que ton coeur se réjouisse; moi, je te donnerai la vigne de Naboth de Jizreel.
verses.am: ሚስቱም ኤልዛቤል። አንተ አሁን የእስራኤልን መንግሥት ትገዛለህን? ተነሣ እንጀራም ብላ፥ ልብህም ደስ ይበላት፤ የኢይዝራኤላዊውን የናቡቴን የወይን ቦታ እሰጥሃለሁ አለችው።

verses.en: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.
verses.fr: Et elle écrivit au nom d''Achab des lettres qu''elle scella du sceau d''Achab, et qu''elle envoya aux anciens et aux magistrats qui habitaient avec Naboth dans sa ville.
verses.am: በአክዓብም ስም ደብዳቤ ጻፈች፥ በማኅተሙም አተመችው፤ በከተማው ወደ ነበሩትና ከናቡቴም ጋር ወደ ተቀመጡት ሽማግሌዎችና ከበርቴዎች ደብዳቤውን ላከች።

verses.en: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:
verses.fr: Voici ce qu''elle écrivit dans ces lettres: Publiez un jeûne; placez Naboth à la tête du peuple,
verses.am: በደብዳቤውም። ስለ ጾም አዋጅ ንገሩ፥ ናቡቴንም በሕዝቡ ፊት አስቀምጡት፤

verses.en: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.
verses.fr: et mettez en face de lui deux méchants hommes qui déposeront ainsi contre lui: Tu as maudit Dieu et le roi! Puis menez-le dehors, lapidez-le, et qu''il meure.
verses.am: ሁለትም ምናምንቴ ሰዎች በፊቱ አስቀምጡና። እግዚአብሔርንና ንጉሡን ሰድቦአል ብለው ይመስክሩበት፤ አውጥታችሁም እስኪሞት ድረስ ውገሩት ብላ ጻፈች።

verses.en: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
verses.fr: Les gens de la ville de Naboth, les anciens et les magistrats qui habitaient dans la ville, agirent comme Jézabel le leur avait fait dire, d''après ce qui était écrit dans les lettres qu''elle leur avait envoyées.
verses.am: በከተማውም የተቀመጡት የከተማው ሰዎችና ሽማግሌዎች ከበርቴዎችም ኤልዛቤል እንዳዘዘቻቸውና ወደ እነርሱ በተላከው ደብዳቤ እንደ ተጻፈ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.en: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
verses.fr: Ils publièrent un jeûne, et ils placèrent Naboth à la tête du peuple;
verses.am: የጾም አዋጅ ነገሩ፥ ናቡቴንም በሕዝቡ ፊት አስቀመጡት።

verses.en: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.
verses.fr: les deux méchants hommes vinrent se mettre en face de lui, et ces méchants hommes déposèrent ainsi devant le peuple contre Naboth: Naboth a maudit Dieu et le roi! Puis ils le menèrent hors de la ville, ils le lapidèrent, et il mourut.
verses.am: ሁለቱም ምናምንቴ ሰዎች ገብተው በፊቱ ተቀመጡ፤ ምናምንቴዎቹ ሰዎችም በሕዝቡ ፊት። ናቡቴ እግዚአብሔርንና ንጉሡን ሰድቦአል ብለው በናቡቴ ላይ መሰከሩ። የዚያን ጊዜም ከከተማ አውጥተው እስኪሞት ድረስ ወገሩት።

verses.en: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
verses.fr: Et ils envoyèrent dire à Jézabel: Naboth a été lapidé, et il est mort.
