verses.am: ወደ ኤልዛቤልም። ናቡቴ ተወግሮ ሞተ ብለው ላኩ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jézabel apprit que Naboth avait été lapidé et qu''il était mort, elle dit à Achab: Lève-toi, prends possession de la vigne de Naboth de Jizreel, qui a refusé de te la céder pour de l''argent; car Naboth n''est plus en vie, il est mort.
verses.am: ኤልዛቤልም ናቡቴ ተወግሮ እንደ ሞተ በሰማች ጊዜ ኤልዛቤል አክዓብን። ናቡቴ ሞቶአል እንጂ በሕይወት አይደለምና በገንዘብ ይሰጥህ ዘንድ እንቢ ያለውን የኢይዝራኤላዊውን የናቡቴን የወይን ቦታ ተነሥተህ ውረስ አለችው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
verses.fr: Achab, entendant que Naboth était mort, se leva pour descendre à la vigne de Naboth de Jizreel, afin d''en prendre possession.
verses.am: አክዓብም ናቡቴ እንደ ሞተ በሰማ ጊዜ ይወርሰው ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤላዊው ወደ ናቡቴ ወይን ቦታ ሊወርድ ተነሣ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.fr: Alors la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Elie, le Thischbite, en ces mots:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ ቴስብያዊው ወደ ኤልያስ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, descends au-devant d''Achab, roi d''Israël à Samarie; le voilà dans la vigne de Naboth, où il est descendu pour en prendre possession.
verses.am: ተነሥተህ በሰማርያ የሚኖረውን የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ አክዓብን ትገናኝ ዘንድ ውረድ፤ እነሆ፥ ይወርሰው ዘንድ በወረደበት በናቡቴ የወይን ቦታ ውስጥ አለ።

verses.en: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the Lord, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.
verses.fr: Tu lui diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: N''es-tu pas un assassin et un voleur? Et tu lui diras: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Au lieu même où les chiens ont léché le sang de Naboth, les chiens lécheront aussi ton propre sang.
verses.am: አንተም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል ገድለህ ወረስኸውን? ብለህ ንገረው። ደግሞም። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ውሾች የናቡቴን ደም በላሱበት ስፍራ የአንተን ደም ደግሞ ውሾች ይልሱታል ብለህ ንገረው።

verses.en: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.fr: Achab dit à Elie: M''as-tu trouvé, mon ennemi? Et il répondit: Je t''ai trouvé, parce que tu t''es vendu pour faire ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አክዓብም ኤልያስን። ጠላቴ ሆይ፥ አገኘኸኝን? አለው። እርሱም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት። አግኝቼሃለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ለማድረግ ራስህን ሽጠሃልና።

verses.en: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,
verses.fr: Voici, je vais faire venir le malheur sur toi; je te balaierai, j''exterminerai quiconque appartient à Achab, celui qui est esclave et celui qui est libre en Israël,
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ክፉ ነገር አመጣብሃለሁ፥ ፈጽሞም እጠርግሃለሁ፥ ከአክዓብም በእስራኤል ዘንድ የታሰረውንና የተለቀቀውን ወንድ ሁሉ አጠፋለሁ፤

verses.en: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.
verses.fr: et je rendrai ta maison semblable à la maison de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, et à la maison de Baescha, fils d''Achija, parce que tu m''as irrité et que tu as fait pécher Israël.
verses.am: በሥራህም አስቈጥተኸኛልና፥ እስራኤልንም አስተሃልና ቤትህን እንደ ናባጥ ልጅ እንደ ኢዮርብዓም ቤት እንደ አኪያም ልጅ እንደ ባኦስ ቤት አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: And of Jezebel also spake the Lord, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel parle aussi sur Jézabel, et il dit: Les chiens mangeront Jézabel près du rempart de Jizreel.
verses.am: ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ኤልዛቤል። በኢይዝራኤል ቅጥር አጠገብ ኤልዛቤልን ውሾች ይበሉአታል ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.fr: Celui de la maison d''Achab qui mourra dans la ville sera mangé par les chiens, et celui qui mourra dans les champs sera mangé par les oiseaux du ciel.
verses.am: ከአክዓብም ወገን በከተማይቱ ውስጥ የሞተውን ውሾች ይበሉታል፤ በሜዳውም የሞተውን የሰማይ ወፎች ይበሉታል።

verses.en: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the Lord, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
verses.fr: Il n''y a eu personne qui se soit vendu comme Achab pour faire ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, et Jézabel, sa femme, l''y excitait.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፋት ለመሥራት ራሱን እንደ ሸጠ፥ ሚስቱም ኤልዛቤል እንደ ነዳችው፥ እንደ አክዓብ ያለ ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.en: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Il a agi de la manière la plus abominable, en allant après les idoles, comme le faisaient les Amoréens, que l''Eternel chassa devant les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ያጠፋቸው አሞራውያን እንደ ሠሩት ሁሉ፥ ጣዖታትን በመከተል እጅግ ርኩስ ነገር ሠራ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
verses.fr: Après avoir entendu les paroles d''Elie, Achab déchira ses vêtements, il mit un sac sur son corps, et il jeûna; il couchait avec ce sac, et il marchait lentement.
verses.am: አክዓብም ይህን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀድዶ ገላውን ማቅ አለበሰ፥ ጾመም፥ በማቅ ላይም ተኛ፥ ቅስስ ብሎም ሄደ።

verses.en: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.fr: Et la parole de l''Eternel fut adressée à Elie, le Thischbite, en ces mots:
verses.am: ደግሞም። አክዓብ በፊቴ እንደ ተዋረደ አየህን? በፊቴ የተዋረደ ስለ ሆነ በልጁ ዘመን በቤቱ ላይ ክፉ ነገር አመጣለሁ እንጂ በእርሱ ዘመን ክፉ ነገር አላመጣም የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ቴስብያዊው ወደ ኤልያስ መጣ።

verses.en: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.
verses.fr: As-tu vu comment Achab s''est humilié devant moi? Parce qu''il s''est humilié devant moi, je ne ferai pas venir le malheur pendant sa vie; ce sera pendant la vie de son fils que je ferai venir le malheur sur sa maison.
verses.am: ደግሞም። አክዓብ በፊቴ እንደ ተዋረደ አየህን? በፊቴ የተዋረደ ስለ ሆነ በልጁ ዘመን በቤቱ ላይ ክፉ ነገር አመጣለሁ እንጂ በእርሱ ዘመን ክፉ ነገር አላመጣም የሚል የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ ቴስብያዊው ወደ ኤልያስ መጣ።

verses.en: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
verses.fr: On resta trois ans sans qu''il y eût guerre entre la Syrie et Israël.
verses.am: ሶርያና እስራኤልም ሳይዋጉ ሦስት ዓመት ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
verses.fr: La troisième année, Josaphat, roi de Juda, descendit auprès du roi d''Israël.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ወረደ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël dit à ses serviteurs: Savez-vous que Ramoth en Galaad est à nous? Et nous ne nous inquiétons pas de la reprendre des mains du roi de Syrie!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ባሪያዎቹን። ሬማት ዘገለዓድ የእኛ እንደ ሆነች፥ እኛም ከሶርያ ንጉሥ እጅ ሳንወስዳት ዝም እንዳልን ታውቃላችሁን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramothgilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
verses.fr: Et il dit à Josaphat: Veux-tu venir avec moi attaquer Ramoth en Galaad? Josaphat répondit au roi d''Israël: Nous irons, moi comme toi, mon peuple comme ton peuple, mes chevaux comme tes chevaux.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥንም። በሬማት ዘገለዓድ እንዋጋ ዘንድ ከእኔ ጋር ትመጣለህን? አለው። ኢዮሣፍጥም የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። እኔ እንደ አንተ፥ ሕዝቤም እንደ ሕዝብህ፥ ፈረሶቼም እንደ ፈረሶችህ ናቸው አለው።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the Lord to day.
verses.fr: Puis Josaphat dit au roi d''Israël: Consulte maintenant, je te prie, la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አስቀድመህ ትጠይቅ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël assembla les prophètes, au nombre d''environ quatre cents, et leur dit: Irai-je attaquer Ramoth en Galaad, ou dois-je y renoncer? Et ils répondirent: Monte, et le Seigneur la livrera entre les mains du roi.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ነቢያቶቹን አራት መቶ የሚያህሉትን ሰዎች ሰብስቦ። ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ ልሂድን? ወይስ ልቅር? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እግዚአብሔር በንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ውጣ አሉት።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.fr: Mais Josaphat dit: N''y a-t-il plus ici aucun prophète de l''Eternel, par qui nous puissions le consulter?
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥ ግን። እንጠይቀው ዘንድ ሌላ የእግዚአብሔር ነቢይ በዚህ አይገኝምን? አለ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the Lord: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël répondit à Josaphat: Il y a encore un homme par qui l''on pourrait consulter l''Eternel; mais je le hais, car il ne me prophétise rien de bon, il ne prophétise que du mal: c''est Michée, fils de Jimla. Et Josaphat dit: Que le roi ne parle pas ainsi!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። እግዚአብሔርን የምንጠይቅበት የይምላ ልጅ ሚክያስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው አለ፤ ነገር ግን ክፉ እንጂ መልካም ትንቢት አይናገርልኝምና እጠላዋለሁ አለው። ኢዮሣፍጥም። ንጉሥ እንዲህ አይበል አለ።

verses.en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.
verses.fr: Alors le roi d''Israël appela un eunuque, et dit: Fais venir de suite Michée, fils de Jimla.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አንዱን ጃንደረባ ጠርቶ። የይምላን ልጅ ሚክያስን ፈጥነህ አምጣ አለው።

verses.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, étaient assis chacun sur son trône, revêtus de leurs habits royaux, dans la place à l''entrée de la porte de Samarie. Et tous les prophètes prophétisaient devant eux.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ልብሰ መንግሥት ለብሰው በሰማርያ በር መግቢያ አጠገብ በአደባባይ በዙፋኖቻቸው ላይ ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ነቢያቶቹም ሁሉ በፊታቸው ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the Lord, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.
verses.fr: Sédécias, fils de Kenaana, s''était fait des cornes de fer, et il dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Avec ces cornes tu frapperas les Syriens jusqu''à les détruire.
verses.am: የክንዓና ልጅ ሴዴቅያስም የብረት ቀንዶች ሠርቶ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እስኪጠፉ ድረስ በእነዚህ ሶርያውያንን ትወጋለህ አለ።

verses.en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the Lord shall deliver it into the king's hand.
verses.fr: Et tous les prophètes prophétisaient de même, en disant: Monte à Ramoth en Galaad! tu auras du succès, et l''Eternel la livrera entre les mains du roi.
verses.am: ነቢያትም ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ሂድና ተከናወን እያሉ እንዲህ ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.
verses.fr: Le messager qui était allé appeler Michée lui parla ainsi: Voici, les prophètes, d''un commun accord, prophétisent du bien au roi; que ta parole soit donc comme la parole de chacun d''eux! annonce du bien!
verses.am: ሚክያስንም ሊጠራ የሄደ መልእክተኛ። እነሆ፥ ነቢያት ሁሉ በአንድ አፍ ሆነው ለንጉሡ መልካምን ይናገራሉ፤ ቃልህም እንደ ቃላቸው እንዲሆን መልካም እንድትናገር እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Micaiah said, As the Lord liveth, what the Lord saith unto me, that will I speak.
verses.fr: Michée répondit: L''Eternel est vivant! j''annoncerai ce que l''Eternel me dira.
verses.am: ሚክያስም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! እግዚአብሔር የሚነግረኝን እርሱን እናገራለሁ አለ።

verses.en: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut arrivé auprès du roi, le roi lui dit: Michée, irons-nous attaquer Ramoth en Galaad, ou devons-nous y renoncer? Il lui répondit: Monte! tu auras du succès, et l''Eternel la livrera entre les mains du roi.
verses.am: ወደ ንጉሡም በመጣ ጊዜ ንጉሡ። ሚክያስ ሆይ፥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ እንሂድን? ወይስ እንቅር? አለው፤ እርሱም። ውጣና ተከናወን፤ እግዚአብሔርም በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the Lord?
verses.fr: Et le roi lui dit: Combien de fois me faudra-t-il te faire jurer de ne me dire que la vérité au nom de l''Eternel?
verses.am: ንጉሡም። ከእውነት በቀር በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንዳትነግረኝ ስንት ጊዜ አምልሃለሁ? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the Lord said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
verses.fr: Michée répondit: Je vois tout Israël dispersé sur les montagnes, comme des brebis qui n''ont point de berger; et l''Eternel dit: Ces gens n''ont point de maître, que chacun retourne en paix dans sa maison!
verses.am: እርሱም። እስራኤል ሁሉ ጠባቂ እንደሌላቸው በጎች በተራሮች ላይ ተበትነው አየሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ለእነዚህ ጌታ የላቸውም እያንዳንዱም በሰላም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ አለ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël dit à Josaphat: Ne te l''ai-je pas dit? Il ne prophétise sur moi rien de bon, il ne prophétise que du mal.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ክፉ እንጂ መልካም እንደማይናገርልኝ አላልሁህምን? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
verses.fr: Et Michée dit: Ecoute donc la parole de l''Eternel! J''ai vu l''Eternel assis sur son trône, et toute l''armée des cieux se tenant auprès de lui, à sa droite et à sa gauche.
verses.am: ሚክያስም አለ። እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ እግዚአብሔር በዙፋኑ ተቀምጦ፥ የሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ በቀኙና በግራው ቆመው አየሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: Qui séduira Achab, pour qu''il monte à Ramoth en Galaad et qu''il y périsse? Ils répondirent l''un d''une manière, l''autre d''une autre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ወጥቶ በሬማት ዘገለዓድ ይወድቅ ዘንድ አክዓብን የሚያሳስት ማን ነው? አለ። አንዱም እንዲህ ያለ ነገር፥ ሌላውም እንዲያ የለ ነገር ተናገረ።

verses.en: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will persuade him.
verses.fr: Et un esprit vint se présenter devant l''Eternel, et dit: Moi, je le séduirai.
verses.am: መንፈስም ወጣ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቆሞ። እኔ አሳስተዋለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
verses.fr: L''Eternel lui dit: Comment? Je sortirai, répondit-il, et je serai un esprit de mensonge dans la bouche de tous ses prophètes. L''Eternel dit: Tu le séduiras, et tu en viendras à bout; sors, et fais ainsi!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። በምን? አለው፤ እርሱም። ወጥቼ በነቢያቶቹ ሁሉ አፍ ሐሰተኛ መንፈስ እሆናለሁ አለ። እግዚአብሔርም። ማሳሳትስ ታሳስተዋለህ፥ ይሆንልሃልም፤ ውጣ፥ እንዲሁም አድርግ አለ።

verses.en: Now therefore, behold, the Lord hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the Lord hath spoken evil concerning thee.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, voici, l''Eternel a mis un esprit de mensonge dans la bouche de tous tes prophètes qui sont là. Et l''Eternel a prononcé du mal contre toi.
verses.am: አሁንም። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእነዚህ በነቢያትህ ሁሉ አፍ ሐሰተኛ መንፈስ አድርጎአል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በላይህ ክፉ ተናግሮብሃል።

verses.en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the Lord from me to speak unto thee?
verses.fr: Alors Sédécias, fils de Kenaana, s''étant approché, frappa Michée sur la joue, et dit: Par où l''esprit de l''Eternel est-il sorti de moi pour te parler?
verses.am: የክንዓናም ልጅ ሴዴቅያስ ቀረበ፥ ሚክያስንም ጕንጩን በጥፊ መታውና። አንተን ሊናገር የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በምን መንገድ ከእኔ አለፈ? አለ።

verses.en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.fr: Michée répondit: Tu le verras au jour où tu iras de chambre en chambre pour te cacher.
verses.am: ሚክያስም። እነሆ፥ በዚያ ቀን ልትሸሸግ ወደ እልፍኝህ በሄድህ ጊዜ ታያለህ አለ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël dit: Prends Michée, et emmène-le vers Amon, chef de la ville, et vers Joas, fils du roi.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ሚክያስን ውሰዱ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም ሹም ወደ አሞን ወደ ንጉሡም ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአስ መልሳችሁ። ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
verses.fr: Tu diras: Ainsi parle le roi: Mettez cet homme en prison, et nourrissez-le du pain et de l''eau d''affliction, jusqu''à ce que je revienne en paix.
verses.am: በደኅና እስክመለስ ድረስ ይህን ሰው በግዞት አኑሩት፥ የመከራም እንጀራ መግቡት፥ የመከራም ውኃ አጠጡት በሉ አለ።

verses.en: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the Lord hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
verses.fr: Et Michée dit: Si tu reviens en paix, l''Eternel n''a point parlé par moi. Il dit encore: Vous tous, peuples, entendez!
verses.am: ሚክያስም። በደኅና ብትመለስ እግዚአብሔር በእኔ የተናገረ አይደለም አለ። ደግሞም። አሕዛብ ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ አለ።

verses.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, montèrent à Ramoth en Galaad.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ወጡ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël dit à Josaphat: Je veux me déguiser pour aller au combat; mais toi, revêts-toi de tes habits. Et le roi d''Israël se déguisa, et alla au combat.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ልብሴን ለውጬ ወደ ሰልፍ እገባለሁ፤ አንተ ግን ልብስህን ልበስ አለው። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ልብሱን ለውጦ ወደ ሰልፍ ገባ።

verses.en: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.
verses.fr: Le roi de Syrie avait donné cet ordre aux trente-deux chefs de ses chars: Vous n''attaquerez ni petits ni grands, mais vous attaquerez seulement le roi d''Israël.
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ ሠላሳ ሁለቱን የሰረገሎች አለቆች። ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ በቀር፥ ታናሽ ቢሆን ወይም ታላቅ ከማናቸውም ጋር አትግጠሙ ብሎ አዝዞ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.fr: Quand les chefs des chars aperçurent Josaphat, ils dirent: Certainement, c''est le roi d''Israël. Et ils s''approchèrent de lui pour l''attaquer. Josaphat poussa un cri.
verses.am: የሰረገሎች አለቆችም ኢዮሣፍጥን ባዩ ጊዜ። በእውነት የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነው አሉ፤ ይገጥሙትም ዘንድ ከበቡት፤ ኢዮሣፍጥም ጮኸ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.fr: Les chefs des chars, voyant que ce n''était pas le roi d''Israël, s''éloignèrent de lui.
verses.am: የሰረገሎች አለቆችም የእስራኤል ንጉሥ እንዳልሆነ ባዩ ጊዜ እርሱን ከማሳደድ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.fr: Alors un homme tira de son arc au hasard, et frappa le roi d''Israël au défaut de la cuirasse. Le roi dit à celui qui dirigeait son char: Tourne, et fais-moi sortir du champ de bataille, car je suis blessé.
verses.am: አንድ ሰውም ቀስቱን ድንገት ገትሮ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ በጥሩሩ ልብስ መጋጠሚያ በኩል ወጋው፤ ሰረገለኛውንም። መልሰህ ንዳ፥ ተወግቻለሁና ከሰልፍ ውስጥ አውጣኝ አለው።

verses.en: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
verses.fr: Le combat devint acharné ce jour-là. Le roi fut retenu dans son char en face des Syriens, et il mourut le soir. Le sang de la blessure coula dans l''intérieur du char.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ሰልፍ በረታ፤ ንጉሡም በሶርያውያን ፊት በሰረገላው ላይ ተደግፎ ነበር፥ ማታም ሞተ፤ የቍስሉም ደም በሰረገላው ውስጥ ፈሰሰ።

verses.en: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
verses.fr: Au coucher du soleil, on cria par tout le camp: Chacun à sa ville et chacun dans son pays!
verses.am: በሠራዊቱም መካከል ፀሐይ ስትገባ። ንጉሡ ሞቶአልና እያንዳንዱ ወደ ከተማው፥ እያንዳንዱም ወደ አገሩ ይሂድ የሚል ጩኸት ሆነ።

verses.en: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.fr: Ainsi mourut le roi, qui fut ramené à Samarie; et on enterra le roi à Samarie.
verses.am: ወደ ሰማርያም መጡ፥ ንጉሡንም በሰማርያ ቀበሩት።

verses.en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the Lord which he spake.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''on lava le char à l''étang de Samarie, les chiens léchèrent le sang d''Achab, et les prostituées s''y baignèrent, selon la parole que l''Eternel avait prononcée.
verses.am: አመንዝሮች በታጠቡባት በሰማርያ ኵሬ ሰረገላውን አጠቡት፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረው ቃል ውሾች ደሙን ላሱት።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions d''Achab, tout ce qu''il a fait, la maison d''ivoire qu''il construisit, et toutes les villes qu''il a bâties, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois d''Israël?
verses.am: የቀረውም የአክዓብ ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ ከዝሆን ጥርስም የሠራው ቤት፥ የሠራቸውም ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Achab se coucha avec ses pères. Et Achazia, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: አክዓብም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ ልጁ አካዝያስ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.fr: Josaphat, fils d''Asa, régna sur Juda, la quatrième année d''Achab, roi d''Israël.
verses.am: አክዓብም በነገሠ በአራተኛው ዓመት የአሳ ልጅ ኢዮሣፍጥ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.fr: Josaphat avait trente-cinq ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna vingt cinq ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Azuba, fille de Schilchi.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ አምስት ዓመት ጎበዝ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ አምስት ዓመት ነገሠ። እናቱም ዓዙባ የተባለች የሺልሒ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the Lord: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
verses.fr: Il marcha dans toute la voie d''Asa, son père, et ne s''en détourna point, faisant ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel. Seulement, les hauts lieux ne disparurent point; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et des parfums sur les hauts lieux.
verses.am: በአባቱም በአሳ መንገድ ሁሉ ሄደ፥ ከእርሱም ፈቀቅ አላለም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን በኮረብቶች ላይ ያሉትን መስገጃዎች አላራቀም፤ ሕዝቡ ገና በኮረብቶቹ ላይ ባሉት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.fr: Josaphat fut en paix avec le roi d''Israël.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ጋር ታረቀ።  vፕ

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Josaphat, ses exploits et ses guerres, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Chroniques des rois de Juda?
verses.am: የቀረውም የኢዮሣፍጥ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ጭከና፥ እንዴትም እንደ ተወጋ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
verses.fr: Il ôta du pays le reste des prostitués, qui s''y trouvaient encore depuis le temps d''Asa, son père.
verses.am: ከአባቱ ከአሳ ዘመን የተረፉትን ሰዶማውያን ከምድር አጠፋ።

verses.en: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
verses.fr: Il n''y avait point de roi en Edom: c''était un intendant qui gouvernait.
verses.am: በኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ አልነበረም፤ ሹሙም እንደ ንጉሥ ነበረ።

verses.en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Eziongeber.
verses.fr: Josaphat construisit des navires de Tarsis pour aller à Ophir chercher de l''or; mais il n''y alla point, parce que les navires se brisèrent à Etsjon-Guéber.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም ወደ ኦፊር ሄደው ወርቅ ያመጡ ዘንድ የተርሴስን መርከቦች ሠራ፤ ነገር ግን መርከቦቹ በዔጽዮንጋብር ተሰበሩ እንጂ አልሄዱም።

verses.en: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
verses.fr: Alors Achazia, fils d''Achab, dit à Josaphat: Veux-tu que mes serviteurs aillent avec les tiens sur des navires? Et Josaphat ne voulut pas.
verses.am: የአክዓብም ልጅ አካዝያስ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ባሪያዎቼ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር በመርከብ ይሂዱ አለው፤ ኢዮሣፍጥ ግን አልወደደም።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Josaphat se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré avec ses pères dans la ville de David, son père. Et Joram, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ልጁ ኢዮራም ነገሠ።

verses.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
verses.fr: Achazia, fils d''Achab, régna sur Israël à Samarie, la dix-septième année de Josaphat, roi de Juda. Il régna deux ans sur Israël.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በኢዮሣፍጥ በአሥራ ሰባተኛው ዓመት የአክዓብ ልጅ አካዝያስ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ በእስራኤልም ላይ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, et il marcha dans la voie de son père et dans la voie de sa mère, et dans la voie de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qui avait fait pécher Israël.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፥ በአባቱና በእናቱም መንገድ፥ እስራኤልንም ባሳተው በናባጥ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም መንገድ ሄደ።

verses.en: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the Lord God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.
verses.fr: Il servit Baal et se prosterna devant lui, et il irrita l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, comme avait fait son père.
verses.am: በኣልንም አመለከ ሰገደለትም፤ አባቱም እንዳደረገ ሁሉ የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣ።
